script.label: 剧本 · 短剧 · 影视

interactive.label: 互动叙事 · 游戏 · 角色扮演

imitation.label: 仿写 · 同人 · 风格迁移

planning.label: 规划先行：层级大纲、分解写作
planning.label_en: Plan first: hierarchical outlines, decomposed drafting

theory.label: 叙事理论注入：结构模型、类型套路、写作原则
theory.label_en: Narrative theory: structure models, genre tropes, craft principles

character.label: 人物塑造 · 角色档案

memory.label: 长篇记忆 · 一致性：状态库、设定库、检索
memory.label_en: Long-form memory · continuity: state stores, setting bibles, retrieval

multiagent.label: 多智能体分工：作者、编辑、审稿、读者
multiagent.label_en: Multi-agent roles: writer, editor, reviewer, reader

simulation.label: 角色模拟 · 世界推演：让角色演出情节
simulation.label_en: Character and world simulation: let characters act out the plot

revision.label: 审稿 · 自我批评 · 迭代修订

style.label: 风格学习 · 仿写：范文、文风蒸馏、拆书
style.label_en: Style learning · imitation: exemplars, style distillation, book teardowns

deai.label: 去 AI 味 · 文笔打磨

interactive.label: 交互共创：读者选择、人机协作
interactive.label_en: Interactive co-creation: reader choices, human-AI collaboration

factual.label: 事实约束：素材驱动、证据核对、不编造
factual.label_en: Fact constraints: source-driven, evidence checks, no fabrication

formats.skill: 标准 SKILL.md 或 agent 插件
formats.prompts: 提示词 / 方法文档，需手动使用
formats.harness: agent 框架、编排系统或命令行工具
formats.app: 完整应用：桌面、网页、移动端

entries.name: inkos
entries.desc: 统一 harness 管长短篇、剧本、同人仿写、互动影游；长篇用 truth files 记设定、伏笔和角色状态，每章写后审计→修订→状态回写
entries.desc_en: A single harness for long and short fiction, scripts, fan fiction imitation and interactive film-games; long-form uses truth files for settings, foreshadowing and character state, with audit, revise and state write-back after each chapter

entries.name: zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode
entries.desc: 扫榜找题材、拆爆款提节奏与素材，再按细纲逐章写；设定、大纲、追踪分文件落盘，状态卡分开作者真相与读者已知，写后脚本查 AI 句式
entries.desc_en: Finds genres via ranking-chart analysis, tears down hits for pacing and material, writes from detailed outlines; separate setting/outline/tracking files, state cards split author truth from reader knowledge, post-write AI-pattern script
entries.note: 同团队另有 DeepSeek Harness 版 oh-story-dsh
entries.note_en: The same team has a DeepSeek Harness version, oh-story-dsh

entries.name: webnovel-writer
entries.desc: Claude Code 长篇网文插件：分阶段初始化设定与总纲、拆卷纲章纲，写章后多维审查并把事实提交进状态库与 RAG，可查伏笔角色，附只读面板
entries.desc_en: Claude Code long-form web novel plugin: staged setup of setting and master outline, volume and chapter outlines, multi-dimension review per chapter, facts committed to a state store and RAG, queryable foreshadowing, read-only dashboard
entries.note: master 为 Claude Code 版，新功能在 v8 分支（DeepSeek Harness）
entries.note_en: master is the Claude Code version; new features are on the v8 branch (DeepSeek Harness)

entries.name: AI_NovelGenerator
entries.desc: 本地部署的长篇小说生成应用：用雪花法从核心创意逐级展开卷、弧、场景、章纲到正文，管理角色/势力/物品/伏笔状态，AI 流程可在画布上改
entries.desc_en: Locally deployed long-form generator: snowflake method expands a core idea into volumes, arcs, scenes, chapter outlines and prose, manages character / faction / item / foreshadowing state, and the AI flow can be edited on a canvas
entries.note: main 分支已经重写（Next.js + FastAPI + MongoDB），旧版留在 old 分支，两版数据不兼容
entries.note_en: The main branch has been rewritten (Next.js + FastAPI + MongoDB), the old version stays on the old branch, and the two versions' data are incompatible

entries.name: NousResearch/autonovel
entries.desc: 仿 autoresearch 的改—评—留弃循环：设定、人物、大纲、文风、canon 打分过阈值，逐章起草评分重写，再经对抗删改、读者评审团和 Opus 审稿
entries.desc_en: autoresearch-style modify-evaluate-keep/discard loop: setting, characters, outline, style, canon scored against thresholds, chapters drafted and rewritten, then adversarial cuts, reader panel, Opus review
entries.note: 无 License；附 CRAFT.md / ANTI-SLOP.md 等写作原则文档；示例成书在 autonovel/bells 分支；导出阶段另有排版、插画和 ElevenLabs 有声书
entries.note_en: No license; includes writing-principle docs such as CRAFT.md / ANTI-SLOP.md; sample finished book on the autonovel/bells branch; export stage also covers typesetting, illustrations and an ElevenLabs audiobook

entries.name: RecurrentGPT
entries.desc: 用自然语言模拟 LSTM：每步写一段正文和下一段计划，改写短期记忆，段落摘要存入可语义检索的长期记忆；人可选改计划共写任意长度小说
entries.desc_en: Simulates an LSTM in natural language: each step writes a paragraph and the next plan, rewrites short-term memory, and stores paragraph summaries in searchable long-term memory; a human can edit the plan to co-write a novel of any length
entries.note: 论文 arXiv 2305.13304；依赖 OpenAI API；也演示了互动小说用法；开源模型适配版见 jackaduma/Recurrent-LLM
entries.note_en: Paper arXiv 2305.13304; depends on the OpenAI API; also demos interactive fiction use; open-model port at jackaduma/Recurrent-LLM

entries.name: neuro-book
entries.desc: 长篇写作 IDE：时间线切面事件溯源推算世界状态，伏笔承诺账本，leader/writer 等多 agent 分工写章，llmlint 规则查 AI 味
entries.desc_en: Long-form writing IDE: timeline-slice event sourcing computes world state, a foreshadowing promise ledger, leader/writer multi-agent chapters, llmlint rules for AI tone
entries.note: AGPL-3.0；当前分支按 v2 方案重建中，可用版本在 master；去 AI 味 lint 另有独立仓库 notnotype/llmlint
entries.note_en: AGPL-3.0; the current branch is being rebuilt as a v2 plan, the usable version is on master; the de-AI lint is a separate repo notnotype/llmlint

entries.name: PenglongHuang/chinese-novelist-skill
entries.desc: 从零生成 10–50 章中文小说：三层问答、创作记忆、每章悬念钩子、自动校验
entries.desc_en: Generates 10-50 chapter Chinese novels from scratch: three-layer Q&A, creative memory, a suspense hook in every chapter, and automatic checks

entries.name: AI-Novel-Writing-Assistant
entries.desc: 长篇小说创作工作台：自动导演从灵感推进到开书、世界观、角色、章节规划、正文与检查，含拆书、写法引擎、反 AI 规则、RAG 知识库和短篇流程
entries.desc_en: Long-form workbench: an auto-director runs inspiration to setup, worldbuilding, characters, chapter planning, prose and checks; book teardown, style engine, anti-AI rules, RAG, short-story flow
entries.note: 有 Windows 桌面版，也能从源码部署；能把已写章节延展成漫画分镜和短剧素材。作者另有 ani-book-skill（已收）
entries.note_en: Has a Windows desktop build, or deploy from source; can extend written chapters into comic storyboards and short-drama material; the author also has ani-book-skill (listed)

entries.name: MuMuAINovel
entries.desc: 小说创作 Web 应用：向导生成大纲、角色、世界观和职业等级体系，逐章生成并按分析重写，带伏笔追踪、拆书、自定义文风和可编辑 Prompt 模板
entries.desc_en: Web novel app: a wizard generates outline, characters, worldbuilding and a profession/rank system, then chapters one by one with analysis-based rewrites, foreshadowing tracking, book teardown, custom styles and editable Prompt templates
entries.note: Docker + PostgreSQL 部署；README 有大量 API 中转站赞助广告；内置 story-* skill 搬自 oh-story-claudecode
entries.note_en: Deployed with Docker + PostgreSQL; README has many API relay sponsor ads; the built-in story-* skills are copied from oh-story-claudecode

entries.name: gpt-author
entries.desc: 先生成多个情节并选出最佳再改进，写出指定章数的故事线并再改一轮，逐章参考前文写作，最后生成封面打包 EPUB
entries.desc_en: Generates several plots and picks and improves the best, writes a storyline for the requested number of chapters and revises it once more, writes each chapter with reference to earlier text, then generates a cover and packages an EPUB
entries.note: 2023 年的早期代表作，Jupyter/Colab 笔记本；另有更简化的 Claude 3 版本
entries.note_en: Influential early project from 2023, Jupyter/Colab notebook; there is also a more simplified Claude 3 version

entries.name: ainovel-cli
entries.desc: 全自动长篇小说生成 CLI：确定性引擎调度 Architect/Writer/Editor 三个代理，卷弧滚动规划、七维评审、步骤级断点恢复，可随时插入修改意见
entries.desc_en: Fully automatic long-form CLI: a deterministic engine runs Architect/Writer/Editor agents, rolling volume-arc planning, seven-dimension review, step-level resume, feedback insertable anytime
entries.note: 主打一句话全自动成书；想逐章把关可开 /review on。可在 TUI 里看着写，也可 headless 跑在服务器上
entries.note_en: Built for fully automatic one-sentence book generation; turn on /review on for chapter-by-chapter control. Can be watched in the TUI or run headless on a server

entries.name: arboris-novel
entries.desc: 写作网页应用：角色/地点/派系设定库，AI 把灵感整理成主线蓝图和章节纲要，按纲要生成章节并抽取摘要供后文使用，支持一次多版本择优
entries.desc_en: Web writing app: character/place/faction setting bible, AI turns ideas into a blueprint and chapter outlines, generates chapters and extracts summaries for later use, several versions per run
entries.note: 需 OpenAI 兼容 API；想用命令行加编辑器可搭配 t59688/novel-kit；仓库无许可证
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI-compatible API; for a CLI plus editor workflow pair with t59688/novel-kit; no license

entries.name: 91Writing
entries.desc: 前端小说创作台：按类型模板建书，AI 生成大纲与章节、续写和分类润色，世界观模板化管理并做一致性检查，提示词库带变量可自定义
entries.desc_en: Front-end novel writing desk: books from genre templates, AI generates outlines and chapters, continuation and categorized polish, templated worldbuilding management with consistency checks, and a variable-driven custom prompt library
entries.note: 2025-10 后未更新，按 ≥100★ 保留；需自配 OpenAI 兼容 API，内置提示词仅为演示
entries.note_en: Not updated since 2025-10, kept under the 100-star rule; you supply your own OpenAI-compatible API, built-in prompts are demos only

entries.name: EthanYoQ/AI-Novel-Writer
entries.desc: 桌面长篇写作软件：前提、角色、世界观、章节蓝图、草稿、审稿、修稿、定稿逐段推进，可按阶段绑定写作 Skill，支持本地与在线模型
entries.desc_en: Desktop long-form app advancing premise, characters, worldbuilding, chapter blueprint, draft, review, revision, finalization; Skills bindable per stage; local or online models
entries.note: 提供 Windows/macOS 桌面版；仓库里另有 DeepSeek Harness 插件预览版，已冻结，作者说它的能力不到桌面版一成
entries.note_en: Windows/macOS desktop builds available; the repo also has a frozen DeepSeek Harness plugin preview that the author says has under a tenth of the desktop version's capability

entries.name: RhythmicWave/NovelForge
entries.desc: 卡片式长篇创作工具：按 JSON Schema 结构化生成设定、角色、大纲卡片，用 @DSL 注入上下文、知识图谱保一致，可编排代码式工作流（含拆书）
entries.desc_en: Card-based long-form tool: generates setting, character and outline cards structured by JSON Schema, injects context with an @DSL, keeps consistency with a knowledge graph, and orchestrates code-style workflows (including book teardown)

entries.name: Long-Novel-GPT
entries.desc: 长篇小说 Agent：章节→剧情→正文逐级扩写并多线程并行；可导入已有小说拆书得剧情纲要，按意见检索片段改写并同步更新纲要
entries.desc_en: Long-form novel agent: expands chapter, plot, then prose level by level with parallel threads; teardown of existing novels into outlines, rewrites retrieved passages per feedback and syncs the outline
entries.note: 2025-11 后未更新（1247★）；附天蚕土豆风格等提示词；Docker 部署
entries.note_en: Not updated since 2025-11 (1247 stars); includes prompts such as a Tiancan Tudou style; Docker deployment

entries.name: OpenFic
entries.desc: 人机协同的小说写作工具：写作编辑器加可自定义的 Prompt/Agent/工作流，维护设定、角色与伏笔，向量检索百万字项目，支持 Docker/pip/桌面版
entries.desc_en: Human-AI collaborative novel tool: writing editor plus customizable Prompts/Agents/workflows, maintains settings, characters and foreshadowing, vector retrieval over million-character projects; supports Docker, pip and a desktop version
entries.note: 定位是协同写作，不做一键成书。README 里有 API 中转商的推广链接
entries.note_en: Positioned as co-writing, not one-click book generation. README contains promo links for an API relay provider

entries.name: AI-automatically-generates-novels
entries.desc: 种子→根合同→里程碑链→逐章细纲→正文，每层发散 3 个候选由程序选优；评审须引原句证据、由程序扣分并自动返修，也能写短剧和影视剧本
entries.desc_en: Seed, root contract, milestone chain, chapter outlines, prose; each layer diverges 3 candidates the program picks from; reviews must quote the original sentence, program deducts and auto-revises; also writes short drama and screenplays
entries.note: 带 Web UI 和守护进程长跑；内容类型由 packs 声明，可扩展；需配置至少一个模型网关
entries.note_en: Has a Web UI and a daemon for long runs; content types are declared by packs and extensible; at least one model gateway must be configured

entries.name: wordflowlab/novel-writer
entries.desc: 参照 Spec-Kit 的七步法：宪法→规格→澄清→计划→任务→写作→分析，以斜杠命令装进多种 AI 助手，配情节/时间线/关系/世界观追踪做一致性检查
entries.desc_en: Seven-step method modeled on Spec-Kit (constitution, spec, clarify, plan, tasks, write, analyze) as slash commands in many AI assistants, with plot/timeline/relationship tracking for consistency
entries.note: npm 包 novel-writer-cn，novel init 生成项目和命令；插件含真实人声、风格模仿等
entries.note_en: npm package novel-writer-cn, novel init generates the project and commands; plugins include real human voice, style imitation, etc.

entries.name: denova
entries.desc: 小说写作与 AI 文字冒险一体平台：资料库按组给 Agent 供上下文，支持 SubAgent 协作和定时续写/审阅；游戏侧有剧情分支、角色世界状态与规则检定
entries.desc_en: Novel writing plus AI text adventure platform: grouped knowledge base feeds the Agent, SubAgent collaboration, scheduled continuation/review; game side has branches, world state, rule checks
entries.note: 发布版默认开启匿名使用统计（Umami，可关）；一键安装为 curl | sh 脚本
entries.note_en: Release builds enable anonymous usage statistics by default (Umami, can be turned off); one-line install is a curl | sh script

entries.name: Chinese-WebNovel-Skill
entries.desc: 网文写作 skill：主路由分派到开头、转场、对白、章末、剧情逻辑、人物一致性、卷纲、去 AI 味等 10 个模块，写前检索本地语料范例
entries.desc_en: Web novel skill: a main router dispatches to 10 modules (opening, transitions, dialogue, chapter ending, plot logic, character consistency, volume outline, de-AI), retrieving local corpus examples first
entries.note: README 未写安装方式：SKILL.md 在仓库根目录，把整个仓库放进 skills 目录即可；附 166 篇短篇语料约 11MB，检索脚本需 Python 3
entries.note_en: README gives no install method: SKILL.md is at the repo root, put the whole repo in the skills directory; includes 166 short-story corpus pieces (~11MB), retrieval script needs Python 3

entries.name: yuanbw2025/storyforge
entries.desc: 本地优先叙事工作台：长短篇小说、剧本、漫画/漫剧素材共用世界设定，按需检索上下文并限定字段写回，支持节点流程、插件，还能从作品派生跑团等互动体验
entries.desc_en: Local-first narrative workbench: novels, scripts and comic/motion-comic material share worldbuilding, context retrieved on demand and written back only to constrained fields, node-based flows, plugins, can derive TRPG-style experiences
entries.note: README 有九种语言，正文以中文为主；可经 Codex app-server 复用 ChatGPT 登录；含插件作者包 zip；漫剧部分只做到分镜交付包
entries.note_en: README in nine languages, body mostly Chinese; can reuse a ChatGPT login via the Codex app-server; includes a plugin author kit zip; the motion-comic part only reaches a storyboard delivery package

entries.name: Openwrite
entries.desc: DeepSeek Harness 长篇小说插件：统一创作 Agent 加 90 个小说工具，人物、设定、大纲、伏笔存本地，章节走标准审稿 DAG 与去 AI 味
entries.desc_en: DeepSeek Harness long-form plugin: one writing Agent plus 90 novel tools, characters/settings/outlines/foreshadowing stored locally, chapters pass a review DAG and de-AI
entries.note: 需 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）宿主；preset 内含 oh-story-deslop / long-write / review 等 skill，疑似取自 zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode
entries.note_en: Needs the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) host; the preset includes skills like oh-story-deslop / long-write / review that appear to be taken from zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode

entries.name: QMAI
entries.desc: 总纲→卷纲→17 节章纲三级大纲；每章定稿后摄取摘要/人物状态/伏笔/图谱，写前按优先级组装上下文混合检索；拆文库提取文风与角色，六维审查
entries.desc_en: Master, volume and 17-section chapter outlines; each finalized chapter ingests summary, character state, foreshadowing and graph; hybrid-retrieval context by priority; teardown library extracts style and characters; six-dimension review
entries.note: Tauri 桌面应用，官网 qmai.pro；许可证非标准声明（NOASSERTION）
entries.note_en: Tauri desktop app, website qmai.pro; license is a non-standard declaration (NOASSERTION)

entries.name: awesome-novel-agent
entries.desc: 总控 agent 按状态文件逐个派 8 个子 agent：卷纲→章纲场景卡→提示词组装→正文→Gate A-F 去 AI 味（不过就重写）→归档更新设定
entries.desc_en: A master agent dispatches 8 sub-agents from state files: volume outline→chapter scene cards→prompt assembly→draft→Gate A-F de-AI (rewrite on fail)→archive and update settings
entries.note: 名字带 awesome，但它是创作 agent，不是列表；README 写明个人免费、商用需联系作者授权（仓库许可证为 AGPL-3.0）
entries.note_en: Despite the awesome- name, it is a writing agent, not a list; the README says free for personal use, commercial use needs the author's permission (repo license is AGPL-3.0)

entries.name: inliver233/Ai-Novel
entries.desc: 自托管长篇写作平台：项目→大纲/细纲→章节，角色与世界观条目结构化存储，pgvector 检索故事记忆注入生成，可调试 Prompt 模板并批量生成
entries.desc_en: Self-hosted long-form platform: project to outline/detailed outline to chapters, structured characters and worldbuilding entries, pgvector story memory injected into generation, debuggable prompt templates, batch generation
entries.note: README 对应 lite 分支；部署需 Docker Compose（PostgreSQL + pgvector、Redis）
entries.note_en: README corresponds to the lite branch; deployment needs Docker Compose (PostgreSQL + pgvector, Redis)

entries.name: easy-writing
entries.desc: 本地网文写作桌面软件：工作流一键建书（灵感→大纲→设定→逐章自动生文，可断点续），配合续写、润色扩写和大纲/角色/时间线资料库
entries.desc_en: Local web novel desktop software: a workflow sets up a book in one click (inspiration, outline, settings, then automatic resumable chapter text), with continuation, polish/expansion and outline, character and timeline libraries
entries.note: Tauri 桌面应用，BYOK；提示词为本地 md 可改；附竞品拆书与榜单爬虫；AGPL-3.0，另有商业授权
entries.note_en: Tauri desktop app, BYOK; prompts are local editable md files; includes competitor book teardown and a ranking crawler; AGPL-3.0, commercial license also available

entries.name: novel-creator-skill
entries.desc: 每章强制五步门禁（记忆同步→一致性→风格校准→校稿→脚本），配 RAG 回读、知识图谱、进度配额、跨 agent 交叉审稿与事件冷却，两遍去 AI 味
entries.desc_en: Every chapter must pass a five-step gate (memory sync, consistency, style calibration, proofreading, script), with RAG readback, knowledge graph, progress quotas, cross-agent peer review, event cooldown, and two passes of de-AI
entries.note: 最后更新 2026-03-10，因 682★ 收录；去 AI 味润色基于 blader/humanizer 方法论
entries.note_en: Last updated 2026-03-10, included for its 682 stars; the de-AI polish is based on the blader/humanizer methodology

entries.name: show-me-the-story
entries.desc: 长篇小说本地应用：设定角色与世界观后分批生成大纲，逐章起草、审阅、定向修订；抽取带出处的事实、追踪伏笔、提出设定变更，最后全书校对
entries.desc_en: Local long-form app: after you set characters and worldbuilding it generates outlines in batches, drafts, reviews and targeted-revises each chapter, extracts sourced facts, tracks foreshadowing, proposes setting changes, proofreads the book
entries.note: 单个 Go 可执行文件，需 OpenAI 兼容 API；Release 提供预编译包，源码完整；支持导入已有作品续写
entries.note_en: Single Go executable, needs an OpenAI-compatible API; Releases provide prebuilt packages, source is complete; can import an existing work to continue

entries.name: kimi-writer

entries.desc_en: Generates a master outline with main/side plots, foreshadowing and character arcs, splits it into volumes and chapter outlines, streams chapters with per-volume context, then de-AIs the prose
entries.note: Java + React 平台，作者另有在线版；License 未声明标准协议；同作者的 AnimaHub 是视频平台，未收
entries.note_en: Java + React platform with a separate hosted version by the author; license not declared as a standard one; the author's AnimaHub (a video platform) is not listed

entries.name: eliumusk/ai-novel-writer
entries.desc: PyQt 写作应用：Gemini 按全书大纲和章纲生成正文，SQLite 存角色、关系和章节摘要，自动摘要并追踪情节线与伏笔，支持文风模仿
entries.desc_en: PyQt writing app: Gemini generates text from the book outline and chapter outlines, SQLite stores characters, relationships and chapter summaries, with automatic summaries, plotline and foreshadowing tracking, and style imitation
entries.note: 需 Gemini API
entries.note_en: Needs a Gemini API

entries.name: Narraverse-Engine
entries.desc: 长篇大纲与世界观推演工作室：LangGraph swarm 多 agent 回合制议事，维护正典库和关系图谱，推演世界规则、大纲、伏笔和正文，人工确认后入库
entries.desc_en: Long-form outline and worldbuilding simulation studio: a LangGraph swarm of agents deliberates in turns, maintains a canon store and relationship graph, simulates rules, outline, foreshadowing and text, human confirms before storing
entries.note: 0.2.0 Alpha；Docker Compose 一键启动，数据存本地 SQLite
entries.note_en: 0.2.0 Alpha; one-command start with Docker Compose, data in local SQLite

entries.name: chinese-webnovel-skills
entries.desc: 按「平台+频道+题材」参数套用起点/番茄的爽点、打脸四拍和追读节奏，30+ 技能覆盖选题、大纲、金手指、扩写、追读诊断、连贯检查、去 AI 味
entries.desc_en: Applies Qidian/Fanqie payoff beats, face-slap four-beat and retention pacing by platform+channel+genre; 30+ skills from topic and outline to retention diagnosis, continuity check, de-AI
entries.note: 另有接自有 API 的终端 CLI 版；含一个短剧剧本技能
entries.note_en: Also has a terminal CLI version using your own API; includes a short drama script skill

entries.name: EdwardAThomson/NovelWriter
entries.desc: 多类型小说写作 GUI：按类型套路生成宇宙设定、势力和人物，再做结构大纲、场景规划和逐章正文，多 agent 编排，多级审阅
entries.desc_en: Multi-genre novel writing GUI: generates universe, factions and characters from genre conventions, then structural outline, scene planning and chapter prose via multi-agent orchestration and layered review
entries.note: Tkinter 界面；可走 API 或本地 codex/gemini/claude CLI；作者另有 EdwardAThomson/StoryDaemon
entries.note_en: Tkinter interface; works via API or local codex/gemini/claude CLI; the author also has EdwardAThomson/StoryDaemon

entries.name: book-writer
entries.desc: Claude Code 写书 harness：调研→计划审批→最多 4 写手并行写章，小说档案由连续性守护维护故事圣经、伏笔与节奏报告，验收后出 EPUB
entries.desc_en: Claude Code book-writing harness: research, plan approval, up to 4 parallel chapter writers; the fiction profile has a continuity guardian maintaining a story bible, foreshadowing and pacing reports; EPUB output after acceptance
entries.note: 韩语；默认是技术书档案，v1.3 起加入小说/实用书/随笔文体档案
entries.note_en: Korean; defaults to a technical-book profile, with fiction/practical-book/essay profiles added in v1.3

entries.name: ReasoningNCP
entries.desc: 论文代码：以 VR-CLI 奖励（计划能否提升下一章原文似然）做强化学习，训练模型先推理下一章计划再续写长篇，含数据构建、SFT/RL 与评测
entries.desc_en: Paper code: RL with a VR-CLI reward (does the plan raise the likelihood of the real next chapter) trains a model to reason out a next-chapter plan before continuing long-form fiction; includes data building, SFT/RL and evaluation
entries.note: Learning to Reason for Long-Form Story Generation（arXiv 2503.22828）；训练需 GPU
entries.note_en: Learning to Reason for Long-Form Story Generation (arXiv 2503.22828); training needs a GPU

entries.name: fanqie-novel-skill
entries.desc: 番茄长篇写作 skill：写前读状态文件，写后去 AI 味并跑 8 项最小审计（字数、因果链、战斗、对话占比、话疗、循环等）
entries.desc_en: Fanqie long-form skill that reads state files before writing, then strips AI prose and runs 8 minimal audits (word count, causal chain, fights, dialogue ratio, loops)
entries.note: 工作流和状态文件（current_state、pending_hooks、character_matrix 等）沿用 Narcooo/inkos，另加番茄平台规则、商业审查和战斗/对话/话疗/循环审计
entries.note_en: Workflow and state files (current_state, pending_hooks, character_matrix, etc.) follow Narcooo/inkos; adds Fanqie platform rules, commercial review, and fight/dialogue/talk-it-out/loop audits

entries.name: StoryMoss
entries.desc: 主创、管理、编辑审计三代理黑板协作，每章过加权质量门才交付；续写前检索前文原文，按书纲→卷纲→章纲规划，正文写完自动回流角色/设定/伏笔入库
entries.desc_en: Author, manager and editor-auditor agents share a blackboard; each chapter passes a weighted quality gate; plans book→volume→chapter and writes characters/settings/foreshadowing to a store
entries.note: Tauri+Rust 桌面应用，支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama；另有 StyleDNA 文风、拆书、按公版人类语料校准的 AI 腔检测；GitHub 未识别许可证（README 徽章写 ISC），仓库根目录混有构建日志等杂项
entries.note_en: Tauri+Rust desktop app supporting OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama; also has StyleDNA style, book teardown, and AI-tone detection calibrated on public-domain human text; GitHub detects no license (README badge says ISC), repo root contains build logs and other clutter

entries.name: DaisyWriter
entries.desc: 在 webnovel-writer 的开书/规划/写章/审查流程上加扫榜、拆书、批量写、设定审查与去 AI 味，另有中短篇开书→写作→审查流水线
entries.desc_en: Adds ranking-chart analysis, book teardown, batch writing, setting review and de-AI to webnovel-writer's setup/plan/write/review flow, plus a mid-length and short-story pipeline
entries.note: 基于 lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer（init/plan/write/review 等 8 个），另加扫榜、拆书、批量写、设定审查、去 AI 味、中短篇 5 个 skill 和封面生成；番茄发布取自 amm10090/fanqie-publisher-skill；另含技术博客/公众号/小红书技能
entries.note_en: Based on lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer (8 skills including init/plan/write/review), adding 5 skills (ranking analysis, teardown, batch writing, setting review, de-AI, mid/short stories) and cover generation; Fanqie publishing from amm10090/fanqie-publisher-skill; also includes tech blog/WeChat/Xiaohongshu skills

entries.name: AIStoryBuilders
entries.desc: 把小说拆成时间线、地点、人物（按时间线分段描述）和章节段落的数据结构，写每段时按其时间线、地点和出场人物取对应设定作上下文
entries.desc_en: Breaks a novel into timelines, locations, characters (described per timeline segment) and chapter paragraphs, and when writing each paragraph pulls the matching setting by its timeline, location and characters present
entries.note: C# .NET MAUI 桌面应用，另有在线版和微软商店版；需 OpenAI / Azure OpenAI Key
entries.note_en: C# .NET MAUI desktop app, also with a hosted version and a Microsoft Store version; needs an OpenAI / Azure OpenAI key

entries.name: dreampowers
entries.desc: OpenCode 中文小说技能包：14 个 skill，覆盖构思、七维文风问卷、设定文件隔离、大纲伏笔、分场景写作、冷读与一致性审查
entries.desc_en: Chinese novel skill pack for OpenCode: 14 skills covering ideation, a seven-dimension style questionnaire, isolated setting files, outline and foreshadowing, scene-by-scene writing, cold reads and consistency review
entries.note: 依赖 oh-my-openagent；成人场景技能为选装（install.sh --all 才装）
entries.note_en: Depends on oh-my-openagent; the adult-scene skill is optional (installed only with install.sh --all)

entries.name: ProseForge
entries.desc: 六席位 agent 流水线：分析→四路并行场景草稿择优→连续性/对抗/文风三审合议→定点改写；章节摘要金字塔+承诺台账+叙事 RAG 防失忆
entries.desc_en: Six-seat agent pipeline: analysis, four parallel scene drafts with best-of selection, continuity/adversarial/style review, targeted rewrite; summary pyramid, promise ledger and narrative RAG prevent amnesia
entries.note: Docker 或原生安装包本地部署，模型走 OpenAI 兼容接口；packs/ 附 80 余个题材与技法 SKILL.md
entries.note_en: Local deployment via Docker or native installer, models through an OpenAI-compatible interface; packs/ includes 80+ genre and technique SKILL.md files

entries.name: chinese-longnovel-skill
entries.desc: 中文长篇网文工作流：扫榜开书、范文拆解与文风蒸馏、每 50 章分阶段细纲、事实锁与状态仓库、伏笔追踪、双审查自动修复
entries.desc_en: Chinese long-form workflow: ranking-chart book setup, sample teardown and style distillation, detailed outline every 50 chapters, fact locks, state store, foreshadowing tracking, dual-review auto-fix
entries.note: 校验脚本需 Python 3；自然化环节内置 Humanizer-zh 规则（已注明来源）
entries.note_en: Check scripts need Python 3; the naturalization step embeds Humanizer-zh rules (source credited)

entries.name: john-paul-ruf/novel-engine
entries.desc: 七个 AI 编辑角色（故事教练、代笔、初读、发展编辑、校对等）走 15 步流程从 pitch 到出版稿，访谈作者建 Voice Profile 保持文风
entries.desc_en: Seven AI editor roles (story coach, ghostwriter, first reader, developmental editor, proofreader and others) run a 15-step flow from pitch to publishable manuscript, interviewing the author to build a Voice Profile that keeps the style
entries.note: Electron 桌面应用，AGPL；使用 Claude、Codex 或 Ollama；作者称已用其出版 10 本 Amazon 书
entries.note_en: Electron desktop app, AGPL; uses Claude, Codex or Ollama; the author says they published 10 Amazon books with it

entries.name: zenstory
entries.desc: 对话式小说工作台：路由按请求选五条流程，大纲规划师、爽点设计师、内容创作者、质量审稿人接力，超 500 字自动送审；每轮按预算注入 AI 记忆和相关文件
entries.desc_en: Conversational novel workbench: a router picks one of five flows; outline planner, payoff designer, writer, reviewer relay (auto-review above 500 characters); AI memory and files injected per budget
entries.note: MIT 可自部署，另有官方在线版 app.zenstory.ai；外部 agent 通过 npx zenstory CLI 与 skill 接入
entries.note_en: MIT, self-deployable, with an official online version at app.zenstory.ai; external agents connect via the npx zenstory CLI and skill

entries.name: book-os
entries.desc: Novel-OS：写作标准（文风、类型指南、叙事技巧）、小说层（前提、计划、决策）、稿件层（大纲、人物档案、逐场景任务）三层上下文引导 AI 写
entries.desc_en: Novel-OS: three context layers guide AI writing: standards (style, genre guides, technique), novel (premise, plan, decisions), manuscript (outline, character profiles, scene tasks)

entries.name: StoryCrafter
entries.desc: text-generation-webui 扩展：按 beat 逐段提示生成，每段可存三个版本，Future Cues 指令作用于后续段落以保持连续
entries.desc_en: text-generation-webui extension: generates passage by passage from beats, saves three versions of each passage, and applies Future Cues instructions to later passages to keep continuity
entries.note: 须装在 extensions/StoryCrafter；在作者旧扩展 BlockWriter 基础上扩展；仓库无许可证
entries.note_en: Must be installed in extensions/StoryCrafter; extends the author's earlier extension BlockWriter; repo has no license

entries.name: AI-Book-Generator
entries.desc: 浏览器端写书工具：先生成书名候选和概念（logline、前提、主题），再出带章节目的的大纲，带前文摘要逐章写作，可一键 Agent 模式跑完
entries.desc_en: Browser-based book writer: generates title candidates and a concept (logline, premise, themes), then an outline with a purpose per chapter, writes chapter by chapter with summaries of earlier text, with a one-click Agent mode to run it all
entries.note: 小说与非虚构通用；支持 OpenAI / Claude / Gemini，可生成封面
entries.note_en: Works for fiction and nonfiction; supports OpenAI / Claude / Gemini, can generate covers

entries.name: qin1473692580-ux/oh-story-claudecode
entries.desc: oh-story 派生版：扫榜拆文建模块库再写长短篇，正文落盘后过语言门、错别字门、AI 味与跨章连续性守卫，另加后台数据诊断、资料考证和发布
entries.desc_en: oh-story derivative: ranking-chart analysis and teardown build a module library; saved text passes language, typo, AI-prose and cross-chapter continuity guards, plus data diagnostics, research, publishing
entries.note: 基于 zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode，2026-08 起独立演进、不同步上游；另加 story-data-analyze、story-research、story-explore、story-release-package、story-publish 五个 skill，以及错别字门禁、新题材包、TRAE/WorkBuddy 适配
entries.note_en: Based on zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode, evolving independently and not syncing upstream since 2026-08; adds five skills (story-data-analyze, story-research, story-explore, story-release-package, story-publish), a typo gate, new genre packs and TRAE/WorkBuddy adaptation

entries.name: ai-fiction-writer
entries.desc: 十个 skill 分管拆文、大纲、角色卡、知识库与世界地图；写前查逻辑矩阵、知情边界和冻结状态防穿帮，写后 9 维去 AI 味评分并四视角审稿
entries.desc_en: Ten skills for teardown, outline, character cards, knowledge base and world map; pre-write logic matrix, knowledge-boundary and frozen-state checks, then 9-dimension de-AI score and four-viewpoint review
entries.note: README 只写了克隆仓库，需自行把「纯净版skill/」下各目录放进 agent 的 skills 目录
entries.note_en: README only says to clone the repo; you must copy the directories under "纯净版skill/" into your agent's skills directory yourself

entries.name: mythpen
entries.desc: 桌面写作应用：写作模式下 AI 按六步工作流读设定和前章，写含认知、情感、悬念等五维度的章纲，再成文、润色；另有协作共写模式
entries.desc_en: Desktop writing app: AI follows a six-step workflow reading settings and the prior chapter, writes a five-dimension chapter outline (cognition, emotion, suspense, etc.), then drafts and polishes; co-writing mode
entries.note: Tauri 桌面，数据存本地 SQLite；作者另有 Claude Code 工作流版 niyongsheng/clark-typer
entries.note_en: Tauri desktop, data in local SQLite; the author also has a Claude Code workflow version, niyongsheng/clark-typer

entries.name: The-Crucible-Writing-System-For-Claude
entries.desc: 史诗奇幻长篇插件：问卷生成 9 份规划文档，按 36 拍 Crucible 结构（任务/内火/羁绊三线交织）出章纲，逐场景写作并对照规划防幻觉，每两章自动审稿
entries.desc_en: Epic fantasy plugin: questionnaire yields 9 planning docs, a 36-beat Crucible structure (quest/inner fire/bond threads) gives chapter outlines, scenes checked against the plan, review every two chapters
entries.note: 作者自创的 Crucible 结构；Claude Code 插件市场安装；2025-12 后未更新，因结构理论独特而收；存在恶意仿冒仓库 pasteurmonga/The-Crucible-Writing-System-For-Claude，认准本仓库
entries.note_en: Crucible structure is the author's own; install via the Claude Code plugin marketplace; not updated since 2025-12, listed for its distinctive structure theory; a malicious lookalike repo pasteurmonga/The-Crucible-Writing-System-For-Claude exists, use this repo

entries.name: huihuijiangqiang/moshu
entries.desc: 长篇网文工作台：卷纲、章纲和场景卡（POV、目标、阻力、转折、钩子）配 pgvector 设定库与时间线检索生成候选正文，再过一致性守卫和自然化审查
entries.desc_en: Web novel workbench: volume/chapter outlines and scene cards (POV, goal, obstacle, turn, hook) with a pgvector setting bible and timeline retrieval, then consistency guard and naturalness review
entries.note: 自部署需 PostgreSQL/pgvector、Redis、Celery；含积分计费和漫剧分镜管理模块；有在线体验站
entries.note_en: Self-hosting needs PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis and Celery; includes credit billing and a comic-drama storyboard module; has an online demo

entries.name: fictionforge
entries.desc: 每个角色是带记忆和信念的 agent，先演出事件；导演把多视角事件线合成章节 spec 再写，逐章过禁词/AI 腔门禁，不合格就返工
entries.desc_en: Each character is an agent with memory and beliefs that plays out events first; a director merges multi-perspective event lines into a chapter spec before writing, each chapter passes banned-word and AI-tone gates, and failures are reworked
entries.note: README 首屏是从门禁里抽出的 CanonBench 长篇一致性基准（零 LLM 判定器，三档 harness 消融）；换小说只换内容包
entries.note_en: README opens with CanonBench, a long-form consistency benchmark extracted from the gates (zero-LLM judge, three-level harness ablation); switching novels only means swapping the content pack

entries.name: nest-drama
entries.desc: 从素材提炼世界观、必达/弹性剧情节点和角色三卡；角色是信息隔离的独立 agent 自主行动，舞台监督调度、监督者审人性，剧情经世界内因果收敛到节点
entries.desc_en: Extracts worldbuilding, must-hit/flexible plot nodes and character cards from source; information-isolated character agents act autonomously, converging on the nodes via in-world causality
entries.note: 纯 Python 标准库本地网页应用，需 OpenAI 兼容 API；README 推荐下载 Release zip，但仓库含完整源码；中英双语 README
entries.note_en: Pure Python stdlib local web app, needs an OpenAI-compatible API; README recommends the Release zip but the repo has full source; bilingual Chinese/English README

entries.name: Chevoink
entries.desc: 长篇小说平台：Agent 按两级路由加载 Skill，Story Compiler 按章程→承诺→场景任务→章节衔接编排写作，过连续性与人类感质量门
entries.desc_en: Long-form novel platform: the Agent loads Skills through two-level routing, and a Story Compiler orchestrates writing as charter, commitments, scene tasks, chapter transitions, passing continuity and human-feel quality gates
entries.note: 正文版本化可回滚；含书城阅读与社区；在线版按 Credits 计费，可自部署（React + PostgreSQL）
entries.note_en: Prose is versioned and revertible; includes a book-city reader and community; hosted version bills by Credits, can be self-deployed (React + PostgreSQL)

entries.name: Novel-OS
entries.desc: 架构→执笔→编辑→守卫→整理五角色流水线，结果并入持久 story_state，确定性连续性引擎先查断线与时间漂移再交 LLM 审校
entries.desc_en: Five-role pipeline of architect, writer, editor, guard, curator, with results merged into a persistent story_state; a deterministic continuity engine checks for broken threads and timeline drift before handing to the LLM reviewer
entries.note: 浏览器写作工作室 + 无头 CLI；支持各家 OpenAI 兼容模型
entries.note_en: Browser writing studio + headless CLI; supports various OpenAI-compatible models

entries.name: lightnovel-studio
entries.desc: 一句话概念依次生成世界观、角色群、章节大纲再逐章写正文，附续写、角色对话和一致性/读者体验推敲，内置中日轻小说题材
entries.desc_en: One-line concept to worldbuilding, cast and chapter outlines, then chapter prose, with continuation, character dialogue and consistency/reader-experience refinement, plus Chinese and Japanese light novel genres
entries.note: 纯前端，作品存浏览器 localStorage；支持 Gemini/Claude/OpenAI/兼容接口
entries.note_en: Pure front end, works stored in browser localStorage; supports Gemini/Claude/OpenAI/compatible endpoints

entries.name: ultimate-novel-creation-skill
entries.desc: 立项→世界观人设→滚动章节规划→单章写作；每章强制跑写后流水线：更新圣经与摘要、金手指/时间/叙事线约束检查、读者审稿、朱雀检测对策，缺步不准写下一章
entries.desc_en: Project setup, worldbuilding and characters, rolling chapter planning, chapter writing; each chapter must run a post-write pipeline (bible and summary update, golden-finger/timeline/thread checks, reader review, Zhuque countermeasures)
entries.note: 须先把 system_prompt.md 配成宿主的系统提示词，流程才会被严格执行；写后流水线内置朱雀 AIGC 检测对策
entries.note_en: You must set system_prompt.md as the host's system prompt for the flow to be enforced; the post-write pipeline includes Zhuque AIGC detection countermeasures

entries.name: novel-distiller
entries.desc: 创世蓝图→为角色蒸馏思维 SKILL.md→蒸馏参考作者文风→多智能体推演场景→撰写→8 维锚定自检，YAML 数值状态层追踪暗线，叠加番茄/起点平台规则
entries.desc_en: Blueprint, then distills each character's mind into a SKILL.md and a reference author's style, multi-agent scene simulation, drafting, 8-dimension anchored self-check; YAML numeric state tracks hidden threads, with Fanqie/Qidian rules
entries.note: Python CLI 负责组装 prompt，LLM 推理交给 Claude Code；剧情推演借用 MiroFish 多智能体模拟思路；demo 含孙悟空、刘慈欣蒸馏
entries.note_en: A Python CLI assembles prompts and Claude Code does the LLM reasoning; scene simulation borrows MiroFish's multi-agent simulation idea; demos include Sun Wukong and Liu Cixin distillations

entries.name: bloodycrownD/novel-master
entries.desc: 长篇写作 agent 工作台：世界观/人设/卷纲/章节放入虚拟文件树，目录级规则控制注入上下文的档位，只读分析/写作/资料整理多智能体分工，可派子代理
entries.desc_en: Long-form writing agent workbench: worldbuilding, characters, volume outlines and chapters in a virtual file tree, directory-level rules set how much context is injected, read-only analysis / writing / research agents can spawn sub-agents
entries.note: PolyForm Noncommercial 许可，禁止商用；桌面/安卓/CLI 三端；具体叙事方法需用户自建模板或导入 SKILL.md
entries.note_en: PolyForm Noncommercial license, commercial use prohibited; desktop / Android / CLI; the actual narrative method must come from templates you build or SKILL.md files you import

entries.name: QianBi-Novel
entries.desc: 立项→设定→总纲→世界书与正则→细纲→正文六阶段共写；世界书按锚点注入，must 契约确定性复检，终审引证验真+三票投票，新设定回写
entries.desc_en: Six-stage co-writing: setup, master outline, world book and regex, detailed outline, text; world book injected by anchors, must contract rechecked deterministically, final review checks citations by three votes, settings written back
entries.note: Windows 桌面应用（PySide6），BYOK 全本地；内置 10 套题材预设，含同人设定集导入路径
entries.note_en: Windows desktop app (PySide6), bring your own key, fully local; 10 built-in genre presets, with an import path for fan fiction setting collections

entries.name: AI-Practical-Lab/novel-writer
entries.desc: 状态机驱动的长篇 skill：构思→世界观→卷纲→章纲→逐章写，每步跑验证脚本卡关，配 YAML 角色卡、伏笔追踪、检查点回滚和修改经验积累
entries.desc_en: State-machine long-form skill: concept, worldbuilding, volume and chapter outlines, then chapter writing, each step gated by validation scripts, with YAML character cards, foreshadowing, rollback
entries.note: 也适配 Trae、Antigravity
entries.note_en: Also works with Trae and Antigravity

entries.name: flutter-novel-main
entries.desc: 按大纲→分卷规划→范围规划→章节规划→正文五级提示词逐章生成，用进度追踪文件支撑自动续写，可随机生成书名和题材
entries.desc_en: Generates chapter by chapter with five prompt levels (outline, volume, range, chapter plan, prose), a progress-tracking file for auto-continuation, random title and genre generation
entries.note: Flutter 多端；支持 OpenRouter、Ollama 等自定义接口
entries.note_en: Flutter multi-platform; supports custom endpoints such as OpenRouter and Ollama

entries.name: curvedinf/novel-writer
entries.desc: 三段脚本写长篇：先依次生成梗概、人物、场景设定、情节和标题（每步可重做、可手改 JSON），再逐章起草，最后定稿
entries.desc_en: Three-script long-form writer: generates synopsis, characters, setting, plot and title in turn (each redoable, JSON editable), then drafts chapter by chapter and finalizes
entries.note: README 极简；API Key 写在 writer.py；作者建议用 Gemini 做设定、Claude/GPT-4 写正文
entries.note_en: Minimal README; API key is written in writer.py; author suggests Gemini for setup and Claude/GPT-4 for prose

entries.name: novel-agent-studio
entries.desc: 设定作者声音后对话生成总纲、人物关系、双时间线与章纲，按场景起草，审稿回查原文核对时间/知情并局部修订，采纳正文才提取带出处的故事记忆
entries.desc_en: Sets the author's voice, then chats out outline, relationships, dual timelines and chapter outlines; reviews check time/knowledge against source, adopted text yields sourced story memory
entries.note: Electron 桌面应用，仅验证 macOS Apple Silicon；接 GLM / MiniMax；附 desktop-app/runtime/skills/novel-workflow/SKILL.md
entries.note_en: Electron desktop app, verified only on macOS Apple Silicon; connects to GLM / MiniMax; includes desktop-app/runtime/skills/novel-workflow/SKILL.md

entries.name: LLM-book-generator
entries.desc: 命令行整书生成：从选题、书名到章节大纲、分节正文和前后附文，小说会生成人物表，草稿分两遍写，scratchpad 存人物和地点
entries.desc_en: Command-line whole-book generator: topic and title to chapter outlines, section text and front/back matter; novels get a character list, two-pass drafts, and a scratchpad for characters and places
entries.note: 通用书籍生成器，也写非虚构（含 LaTeX 公式渲染）；需本地 llama.cpp server；输出 DOCX
entries.note_en: General book generator that also writes nonfiction (with LaTeX formula rendering); needs a local llama.cpp server; outputs DOCX

entries.name: AnySpark
entries.desc: 对话驱动的小说智能体：主循环按需调用图谱查证、伏笔、剧情计划、设定检索等工具，再用无历史的干净上下文写章；可拆书提炼技巧 skill，角色推演多探索选优
entries.desc_en: Dialogue-driven novel agent: main loop calls tools on demand (graph fact-check, foreshadowing, plot plan, setting retrieval), writes chapters in a clean history-free context; teardown to skills, character simulation
entries.note: Python 后端 + React 创作台 + 对话 CLI；默认接 DeepSeek；License 未声明标准协议
entries.note_en: Python backend + React studio + chat CLI; defaults to DeepSeek; no standard license declared

entries.name: StoryDaemon
entries.desc: 不预先列大纲，agent 按 story tick 循环自主规划、写场景并更新人物/地点记忆，配张力评分、目标层级、从 21 部经典小说测得的场景骨架和矛盾检测
entries.desc_en: No upfront outline: an agent loops on story ticks to plan, write scenes and update character/location memory, with tension scoring, goal hierarchy, scene skeletons measured from 21 classic novels, and contradiction detection
entries.note: 无开源许可证；默认走 Codex CLI，也可接各家 API；作者前作 EdwardAThomson/NovelWriter 是大纲先行路线
entries.note_en: No open-source license; defaults to Codex CLI but works with various APIs; the author's earlier NovelWriter (EdwardAThomson/NovelWriter) is outline-first

entries.name: wanxiangpu-loreweft
entries.desc: 长篇小说工程台：Story Plan→章节蓝图→按场景生成，世界规则/人物/伏笔/状态账本约束，并行校验+受控修订+提交门禁，15 个分工智能体
entries.desc_en: Long-form novel workbench: Story Plan, chapter blueprint, then scene generation constrained by a ledger of world rules, characters, foreshadowing and state, with parallel checks, controlled revision, commit gates and 15 specialized agents
entries.note: 主要面向 Windows 桌面（Tauri）；AGPL-3.0
entries.note_en: Mainly a Windows desktop app (Tauri); AGPL-3.0

entries.name: ai-book-writer
entries.desc: CrewAI 五角色流水线：概念→大纲→分章写作→编辑→连续性检查，小说模式导出角色圣经和时间线 JSON 供连续性校验，带流式输出和预算控制
entries.desc_en: CrewAI five-role pipeline: concept, outline, chapter writing, editing, continuity check; novel mode exports a character bible and timeline JSON for continuity checks, with streaming output and budget control
entries.note: 也做非虚构书稿；需 OpenAI/Anthropic/Google Key，部署栈较重（PostgreSQL、Redis、K8s）；账号由 ai-joon 改名而来
entries.note_en: Also handles nonfiction manuscripts; needs an OpenAI/Anthropic/Google key; heavy deployment stack (PostgreSQL, Redis, K8s); account renamed from ai-joon

entries.name: Morpheus
entries.desc: 长篇小说工作台：多 agent 分担规划、设定、连续性、文风与裁决，L1/L2/L3 记忆加开放线程装配上下文，批量生成后按修改方向重做单章
entries.desc_en: Long-form workbench: agents split planning, setting, continuity, style, adjudication; L1/L2/L3 memory plus open threads assemble context; redo single chapters by revision direction
entries.note: 默认 DeepSeek，支持 OpenAI 兼容接口；带知识图谱与轨迹回放；仓库无许可证
entries.note_en: Defaults to DeepSeek, supports OpenAI-compatible APIs; includes knowledge graph and trace replay; no license in the repo

entries.name: Novelgen
entries.desc: 面向读者的小说生成器：输入种子生成分章情节，长篇分部生成和精修，靠分层上下文与滑动窗口记忆逐章写，可对照相邻章节自动出修改意见
entries.desc_en: Reader-oriented novel generator: a seed yields chaptered plots, long works generated and refined in parts with layered context and sliding-window memory, auto revision notes against adjacent chapters
entries.note: Tauri 桌面应用；支持 LM Studio、Ollama 本地模型和 Gemini 等云端；输出韩/日/英
entries.note_en: Tauri desktop app; supports LM Studio and Ollama local models and cloud models such as Gemini; outputs Korean/Japanese/English

entries.name: craft-companion
entries.desc: 小说协作框架：从零或导入旧作建分层知识库，每章走章纲→初稿→执行层自查→评估层复核→仲裁层修订→终版，并回写知识库和检查点
entries.desc_en: Novel collaboration framework: layered knowledge base from scratch or an imported draft; each chapter goes outline, first draft, execution-layer self-check, evaluation-layer review, arbitration-layer revision, final, with write-back
entries.note: 附小说知识库 MCP 服务器和 CLI；也可在 Cherry Studio 里用
entries.note_en: Includes a novel knowledge base MCP server and CLI; also usable in Cherry Studio

entries.name: inkflow
entries.desc: 战略→滚动 5 章大纲→上下文编排→写作→双层审计→事实提取→归档的多 agent 管线，7 类真相文件管人物、伏笔、资源、信息边界，可从样章蒸馏文风
entries.desc_en: Multi-agent pipeline: rolling 5-chapter outline, context orchestration, writing, two-layer audit, fact extraction, archiving; 7 truth-file types manage characters, foreshadowing, resources, information boundaries; style from samples
entries.note: 架构和 Narcooo/inkos 高度相似（真相文件、资源账本、Plan→Compose→Write→Observe→Reflect），README 未注明来源；Python 重写，另加 Web 工作台和多书风格融合
entries.note_en: Architecture closely resembles Narcooo/inkos (truth files, resource ledger, Plan→Compose→Write→Observe→Reflect) and the README does not credit it; Python rewrite with an added web workbench and multi-book style blending

entries.name: novelIDE
entries.desc: 安卓离线网文 IDE：主 Agent 调 40 多个工具读写角色、设定、伏笔资料库，委派大纲、角色、爽点检查、水文检测、去 AI 味等子 Agent 多轮推敲
entries.desc_en: Android offline web novel IDE: a main Agent calls 40+ tools to read and write character, setting and foreshadowing libraries and delegates outline, characters, payoff checks, padding detection and de-AI to sub-agents over multiple rounds
entries.note: Flutter 源码在仓库里；仓库还夹带日志压缩包和改 hosts 的 .bat 工具脚本
entries.note_en: Flutter source is in the repo; the repo also bundles a log archive and a .bat tool script that edits hosts

entries.name: KKKenChow/ai-novel-writer
entries.desc: 全链路写长篇：世界观→人物→大纲→场景卡逐段写；按六阶段放宽大纲可见范围、过滤剧透防抢跑，章后更新伏笔台账和滚动摘要，五维评审后改写
entries.desc_en: End-to-end long-form writing: worldbuilding, characters, outline, then scene cards segment by segment; six-stage outline visibility filters spoilers, foreshadowing ledger and rolling summary per chapter, rewrite after five-dimension review
entries.note: 默认火山方舟豆包 API，也可接 OpenAI 兼容接口；能把写作技巧文章蒸馏成 skill 包按步骤注入；数据存本地 JSON
entries.note_en: Defaults to Volcano Ark Doubao API, also OpenAI-compatible; can distill writing-craft articles into a skill pack injected step by step; data stored as local JSON

entries.name: lore-weave
entries.desc: 长篇共写平台：每章自动抽取人物、地点、事件和关系进知识图谱，聊天、共写与翻译都以此为据，批评 agent 对照正史检查建议
entries.desc_en: Long-form co-writing platform: each chapter's characters, places, events and relations go into a knowledge graph for chat, co-writing and translation; a critic agent checks against canon
entries.note: 多服务自托管、体量很大；写作合成引擎仍在开发（Phase 3）；另含术语一致的多语翻译和 MMO RPG 扩展；AGPL-3.0
entries.note_en: Multi-service self-hosted and very large; the writing synthesis engine is still in development (Phase 3); also includes terminology-consistent multilingual translation and an MMO RPG extension; AGPL-3.0

entries.name: novel-bot
entries.desc: 文件系统即记忆的写作 agent：自动生成人设、世界观、角色卡、大纲等 Markdown 文件，全局记忆加章节摘要双记忆，每章写完自动更新
entries.desc_en: Writing agent where the file system is the memory: automatically generates Markdown files for characters, worldbuilding, character cards and outline, uses dual memory of global memory plus chapter summaries, and updates after each chapter

entries.name: bmad-book-builder
entries.desc: BMAD 小说模块：8 个 agent 与 17 个流程，每章后跑审稿→圣经更新→逐角色矛盾审计→主题→节奏审计链，用 TTR、句长等指标量化文风
entries.desc_en: BMAD fiction module with 8 agents and 17 workflows; after each chapter runs a review, bible update, per-character contradiction audit, theme and pacing audit chain, and quantifies style with metrics such as TTR and sentence length
entries.note: 需 BMAD 平台；主仓库在作者自建 Forgejo（git.ut0pia.org），GitHub 为 2026-01 快照
entries.note_en: Needs the BMAD platform; the main repo is on the author's self-hosted Forgejo (git.ut0pia.org), the GitHub copy is a 2026-01 snapshot

entries.name: novel-pro
entries.desc: 规划→组稿→写作→观察→结算→审计→修订七角色流水线，事实总账+快照双层真相文件，旧稿逐章接管，未结算禁续写
entries.desc_en: Seven-role pipeline (plan, assemble, write, observe, settle, audit, revise) with fact ledger plus snapshot truth files, chapter-by-chapter takeover of old drafts, no continuation before settlement
entries.note: 基于 Narcooo/inkos 的角色拆分与真相文件思路改写为 skill，新增存量接管与逐章结算（见 ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md），AGPL-3.0
entries.note_en: Adapted into a skill from the role split and truth-file ideas of Narcooo/inkos, adding existing-manuscript takeover and per-chapter settlement (see ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md); AGPL-3.0

entries.name: OpenFicM
entries.desc: 安卓本地小说 Agent：读写章节、角色、世界书与三级笔记，可委派子智能体；参考书多轮蒸馏成文风约束，并对比 AI 原稿与作者定稿学习个人文风
entries.desc_en: Android local novel agent: reads/writes chapters, characters, lorebook and notes, delegates to sub-agents; distills reference books into style constraints, learns personal style from AI draft vs final diffs
entries.note: 基于 syrizelink/OpenFic 重构的 Android 版（非官方）；首次启动从 GitHub/Hugging Face 拉取 Agent/Skill 与本地检索模型
entries.note_en: Unofficial Android rebuild of syrizelink/OpenFic; first launch pulls Agent/Skill and local retrieval models from GitHub/Hugging Face

entries.name: hongyue-creation
entries.desc: 本地桌面写作室：灵感→世界→角色→大纲/细纲→按细纲单章或批量生成正文，黄金三章、雪花法、POV、伏笔回收、去 AI 味等写法技能以 SKILL.md 渐进注入
entries.desc_en: Local desktop writing studio: inspiration→world→characters→outline→single or batch chapters; craft skills (golden first three chapters, snowflake method, de-AI) injected as SKILL.md
entries.note: Electron 应用，AI 是可关闭的增强层，也能纯手写；Agent 改稿走建议/改写/直接三档审批；AGPL-3.0，另有商业授权
entries.note_en: Electron app; AI is an optional layer and it also works for pure manual writing; Agent edits use suggest/rewrite/direct approval tiers; AGPL-3.0 with a commercial license also offered

entries.name: mimoCode-story
entries.desc: MiMo Code 版网文技能包：扫榜、拆文、大纲、正文、去 AI 味、审稿 32 个技能，加 9 重质量门禁、6 类毒点检测和 6 平台对标评分
entries.desc_en: MiMo Code edition of a web novel skill pack: 32 skills covering ranking analysis, book teardown, outline, text, de-AI and review, plus 9 quality gates, 6 kinds of reader-turnoff detection and scoring against 6 platforms
entries.note: 基于 zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode 二次开发，专为小米 MiMo Code 适配，Claude Code 用户用原版即可；一键安装是 curl | bash
entries.note_en: Derived from zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode and adapted for Xiaomi MiMo Code; Claude Code users should use the original; the one-line install is curl | bash

entries.name: novel_writer_agent
entries.desc: 本地长篇写作助手：选题→大纲和章节计划→每章经规划、生成、修订、连续性检查、体验评估、风险检查，写完更新角色、时间线、伏笔和主支线记忆
entries.desc_en: Local long-form assistant: topic, outline and chapter plan, then per chapter planning, generation, revision, continuity check, experience evaluation, risk check, afterwards updating character, timeline, foreshadowing and plotline memory
entries.note: Windows 本地运行；每章约跑 20 个流程，Token 消耗大
entries.note_en: Runs locally on Windows; about 20 steps per chapter, heavy token use

entries.name: bragi
entries.desc: 架空世界故事引擎：用数字路径管理时间树与空间树，当前节点保留全文、邻近节点只留摘要按需扩写，结合角色状态与事件记录续写剧情
entries.desc_en: Story engine for invented worlds: manages a time tree and space tree with numeric paths, keeps full text at the current node and only summaries for nearby nodes to expand on demand, continues the plot using character state and event records
entries.note: CLI + 本地 Web UI；支持 OpenAI / DeepSeek，附离线 Demo Agent
entries.note_en: CLI + local Web UI; supports OpenAI / DeepSeek, includes an offline Demo Agent

entries.name: sailoumili/novel-writer
entries.desc: 统筹队长调度世界、剧情、人物、执笔、复核 5 个子代理：先定《叙事宪法》、世界白皮书和伏笔台账再动笔，复核按三色灯打回重写
entries.desc_en: A captain agent dispatches 5 sub-agents (world, plot, characters, writing, review): sets a "Narrative Constitution", world white paper, foreshadowing ledger first; review bounces drafts
entries.note: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）预设插件，只能在 DSH 里用；章节按版本号存档，改稿不覆盖
entries.note_en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) preset plugin, usable only inside DSH; chapters archived by version number, revisions do not overwrite

entries.name: thriller
entries.desc: 悬疑推理技能包：按子类型走诡计/人物/结构先行路线，追踪人物知情状态与线索公平性（双读者验证、诺克斯检查），七维加权评分改稿，可再转成分支互动小说
entries.desc_en: Mystery skill pack: trick-, character- or structure-first route by subgenre, tracks what characters know and clue fairness (two-reader verification, Knox check), seven-dimension weighted revision, can convert to branching fiction
entries.note: 融合 McKee、Truby、Sanderson 等 25+ 方法与计算叙事论文（对抗式悬念、动态认知逻辑）；含分镜模块与自我进化（GEP）流程；README 英文、技能正文中文；2026-03 后未更新，因方法独特而收
entries.note_en: Combines 25+ methods from McKee, Truby, Sanderson and others with computational narrative papers (adversarial suspense, dynamic epistemic logic); includes a storyboard module and a self-evolution (GEP) flow; README in English, skill text in Chinese; not updated since 2026-03, included for its distinctive method

entries.name: bbroot/novel-master
entries.desc: OpenClaw 长篇小说 skill：策划书、分卷大纲与细纲、三层伏笔追踪、角色状态机与节点压缩图谱、每章四维审计
entries.desc_en: OpenClaw long-form novel skill: planning document, volume outlines and detailed outlines, three-layer foreshadowing tracking, a character state machine with node-compression graph, and a four-dimension audit of every chapter
entries.note: ClawHub 上装到的是 v1，v2 脚本需从 GitHub 获取
entries.note_en: ClawHub installs v1; the v2 scripts must be fetched from GitHub

entries.name: bookbuilder_ai
entries.desc: LangGraph 多 agent 写书：先追问需求，按激励事件、中点、高潮等结构出大纲，批评 agent 循环审稿，再出分章摘要并逐章写、逐章审
entries.desc_en: LangGraph multi-agent book writer: asks clarifying questions, outlines by structure (inciting incident, midpoint, climax), a critic agent reviews the outline in a loop, then chapter summaries and chapter-by-chapter writing and review

entries.name: novelops-skill
entries.desc: 长篇小说状态化流水线：truth files 记设定与角色认知，生成下一章工作包，LLM 起草，审计修订，状态回写，快照 diff
entries.desc_en: Stateful long-form pipeline: truth files record settings and character knowledge, generate a next-chapter work package, LLM drafts, audit and revision, state write-back, snapshot diff
entries.note: 基于 Narcooo/inkos 的思路（truth files、审计-修订-状态回写），用纯 Python 标准库重写成不绑宿主的 skill；另加角色知情边界检查、可配置审计规则、快照/diff、同人与番外的 canon 处理。draft 默认调用本地 Ollama。SKILL.md 以英文为主
entries.note_en: Rewritten as a host-agnostic skill in pure Python stdlib from the ideas of Narcooo/inkos (truth files, audit-revise-state write-back); adds character knowledge-boundary checks, configurable audit rules, snapshots/diff and canon handling for fan fiction and side stories. Draft defaults to local Ollama. SKILL.md is mostly in English

entries.name: Project-Wannabe
entries.desc: 配合小说微调模型 wanabi：先生成标题/梗概/设定/情节转入详情栏，再按「下一段展开指示」反复出候选卡片，人挑选插入正文
entries.desc_en: Companion to fine-tuned novel model wanabi: generates title/synopsis/setting/plot, then offers candidate cards from a "next-paragraph direction" for you to pick and insert
entries.note: 需本地 KoboldCpp 加载 wanabi 系列 GGUF 小说模型（含 Gemma 4 31B 版）；Windows 桌面应用
entries.note_en: Needs local KoboldCpp loading the wanabi GGUF novel models (including a Gemma 4 31B version); Windows desktop app

entries.name: OpenNovel
entries.desc: LangGraph 多 agent：类型研究、故事架构、冲突设计出大纲，写作→编辑→审稿（含 AI 痕迹检测）不过即重写，ChromaDB 存章节摘要和角色状态
entries.desc_en: LangGraph multi-agent: genre research, story architecture and conflict design produce the outline; write, edit, review (with AI-trace detection) loops until it passes, with ChromaDB storing chapter summaries and character state
entries.note: 依赖 Claude Code CLI 登录；可用浏览器自动化发布到番茄小说
entries.note_en: Depends on a Claude Code CLI login; can publish to Fanqie Novel via browser automation

entries.name: waqupin
entries.desc: VS Code 网文插件：全局/项目/章节分层记忆检索注入，人物档案记录章前章后状态，伏笔埋收追踪，节奏评级，作家风格模板精修
entries.desc_en: VS Code web novel plugin: layered global/project/chapter memory retrieval and injection, character profiles recording before- and after-chapter state, foreshadowing tracking, pacing ratings, writer style templates for refinement
entries.note: 开源的是核心层升级前的旧版代码，含激活码校验
entries.note_en: The open-sourced code is the old version from before the core layer upgrade, and includes activation code verification

entries.desc: 终端/网页里写分支小说：每段保留多个生成版本组成故事树，Facts 按故事线锚定状态注入上下文，摘要节点压缩前文作为上下文重置
entries.desc_en: Writes branching fiction in a terminal or browser: each passage keeps multiple generated versions as a story tree, Facts anchored to storylines are injected into context, and summary nodes compress earlier text as a context reset
entries.note: 也可纯人工写；可接本地或云端模型，支持导入 SillyTavern 角色卡与 NovelAI 生成配置
entries.note_en: Can also be used for purely manual writing; works with local or cloud models; imports SillyTavern character cards and NovelAI generation settings

entries.name: dsh-cuigengji-plugin
entries.desc: DSH 小说工作台：按卷章写正文，角色卡/世界书/关系图和节点式情节规划图作为 AI 可查可改的案头资料，按需检索后讨论、续写、改稿
entries.desc_en: DSH novel workbench: writes by volume and chapter, with character cards, world book, relationship graph and a node-based plot planning graph as reference material the AI can query and edit, retrieved on demand
entries.note: DeepSeek Harness 插件，主要适配 DSH Windows 桌面版；可导入酒馆角色卡、世界书与提示词预设
entries.note_en: DeepSeek Harness plugin, mainly for the DSH Windows desktop version; can import Tavern character cards, world books and prompt presets

entries.name: ElyHa
entries.desc: 图结构长篇写作：节点和边管理分支剧情，Planner→Writer→Reviewer→Synthesizer 写章并查设定一致性，AI 以幽灵节点提案、人工采纳
entries.desc_en: Graph-structured long-form writing: nodes and edges manage branching plots, Planner→Writer→Reviewer→Synthesizer write chapters and check setting consistency, AI proposes ghost nodes for approval
entries.note: Web GUI + TUI，界面中英日；GitHub 识别为 AGPL-3.0（README 写 GPLv3）；仓库提交了 .venv-win 目录
entries.note_en: Web GUI + TUI, UI in Chinese/English/Japanese; GitHub detects AGPL-3.0 (README says GPLv3); repo has a committed .venv-win directory

entries.name: lshu-novel-generator
entries.desc: 长篇小说工作台：规划→写手→审计→修订四 Agent 写章并查 OOC 和 AI 痕迹，Truth File+RAG 管设定，可从参考书提炼写作 Skills
entries.desc_en: Long-form workbench: planner, writer, auditor, reviser agents write chapters and check OOC and AI traces, Truth File + RAG manage settings, writing Skills distilled from reference books
entries.note: Truth File 机制与 InkOS 类似；与 XiaoJiuAI/lingshu 同叫「灵枢」，但不是同一项目
entries.note_en: Truth File mechanism is similar to InkOS; shares the name Lingshu (灵枢) with XiaoJiuAI/lingshu but is a different project

entries.name: open-skoob
entries.desc: 网文多智能体工作室：意图卡→世界观→大纲→卷→章六步开书，每章规划→编排→执笔→审校→修订→结算六师接力；八师逆向拆书建图谱，写前可多轮仿真推演
entries.desc_en: Multi-agent web novel studio: six-step book setup (intent card, worldbuilding, outline, volume, chapter), six roles per chapter (plan, orchestrate, write, review, revise, settle); eight roles tear books into a graph, pre-write simulation
entries.note: README 引导去 gaotk.com 中转站建 Key，拆书/仿真/检测等引擎走官方云端 API；许可证 NOASSERTION，另附商业许可；含同人支线与互动影游模式
entries.note_en: README directs you to the gaotk.com relay to create a key; teardown / simulation / detection engines use the official cloud API; license NOASSERTION with a separate commercial license; includes fan-fiction side line and interactive film-game mode

entries.name: vibe-noveling
entries.desc: Claude Code 网文插件：苏格拉底式设定讨论、救猫咪全书规划、雪花法事件卡、写后 AI 味检测、标记返修、知识图谱
entries.desc_en: Claude Code web novel plugin: Socratic setting discussion, Save the Cat whole-book planning, snowflake-method event cards, post-write AI-tone detection, marked rework, and a knowledge graph
entries.note: 针对 GLM-5 调优，作者要求关闭思考模式；默认风格基线是男频爽文
entries.note_en: Tuned for GLM-5, the author asks you to turn off thinking mode; default style baseline is male-oriented power-fantasy web novels

entries.name: xiami
entries.desc: 长篇逐章流水线：世界观/总纲/细纲/人物卡/伏笔库/剧情账本约束连续性，每章推演→主笔→门禁→定向修复→账本结算，另有情绪钩子排布与读者速读模型
entries.desc_en: Chapter-by-chapter pipeline: worldbuilding, outlines, character cards, foreshadowing bank and plot ledger constrain continuity; each chapter runs simulate→write→gate→targeted fix→ledger settle
entries.note: Tauri 桌面应用，API Key 存 Windows 凭据管理器，主要面向 Windows；兼容任意 OpenAI 接口；仓库未声明许可证
entries.note_en: Tauri desktop app, API key stored in Windows Credential Manager, mainly for Windows; works with any OpenAI-compatible API; no license declared

entries.name: fiction-forge
entries.desc: Claude Code 通过 MCP 设定库按章节查人物已知信息；冷读协议带状态账本找连续性错误；按目标语料量化文风画像，扫描器防 AI 腔回潮
entries.desc_en: Claude Code looks up what each character knows by chapter via an MCP setting bible; a cold-read protocol with a state ledger finds continuity errors; style profiles from a target corpus, scanner blocks AI-sounding prose creeping back
entries.note: 总结自作者写完约 29 万字小说的经验；另含 EPUB/PDF 发布和 DALL-E 插图脚本
entries.note_en: Distilled from the author's experience finishing a roughly 290,000-character novel; also includes EPUB/PDF publishing and DALL-E illustration scripts

entries.name: Jackn0/novel_agent
entries.desc: Next.js 写作助手：小说预设→大纲→章纲→小节列表→正文五阶段，每阶段 AI 起稿用户审定，追踪人物状态和伏笔，五档记忆等级，可导入旧作续写
entries.desc_en: Next.js writing assistant in five stages (novel preset, outline, chapter outline, section list, text): AI drafts each stage, user approves, tracks character state and foreshadowing, five memory levels, imports existing work to continue
entries.note: 附多角色有声书制作（Edge TTS / 百度 TTS）；支持 Claude 和 OpenAI 兼容接口
entries.note_en: Also makes multi-voice audiobooks (Edge TTS / Baidu TTS); supports Claude and OpenAI-compatible interfaces

entries.name: MortalAINovel-AIWritingSystem-ai-
entries.desc: 本地桌面写作软件：按书/卷/章管理，AI 续写、润色和风格模仿；角色档案可一键生成关系图谱，拆书知识库分析范文「文笔DNA」供仿写
entries.desc_en: Local desktop app managing books by volume/chapter with AI continuation, polish, style imitation; character profiles give relationship graphs, book teardown extracts "prose DNA"
entries.note: Releases 提供 Windows exe，源码可用 Streamlit 直接运行
entries.note_en: Releases provide a Windows exe; source runs directly with Streamlit

entries.name: openclaw-novel-writer-skill
entries.desc: OpenClaw 网文 skill：读全局大纲写七模块章纲并确认，结合写作指南和读者反馈列要点后写正文，15 项自检，读者反馈回写指南
entries.desc_en: OpenClaw web novel skill: reads the global outline, writes a seven-module chapter outline for confirmation, drafts from a writing guide and reader feedback, 15 self-checks, feedback written back to the guide
entries.note: 每章自动提交 GitHub，需配置 GitHub Token
entries.note_en: Auto-commits to GitHub every chapter; needs a GitHub token

entries.name: speckit-preset-fiction-book-writing
entries.desc: 把 Spec Kit 规格驱动流程改成写小说：故事简报→结构计划（多种情节框架）→逐场景写作任务，26 个命令覆盖构思到投稿，支持多视角与文风样本
entries.desc_en: Recasts Spec Kit's spec-driven flow for novels: story brief→structure plan (several plot frameworks)→scene-level tasks, 26 commands from ideation to submission, multi-POV, style samples
entries.note: 需 GitHub Spec Kit ≥0.5.0；文风有作者样本或 humanized-ai 两种模式；可导出 DOCX/EPUB/LaTeX
entries.note_en: Requires GitHub Spec Kit >= 0.5.0; style comes from author samples or a humanized-ai mode; exports DOCX/EPUB/LaTeX

entries.name: OpenNovelWriter
entries.desc: 类 Novelcrafter 的写作应用：章节、大纲、术语、摘要投影成文件交给 Codex 会话，靠 story-state 与上下文检索 skill 管上下文
entries.desc_en: Novelcrafter-style writing app that projects chapters, outline, glossary and summaries into files for a Codex session, managing context with story-state and context-retrieval skills
entries.note: 依赖本机 Codex CLI；作者提示 Codex 有本地写权限、可能改删稿件，只建议自托管自用；AGPL-3.0
entries.note_en: Depends on a local Codex CLI; the author warns Codex has local write access and may edit or delete manuscripts, so self-host for personal use only; AGPL-3.0

entries.name: siweina/dsh-novel-writer
entries.desc: 写前一次取齐承接口、细纲、人物卡、待回收伏笔、用语禁词等 16 项材料，写后按六维文笔基线对照原著自检，排出带行号的改稿待办
entries.desc_en: Before writing, gathers 16 items at once (handoff point, detailed outline, character cards, pending foreshadowing, banned phrases and more); after writing, self-checks against a six-dimension prose baseline and lists line-numbered todos
entries.note: DSH 插件，也可作 MCP 服务器；随包附 24MB 中文 ONNX 模型本地推理；工具本身不代写，正文由 agent 执笔
entries.note_en: DSH plugin, also usable as an MCP server; ships a 24MB Chinese ONNX model for local inference; the tool does not write for you, the agent writes the text

entries.name: write-chinese-long-screenplay
entries.desc: 中文长篇小说/剧本状态 harness：人物、能力、资源与作者政策存为正典，每章先组装章纲与写前状态，候选正文附状态变更，过检查才落盘
entries.desc_en: State harness for Chinese long-form fiction/scripts: characters, abilities, resources and author policy kept as canon; candidate text carries state changes, saved only after checks pass

entries.name: xt-webnovel-writing
entries.desc: 拆参考文本→立书→八步节奏剧情→爽点与四层文笔改写→结构 10 项加反 AI 味 25 项双路体检，命中回滚级硬门就退回重写；写前读、写后存磁盘记忆
entries.desc_en: Reference-text teardown, book setup, eight-step pacing plot, payoff beats and four-layer prose rewrite, then a dual-path check (10 structure, 25 anti-AI items); rollback-level hard-gate hits force rewrite; reads memory before, saves after
entries.note: 方法论底本是一篇知乎文章，仓库内存档了全文；仓库没有许可证
entries.note_en: Methodology is based on a Zhihu article, archived in full in the repo; the repo has no license

entries.name: book-writer-skill
entries.desc: 英文长篇写作：Story Forge 开书问答，Book Memory Bank 自动维护人物/世界/进度，含节奏蓝图、专项修订与简介/query letter
entries.desc_en: English long-form writing: Story Forge book-setup Q&A, a Book Memory Bank auto-maintaining characters, world and progress, pacing blueprints, targeted revisions, synopsis and query letter

entries.name: ldblckrs-258/novel-studio
entries.desc: 越南语写作工作台：章节→全书→人物三阶段分析，六步自动写作（上下文→方向→大纲→写手→审稿→重写），另含中译越翻译、TTS 与爬虫导入
entries.desc_en: Vietnamese workbench: chapter→book→character analysis, six-step auto writing (context→direction→outline→writer→review→rewrite), plus Chinese-to-Vietnamese translation, TTS, crawler import
entries.note: 界面与提示词为越南语（lang 无对应项，暂填 multi）；数据存浏览器 IndexedDB；工具重心偏翻译
entries.note_en: UI and prompts are Vietnamese (no matching lang value, filled as multi); data stored in browser IndexedDB; the tool leans toward translation

entries.name: Muses
entries.desc: GPT-3 长篇续写脚本：每场景依据上一场景、人物表、滚动摘要和随机情节队列生成，三选一取最长后补感官细节，再更新人物和摘要
entries.desc_en: GPT-3 long-form continuation script: each scene generated from the previous scene, character list, rolling summary and random plot queue; picks the longest of three, adds sensory detail, updates summary
entries.note: 基于 GPT-3 / NLP Cloud 旧接口；可设定不会死亡的主角
entries.note_en: Based on the legacy GPT-3 / NLP Cloud interface; can set a protagonist who never dies

entries.name: NovelWritingAgent
entries.desc: 多 agent 写小说：先生成并收敛设定 canon，章节写→审→改，评审团并行打分再由总评汇总，修订经 canon_patch 反写设定，长期记忆分级检索
entries.desc_en: Multi-agent novel writer: converges a setting canon, then write-review-revise per chapter, a review panel scores in parallel and a chief reviewer aggregates, revisions write back via canon_patch, long-term memory retrieved by tier
entries.note: 各 agent 提示词以 SKILL.md 形式放在包内；有不调模型的骨架调试模式
entries.note_en: Each agent's prompt is packaged as SKILL.md; has a skeleton debug mode that does not call a model

entries.name: webfiction-write
entries.desc: 融合 oh-story 与 webnovel-writer：每章先定读者情绪再写，细纲不足即阻断，提交时写回状态，独立审查未完成标 unverified
entries.desc_en: Merges oh-story and webnovel-writer: decide the reader's emotion before each chapter, block when the detailed outline is thin, write state back on commit, and mark unfinished independent review as unverified
entries.note: 基于 zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode 与 lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer 融合，另加 fiction.py（初始化、章节提交、审查指标、导出）和正文检查脚本；需 Python 3.8+
entries.note_en: Merged from zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode and lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer, adding fiction.py (init, chapter commit, review metrics, export) and a prose check script; needs Python 3.8+

entries.name: WorldScript-Studio
entries.desc: 本地优先的小说/剧本写作工作室：大纲生成器可把结构化提纲写进稿件，配人物与世界档案、故事圣经、节拍表，AI 可续写、生成对白与梗概
entries.desc_en: Local-first novel / screenplay writing studio: an outline generator can write structured outlines into the manuscript, with character and world profiles, story bible and beat sheets; AI can continue text and generate dialogue and synopses
entries.note: 以人写稿为主，AI 为可选能力（云端 BYOK、浏览器本地模型或 Ollama）；PWA + Tauri 桌面版
entries.note_en: Mainly human-written with AI optional (cloud BYOK, in-browser local models or Ollama); PWA + Tauri desktop

entries.name: arcvellum
entries.desc: 本地长篇创作工作室：项目 Agent 接长期目标交后台推进；每个场景作为事务，主创定意图并向角色续演、描写器取候选，经审查修订后提交并写回人物与 Canon
entries.desc_en: Local long-form studio: a project Agent advances long-term goals in the background; each scene is a transaction (lead author sets intent, characters play on, a describer offers candidates), committed after review and written back to Canon
entries.note: Windows 安装包 + 完整源码，Beta；也支持剧本与伪纪录体；作者自述多题材长篇稳定性仍待验证；需自配模型
entries.note_en: Windows installer plus full source, Beta; also supports scripts and mockumentary style; the author says stability on long multi-genre works is still unverified; bring your own model

entries.name: DAWO
entries.desc: 长篇网文桌面软件：一句话建书→设定集→分卷大纲→逐章生文，按卷和出场裁剪注入大纲与角色卡，悬置伏笔作硬约束注入，配六维去 AI 味打分
entries.desc_en: Desktop long-form web novel app: one-line book creation, setting bible, volume outlines, chapter generation, outline and character cards trimmed by volume and appearance, pending foreshadowing as hard constraints, six-dimension de-AI score
entries.note: 仓库未附开源许可证（README 称暂未开源授权）；含 15 个提案制智能体、拆书与朱雀对抗手册；Windows 安装包未签名
entries.note_en: No open-source license in the repo (README says not yet licensed); includes 15 proposal-based agents, book teardown and a Zhuque AI detector countermeasure handbook; Windows installer is unsigned

entries.name: dsh-novel-forge
entries.desc: 代码硬约束长篇：九阶段状态机，细纲未批不许写章，事实账本冲突拒存，写前按预算组装简报，重复句段机审、六维去 AI 味扫描、场景契约防泄底
entries.desc_en: Code-enforced long-form writing: nine-stage state machine blocks chapters until the outline is approved, rejects conflicting facts, budgeted pre-write brief, repeated-passage checks, six-dimension de-AI scan, scene contracts vs spoilers
entries.note: DeepSeek Harness 插件（20 个 novel_* 工具），另附 MCP 目录
entries.note_en: DeepSeek Harness plugin (20 novel_* tools), plus an MCP directory

entries.name: Generating-Long-form-Story-Using-Dynamic-Hierarchical-Outlining-with-Memory-Enhancement
entries.desc: 论文 DOME 的代码：先出粗大纲，写作中动态细化分层大纲，用 neo4j 知识图谱记忆检测并消解前后矛盾，生成长篇故事
entries.desc_en: Code for the DOME paper: rough outline refined dynamically into a hierarchical outline while writing, with neo4j knowledge-graph memory to detect and resolve continuity errors
entries.note: 输入数据沿用 DOC/Re3；需自建 neo4j 和 OpenAI 兼容接口
entries.note_en: Input data follows DOC/Re3; you must set up neo4j and an OpenAI-compatible API yourself

entries.name: inyhow/ai-novel-generator
entries.desc: 网文 Web 应用 + SKILL.md：5 问确认题材、主角缺陷、冲突、节奏和篇幅，出总纲与角色弧线，逐章写并补悬念钩子，每 5 章查连贯，最后去 AI 味
entries.desc_en: Web novel app + SKILL.md: 5 questions fix genre, protagonist flaw, conflict, pacing, length; master outline, chapters with suspense hooks, coherence check every 5 chapters, then de-AI
entries.note: 根目录 SKILL.md 可单独当 skill 用；应用附番茄小说 CDP 自动发布和敏感词检测
entries.note_en: The root SKILL.md can be used alone as a skill; the app includes Fanqie Novel CDP auto-publishing and sensitive-word detection

entries.name: novel-flow-one-by-one
entries.desc: 6 个协作 skill：脑暴→大纲→逐场景写作→六维审稿→设定同步，总控按状态路由，内置冷白描/系统爽文/怪诞悬疑三种文风
entries.desc_en: 6 collaborating skills: brainstorm, outline, scene-by-scene writing, six-dimension review, setting sync; a controller routes by state, with three built-in styles (cold plain description, system-flow web novel, grotesque suspense)
entries.note: README 以 Trae 目录结构为例
entries.note_en: README uses a Trae directory structure as the example

entries.name: StoryBox
entries.desc: 沙盒中让多个角色 agent 自下而上互动产生事件，再结合自上而下的叙事规划把模拟结果组织成长篇故事（AAAI 2026 论文代码）
entries.desc_en: Character agents interact bottom-up in a sandbox to produce events, which top-down narrative planning organizes into a long-form story (code for the AAAI 2026 paper)
entries.note: 需 OpenAI API；代码目录沿用 Generative Agents 的 reverie 沙盒结构
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI API; code directory reuses the Generative Agents reverie sandbox layout

entries.name: XZZKANY/StoryForge
entries.desc: 长篇小说桌面 IDE：Agent 用只读工具跨文件取证，做多视角审稿并产出修订补丁，作者看 diff 决定写回；配 canon 防漂移、一致性扫描和逐章生成
entries.desc_en: Long-form desktop IDE: the Agent gathers evidence across files with read-only tools, does multi-perspective review and produces revision patches, the author reads the diff and decides what to write back; canon drift prevention, scans
entries.note: 作者自述仍在自用阶段，30 章长程生成人工通读未通过；本地需 Docker 起 Postgres/Redis/MinIO
entries.note_en: The author says it is still in personal use and a manual read-through of 30-chapter long-run generation did not pass; locally needs Docker for Postgres/Redis/MinIO

entries.name: 302_novel_writing
entries.desc: 网页小说写作工具：填书名、作者和简介建书，AI 先生成章节剧情规划再写章节正文，可选现代/古风/奇幻等文风，也能全自动写完整本
entries.desc_en: Web novel writing tool: create a book from title, author and synopsis, the AI drafts a chapter plot plan before writing chapter text, with selectable styles (modern, ancient-style, fantasy), or writes a whole book automatically
entries.note: 302.AI 在线产品的开源版，需 302.AI API；界面中英日三语
