entries.note_en: Core idea is positive injection instead of banned-word lists for de-AI; graph database mode needs a roughly 30MB axolotl graph library, macOS recommended; includes an error-case library and machine-check scripts; repo has no license

entries.name: kapaiverki
entries.desc: 用卡牌组合主题、类型、角色、情节和世界观灵感卡，按可改的雪花写作法模板生成小说大纲；另有四阶段角色塑造工坊和情节/角色专家对话
entries.desc_en: Combines theme, genre, character, plot and worldbuilding inspiration cards into a novel outline via an editable Snowflake Method template; also a four-stage character-building workshop and plot/character expert chat
entries.note: 只出大纲，不写正文
entries.note_en: Outline only, does not write prose

entries.name: leehong0704/ai-novel
entries.desc: 设定→章纲→正文，正文中插【标记】让 AI 只重写标记处；定稿时自动抽取人物变化同步角色卡，并增量更新全书梗概和近三章回顾
entries.desc_en: Setting, chapter outline, prose; insert [markers] so the AI rewrites only marked parts; finalizing extracts character changes to sync cards and updates the book synopsis and recent-chapter recap
entries.note: Python 桌面应用，支持 DeepSeek/OpenAI/Gemini；仓库另附 Windows 打包 zip（release/ai-novel.zip），源码完整
entries.note_en: Python desktop app, supports DeepSeek/OpenAI/Gemini; repo also includes a Windows zip (release/ai-novel.zip), full source available

entries.name: novel-creation-skill
entries.desc: 中文长篇/同人 skill：提取原著资料、头脑风暴定设定和人物卡，按题材模板和三/五/六幕结构推进，读者欲望驱动、桥接情节过渡，带自检和上下文管理
entries.desc_en: Chinese long-form/fan fiction skill: extracts source material, brainstorms settings and character cards, follows genre templates and three/five/six-act structure, reader-desire driven, with self-checks
entries.note: 为 Trae SOLO Web 优化，需智能体有联网搜索和内容提取能力；对同人支持最好
entries.note_en: Optimized for Trae SOLO Web; the agent needs web search and content extraction; best support for fan fiction

entries.name: novel-writer-skill
entries.desc: 中英双语小说写作 skill：构思、人设、章纲、逐章写作与章节衔接检查、去 AI 味，附草稿量化体检脚本和 11 套追踪模板
entries.desc_en: Bilingual Chinese/English novel writing skill: ideation, characters, chapter outlines, chapter-by-chapter writing with continuity checks, de-AI, plus a draft quantitative checkup script and 11 tracking templates
entries.note: 另附 ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Gemini 等网页端的系统提示词用法
entries.note_en: Also documents system-prompt usage on web UIs such as ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Gemini

entries.name: NovelizeAI
entries.desc: Gemini 长篇写作应用：按类型、视角、语调等修饰项分三阶段出概念、人物设定和情节大纲，再逐章生成，根据评审反馈迭代
entries.desc_en: Gemini long-form writing app: three stages produce concept, character profiles and plot outline from modifiers (genre, POV, tone), then chapter-by-chapter generation iterated on review feedback
entries.note: 源自作者早期的 Wordware 版 para-droid-ai/novella-xl-15；需 Gemini API
entries.note_en: Derived from the author's earlier Wordware version para-droid-ai/novella-xl-15; needs a Gemini API

entries.name: vicalloy/novel-skills
entries.desc: 长篇小说 skill：用树形 Markdown 摘要（总纲加章节摘要、角色小传、世界观设定）承载剧情，每章写完强制更新相关摘要，写前一次性加载
entries.desc_en: Long-form novel skill carrying the plot in tree-shaped Markdown summaries (master outline, chapter summaries, character bios, worldbuilding), forcing a summary update after each chapter and loading all of it before writing
entries.note: 与作者的 Sequoia 项目深度绑定（摘要加载工具在那边）；附一部写到一半的 AI 小说作样例
entries.note_en: Tightly tied to the author's Sequoia project (the summary-loading tool is there); includes a half-written AI novel as a sample

entries.name: AI_novelsTool_obsdian
entries.desc: PyQt 桌面写作台：大纲师、码字工、督察、评论家等 12 个智能体分工，7 模块记忆追踪角色状态、钩子与大事记，配拆书分析和批评师审稿
entries.desc_en: PyQt desktop writing studio: 12 agents (outliner, drafter, inspector, critic and others) divide the work, 7-module memory tracks character states, hooks and timeline events, with book teardown analysis and a critic that reviews drafts
entries.note: 内置约 49 个网文 skills（103 个 SKILL.md），据作者说明部分整合自 GitHub 其他项目；无 License；需自带 API
entries.note_en: Bundles about 49 web novel skills (103 SKILL.md files), partly integrated from other GitHub projects per the author; no license; bring your own API

entries.name: dsh-novel-craft
entries.desc: 口味校准：作者对候选稿逐段点赞/点踩，模型提炼成几百字节偏好档案注入写稿；每章先列多种场景决策方向再分篇写，批注只改被标段落
entries.desc_en: Taste calibration: the author likes/dislikes passages per paragraph, the model distills a tiny preference profile (a few hundred bytes) for drafting; chapters list scene-decision directions first; annotations revise only marked text
entries.note: DeepSeek Harness 插件，需 Node 22；写稿上下文只放规律、不放已写正文
entries.note_en: DeepSeek Harness plugin, needs Node 22; the drafting context holds only patterns, not already-written prose

entries.name: dsh-novel-writing
entries.desc: 29 个 skill 的网文流水线：协调者统筹选题、大纲、细纲，按看护包生成正文并九维审查，代码门禁拒存离纲章节，再按发布数据回调写作方向
entries.desc_en: 29-skill web novel pipeline: coordinator oversees topic and outlines, drafts from a supervision pack with nine-dimension review, code gates reject off-outline chapters, publishing data steers direction
entries.note: 基于同作者 peterwangze/claude-writing-workflow 迁移到 DeepSeek Harness；默认人类主笔、AI 出草稿参考，高 AI 参与度会阻断上架；仓库未声明许可证
entries.note_en: Migrated to DeepSeek Harness from the same author's peterwangze/claude-writing-workflow; defaults to a human lead writer with AI drafts as reference, high AI involvement blocks listing; no license declared

entries.name: LLMWriter
entries.desc: RAG 长篇写作：世界观圣经、角色卡、阶段摘要、近三章记忆、上章结尾五层上下文，按写作计划多路检索 Qdrant，每章写完抽取事件/事实/关系/伏笔入库
entries.desc_en: RAG long-form writing: five context layers (worldbuilding bible, character cards, stage summaries, last three chapters, previous chapter ending), multi-route Qdrant retrieval by writing plan, events/facts/foreshadowing extracted per chapter
entries.note: 默认 Qwen-Plus；未声明许可证
entries.note_en: Defaults to Qwen-Plus; no license declared

entries.name: novel-creation-omnibus
entries.desc: 55 个按需加载模块的写作 skill：类型模板（规则怪谈、番茄爆文等）、开篇钩子、L1–L4 去 AI 门禁、五专家并行审计与 11 维评分，带技能自进化循环
entries.desc_en: 55-module on-demand writing skill: genre templates, opening hooks, L1-L4 de-AI gates, five-expert parallel audit with 11-dimension scoring, and a skill self-evolution loop
entries.note: 覆盖长篇网文到短篇；模块与自进化指标数量庞大、术语堆砌，实际效果需自测
entries.note_en: Covers long web novels to short stories; the large number of modules and self-evolution metrics is jargon-heavy, so test the real effect yourself

entries.name: Novel-factory
entries.desc: 多智能体+确定性编排：卷→弧→段→章四层规划，角色/物品/势力三账本须附正文引证校验，伏笔排期状态机，异族模型候选盲评，禁泄扫描与 26 项批末体检
entries.desc_en: Multi-agent with deterministic orchestration: four-level planning, character/item/faction ledgers needing text citations, foreshadowing state machine, blind candidate evaluation, spoiler scan, 26-item checkup
entries.note: Java 17 / Spring AI；Qdrant 向量增强可选；ChatGPT 套餐授权通道为实验性功能
entries.note_en: Java 17 / Spring AI; Qdrant vector enhancement optional; ChatGPT subscription authorization channel is experimental

entries.name: Novel-IDE
entries.desc: Tauri 长篇写作 IDE：AI 续写/改写/规划，Planner 拆任务执行，改稿默认先出审阅建议逐条采纳，自动维护角色状态与伏笔索引并可手工锁定
entries.desc_en: Tauri long-form writing IDE with AI continuation/rewrite/planning; a Planner splits tasks, edits default to suggestions accepted one by one, character state and foreshadowing index lockable

entries.name: snowflake-writer
entries.desc: 雪花写作法 10 步 skill：一句话→五句结构→人物表→一页梗概→四页大纲→场景表→场景结构→成文，分给 5 个 agent 人格，附文风 RAG
entries.desc_en: 10-step snowflake-method skill: one sentence→five-sentence structure→character sheet→synopsis→four-page outline→scene list→scene structure→prose, 5 agent personas, style RAG

entries.name: ty-xiaoshuo-skill
entries.desc: 网文八道工序 skill：创作前检查→细纲→正文→四轨质检→跨章节奏审→更新设定库→前情摘要→阶段回顾，五维评分不达标重写，情节类型轮换防公式化
entries.desc_en: Eight-step web novel skill: pre-writing check, detailed outline, prose, four-track QA, cross-chapter pacing review, setting-bible update, recap, stage review; rewrites if the five-dimension score fails, rotates plot types to avoid formula
entries.note: 质检含去 AI 味；附番茄平台策略和修仙、萌娃题材模板；README 写 MIT 但无许可证文件
entries.note_en: QA includes de-AI; ships Fanqie platform strategy and xianxia / cute-kid genre templates; README says MIT but there is no license file

entries.name: xiaoshuo-studio
entries.desc: 长篇工作台+skill 包：问答建书向导生成 canon 与首章 brief，导入参考小说做风格卡，逐章规划→起草→连续性检查→回写 canon→去 AI 味
entries.desc_en: Long-form workbench plus skill pack: Q&A wizard builds canon and a first-chapter brief, reference novels become style cards, then per chapter plan, draft, continuity check, canon write-back, de-AI
entries.note: Web 工作台依赖本地已登录的 Codex CLI；风格学习强调学技法、不克隆作者声线
entries.note_en: Web workbench depends on a locally logged-in Codex CLI; style learning stresses learning technique, not cloning an author's voice

entries.name: AI-Web-Novel-Assistant
entries.desc: PyQt6 网文桌面工具：全局梗概、人物卡、卷梗概、章细纲分层设定，按细纲加前文逐章写，挂机模式自动补全卷章写完全书，一键修复查人名错误和吃书
entries.desc_en: PyQt6 web novel desktop tool: layered settings (global synopsis, character cards, volume synopses, chapter outlines), chapter writing from outline plus earlier text, unattended full-book mode, one-click name and continuity fixes

entries.note_en: Defaults to DeepSeek-Reasoner, OpenAI-compatible; example/ includes two generated sample novels (docx)

entries.name: AuctorForge

entries.name: AutoWrite

entries.desc_en: Rust/Tauri desktop writing app: generates worldbuilding, characters and a chapter outline first, then writes each chapter with three layers of prompts, can illustrate content and export in multiple formats
entries.note: README 很简略；需 DeepSeek API，配图用魔搭 Z-Image
entries.note_en: README is very brief; needs a DeepSeek API, illustrations use ModelScope Z-Image

entries.name: Dylin-code/NovelGenerator
entries.desc: 两段式 skill：资深编辑七段访谈产出 bible（含三幕结构、人物 want/need），再出大纲，每章跑写手→评论家→修订者子代理最多两轮
entries.desc_en: Two-stage skill: a seven-part editor interview produces a bible (three acts, character want/need), then an outline; each chapter runs writer→critic→reviser subagents, up to two rounds
entries.note: 写手和修订者默认走本地 LM Studio，评论家用 Claude；繁体中文
entries.note_en: Writer and reviser default to local LM Studio, critic uses Claude; Traditional Chinese

entries.name: huxiuzhi-novel-agent

entries.note_en: Core rules live in a platform-neutral AGENT.md; SKILL.md / CLAUDE.md are just entry points

entries.name: museflow

entries.name: Novel-framework

entries.name: novel-smith

entries.desc_en: Local long-form workshop: 11-step dialogue builds the world, character cards and world book extracted per chapter, layered memory (recent full text, summaries, compressed history), 15-dimension book teardown, local AI-prose detection
entries.note: Next.js + 本地 SQLite；去 AI 味检测可离线、无需 API Key
entries.note_en: Next.js + local SQLite; the de-AI detection works offline without an API key

entries.name: novel-writer-master
entries.desc: 小说伴写工具：Story Bible 管角色口癖、世界观硬规则和伏笔，章→场景分层大纲设必达检查点，生成时注入前文摘要，并做一致性检测和降 AI 率改写

entries.note: 降 AI 率对标朱雀检测（332 词黑名单、统计分析、定向改写）；可按任务路由不同模型
entries.note_en: AI-rate reduction targets Zhuque detection (332-word blacklist, statistical analysis, targeted rewriting); different models can be routed per task

entries.name: novel_generator

entries.note: 最后更新 2026-03，因情绪债账本和重写熔断的设计少见而收；带 PyQt6 界面
entries.note_en: Last updated 2026-03; included for the rare emotion-debt ledger and rewrite circuit breaker; has a PyQt6 UI

entries.name: Novelex

entries.desc_en: Novel platform generating level by level from story core, worldbuilding (cultivation system, social structure), character profiles, outline, chapters, auto-injecting previous chapter summaries and text; prompt templates are editable

entries.note_en: Go + Vue3 + MongoDB; connects to OpenAI, DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen and others

entries.name: sopher.ai
entries.desc: 从作者简介到成书：多智能体依次做概念、大纲（可人工批准）、分批起草章节、编辑润色与连续性检查，配故事圣经和章节历史

entries.name: word-compiler
entries.desc: 长篇小说上下文编译器：设定圣经+场景计划按系统/章/场景三环组装并控 token 预算，逐块生成后人工审阅，审计禁用词与潜台词，从修改差异学规则
entries.desc_en: Context compiler for long-form fiction that assembles setting bible and scene plans in system/chapter/scene tiers under a token budget, audits banned words and subtext, learns rules from edits

entries.note_en: Includes zero-dependency Node scripts validating story-state.json and chapter cards; style items are observation only, not grounds for rejection

entries.name: autow

entries.desc_en: Web novel engine: teardown of benchmark books builds a material pool, then a four-stage pipeline (detailed outline, prose, check-and-reject, storage) manages long-form state; short-story mode, BM25 retrieval
entries.note: 门禁、检索、同步脚本需 Python，不装时降级为手动校验；生成的「叙事总览」目录可作为 Obsidian 库查看
entries.note_en: Gate, retrieval and sync scripts need Python, falling back to manual checks without it; the generated narrative overview directory can be opened as an Obsidian vault

entries.name: KudoShusak/NovelWriter
entries.desc: Ollama 本地长篇流水线：情节（起中结）→人物卡和世界设定→章节/场景大纲→逐场景写作，状态存 JSON，手改场景后可重建一致性状态
entries.desc_en: Local Ollama long-form pipeline: plot (beginning/middle/end), character cards and world setting, chapter/scene outline, then scene-by-scene writing, with state in JSON that can be rebuilt for consistency after hand-editing a scene
entries.note: 默认输出日语
entries.note_en: Outputs Japanese by default

entries.name: light-novel-creator
entries.desc: 轻小说创作 skill：先按指定作品/作者建风格档案，维护双区角色卡（固定属性+每章更新）与时间线双写校验，每章写完做 6 维自审
entries.desc_en: Light novel skill: builds a style profile from a named work or author, keeps two-zone character cards (fixed attributes + per-chapter updates) with dual-write timeline validation, and runs a 6-dimension self-review after each chapter
entries.note: 为 Reasonix 平台编写；ACGN 百科抓取依赖另一个未随仓库提供的 skill；含让 agent 自行搜索安装外部 skill/MCP 的指令，使用前留意
entries.note_en: Written for the Reasonix platform; ACGN wiki scraping depends on another skill not included in the repo; contains instructions that let the agent search and install external skills/MCP on its own, so review before use

entries.name: lvyu-cmd/chinese-novelist-skill
entries.desc: 中文长篇小说 skill：五项输入自动生成设定，逐章或子 Agent 并行写作，三层记忆、七维自动校验、章节评分和三级修订
entries.desc_en: Chinese long-form skill: five inputs generate the setting, chapter-by-chapter or parallel sub-Agent writing, three-layer memory, seven-dimension checks, scoring, three-level revision
entries.note: 基于 PenglongHuang/chinese-novelist-skill，另加 SQLite 持久化、三层记忆、修订模式和 8 个校验/评分脚本；README 里的 clone 地址写成 chinese-novelist-skill-master，要换成本仓库
entries.note_en: Based on PenglongHuang/chinese-novelist-skill, adding SQLite persistence, three-layer memory, revision mode and 8 check/scoring scripts; the README clone URL says chinese-novelist-skill-master and must be changed to this repo

entries.name: novel-agent-workflow
entries.desc: 文件优先的关卡式流程：访谈→概念→故事圣经→总/卷/章纲逐级 PASS 锁定后发章，作者起草，编辑（去 AI）、读者、军事/科学顾问独立审，改稿重置关卡
entries.desc_en: File-first gated workflow: interview, concept, story bible, then master/volume/chapter outlines each locked on PASS; author drafts, an editor (de-AI), readers and military/science advisors review independently, revisions reset the gate
entries.note: Python CLI + 5 个 SKILL.md；面向长篇中文科幻网文；作者起草角色可由人或 AI agent 承担，工具中立
entries.note_en: Python CLI + 5 SKILL.md files; aimed at long Chinese sci-fi web novels; the drafting role can be filled by a human or an AI agent, tool-neutral

entries.name: novel-ai-agent
entries.desc: 一句话简介→设定集/世界观（硬约束）→卷章大纲→分章写作，注入连续性约束与灵感库；写后审校偏离度、节奏曲线打分、文风指纹漂移检测、时间线校核
entries.desc_en: Premise→setting bible (hard constraints)→volume/chapter outline→chapter writing with continuity constraints; checks deviation, pacing curve, style drift, timeline
entries.note: CLI / Gradio WebUI / 飞书 Bot 三种入口；默认 DeepSeek，语义搜索用硅基流动 bge-m3
entries.note_en: Three entry points: CLI / Gradio WebUI / Feishu bot; defaults to DeepSeek, semantic search uses SiliconFlow bge-m3

entries.name: novel-engine-template
entries.desc: Director 章节设计→Writer 初稿→Critic 评审→不过则局部 patch 修订→质量门禁→Archivist 按证据段更新状态库的长篇模板
entries.desc_en: Long-form template: Director designs the chapter, Writer drafts, Critic reviews, failures get local patches, then a quality gate, and Archivist updates the state store from evidence passages
entries.note: 需自行填写 state_db 角色/世界规则/伏笔与分卷节拍；OpenAI 兼容接口
entries.note_en: You must fill in state_db characters, world rules, foreshadowing and volume beats yourself; OpenAI-compatible interface

entries.name: novel-novel-generator
entries.desc: 一键长篇：先生成 story bible 并给主要角色注入语言指纹，规划师出逐章大纲，写手逐章写，连贯性编辑更新摘要并把新发现的 AI 套话加入禁用表
entries.desc_en: One-click long-form: story bible with verbal fingerprints for main characters, planner outlines, writer drafts, continuity editor updates summaries and adds new AI cliches to a ban list
entries.note: 需 Gemini API；API 密钥暴露在浏览器，只宜本地运行
entries.note_en: Needs a Gemini API; the API key is exposed in the browser, so run locally only

entries.name: novel-project-strategy
entries.desc: Codex 长篇项目管理 skill：定义加载顺序、章节状态与同步规则，新会话不读全文也能恢复项目，防止大纲、设定、正文互相漂移
entries.desc_en: Codex long-form project management skill: defines load order, chapter status and sync rules so a new session can resume the project without reading the full text, preventing outline, settings and text from drifting apart

entries.name: novel-writer-agent
entries.desc: 番茄网文作家人格 skill：大纲→细纲→正文→打磨→审查，从上传的爆款 txt 蒸馏写法，每章按朱雀检测降 AI 味，每 30 章批量审查
entries.desc_en: Fanqie web novelist persona skill: outline, detailed outline, prose, polish, review; distills technique from uploaded hit-novel txt files, lowers AI-ness per chapter via the Zhuque AI detector
entries.note: 主打通过朱雀 AI 检测；附网文词库和对爆款作品的蒸馏库
entries.note_en: Aims to pass the Zhuque AI detector; includes a web novel lexicon and a distillation library of hit works

entries.name: novelcraft-genre-weaver
entries.desc: 仿出版社分工的 23 个专职 agent：头脑风暴（类型预期、世界、人物、情节）→主题和章节场景大纲→五类写手分写→多维审稿后行编辑重写
entries.desc_en: 23 specialist agents modeled on a publishing house: brainstorm (genre expectations, world, characters, plot), then theme and chapter/scene outlines, five kinds of writers draft in parts, multi-dimension review, then line-editor rewrite
entries.note: 可混搭多种类型和套路；仓库附几部生成的样书
entries.note_en: Can mix several genres and tropes; the repo includes some generated sample books

entries.name: NovelFlow
entries.desc: 长篇小说 skill：用文件系统当长期记忆，按章节远近做金字塔式上下文压缩，每章提交结构化 delta，分自由草稿、标准、生产锁定、断书续完等模式
entries.desc_en: Long-form novel skill using the file system as long-term memory, pyramid context compression by chapter distance, a structured delta per chapter, modes such as free draft, standard, production lock and resume-abandoned-book

entries.name: novelist-skill
entries.desc: Codex 中文小说 skill：从灵感到卷纲章纲、正文续写与改稿，维护人物、世界观、伏笔、时间线和章节总结文件
entries.desc_en: Codex Chinese-novel skill: inspiration to volume/chapter outlines, continuation and revision, maintaining files for characters, worldbuilding, foreshadowing, timeline and chapter summaries

entries.name: novelops
entries.desc: 网文框架：每章走上下文组装→情绪板→两稿制写作→脚本扫禁用词→人审→状态更新，创作指令极简、禁忌全交事后脚本，YAML 状态加向量检索
entries.desc_en: Web novel framework: each chapter goes context assembly, emotion board, two-draft writing, script scan for banned words, human review, state update; minimal prompts with prohibitions left to post-hoc scripts; YAML state plus vector search
entries.note: 最后更新 2026-03，因「极简创作指令 + 事后脚本门控」的思路少见而收；有监督和自主段落两种模式
entries.note_en: Last updated 2026-03; included for the rare "minimal prompt + post-hoc script gate" idea; supports supervised and autonomous modes

entries.name: novelos
entries.desc: 桌面长篇工作台：LangGraph 串起规划、编剧、执笔、润色、审核、记忆整理、发布 agent，用故事契约约束，按正文证据检查爽点兑现和数值继承
entries.desc_en: Desktop long-form workbench: LangGraph chains planning, screenwriting, drafting, polish, review, memory and publishing agents under a story contract, checking payoff beats against the text
entries.note: Electron + 本地 FastAPI；目前只打包 macOS 版
entries.note_en: Electron + local FastAPI; only a macOS build is packaged so far

entries.name: Soundingboard
entries.desc: 以场景为单位的小说工作区：38 个 skill 覆盖情节追问、人物 DNA、对白、感官扩写等；连续性账本追踪设定，修改建议用方括号隔离不动原文
entries.desc_en: Scene-based workspace: 38 skills (plot probing, character DNA, dialogue, sensory expansion), a continuity ledger, revision suggestions in square brackets leave original text untouched
entries.note: 默认作者执笔，AI 生成正文要显式进入 Generative 模式
entries.note_en: Author writes by default; AI-generated prose requires explicitly entering Generative mode

entries.name: story-foundry
entries.desc: Claude Code 小说工作区：捕获→提炼→生产，子代理按 Truby、Swain 等理论包出大纲和场景卡，起草后批评、出修复单再修订
entries.desc_en: Claude Code novel workspace: capture, refine, produce; sub-agents produce outlines and scene cards from theory packs such as Truby and Swain, then critique the draft, issue a fix list and revise
entries.note: 作者自述是上下文工程实验项目；仓库无许可证
entries.note_en: The author describes it as a context-engineering experiment; repo has no license

entries.name: StoryMemory-Studio
entries.desc: SQLite 结构化记忆库存人物状态、伏笔、时间线和世界规则，长上下文编排逐章生成；写后做穿帮检测、伏笔管理、文风学习与 AI 腔治理，可转短剧/漫画改编
entries.desc_en: SQLite memory of character states, foreshadowing, timeline and world rules with long-context orchestration per chapter; post-write slip detection, foreshadowing management, style learning, AI-tone control; adapts to short drama / comics
entries.note: 受 OpenHuman 长期记忆思想启发（自述非 fork、未复制代码）；Streamlit 本地应用，另提供 Windows exe；支持 DeepSeek/GLM/Ollama 等
entries.note_en: Inspired by OpenHuman's long-term memory idea (self-described as not a fork, no code copied); local Streamlit app, with a Windows exe; supports DeepSeek/GLM/Ollama and others

entries.name: storyteller
entries.desc: 自主生成多章故事：从英雄之旅、起承转合等 6 种叙事结构中选型并按章/场景分配篇幅，追踪情节线与每个角色的知情状态，可联网调研世界观，分场景/章/文风多级修订
entries.desc_en: Multi-chapter stories: picks from 6 narrative structures (Hero's Journey, kishotenketsu, etc.), allocates length per chapter/scene, tracks plot threads and each character's knowledge, researches worldbuilding, revises at three levels
entries.note: 支持 Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic，12 种语言模板，可模仿指定作者文风；可选 Tavily 调研与 Azure TTS 有声书；2026-01 后未更新
entries.note_en: Supports Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic, 12 language templates, can imitate a named author's style; optional Tavily research and Azure TTS audiobooks; not updated since 2026-01

entries.name: wbb316/dsh-novel
entries.desc: 开书向导填设定、主角、世界观和三幕大纲，大纲拆成按卷分组的情节点挂到章节，写下一章时自动带上未写情节点、卷纲领和角色关系
entries.desc_en: Book-setup wizard collects settings, protagonist, worldbuilding and a three-act outline, split into volume-grouped plot points attached to chapters; the next chapter auto-carries unwritten points and relationships
entries.note: DeepSeek Harness 插件，作者自述练手项目；需 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+
entries.note_en: DeepSeek Harness plugin, a practice project by the author's own account; needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+

entries.name: web-novel-writing-skill
entries.desc: 网文 10 阶段流水线：灵感、世界观、人物、总纲、卷纲、章纲、黄金三章、正文、质检、状态同步，含人物漂移和反派降智检查
entries.desc_en: 10-stage web novel pipeline: inspiration, worldbuilding, characters, master/volume/chapter outlines, golden first three chapters, draft, QA, state sync; checks character drift and villain dumbing-down

entries.name: chaserr/novel-craft
entries.desc: Claude Code 长篇写作与审稿插件：5 个 skill + 12 个 agent，用 RTK.md 定题材风格，管大纲、前情、伏笔、人物档案和逐章审稿
entries.desc_en: Claude Code plugin for long-form writing and review: 5 skills + 12 agents, RTK.md fixes genre and style, and it manages outline, recaps, foreshadowing, character profiles and per-chapter review
entries.note: 作者另有同流程的桌面版 novel-craft-studio
entries.note_en: The author also has a desktop version of the same workflow, novel-craft-studio

entries.name: NovelCraft
entries.desc: Streamlit 轻小说生成：先从一句想法抽取书名、章数、人物卡、背景和分段故事线，再生成正文并由 AI 打分点评，可配插图
entries.desc_en: Streamlit light-novel generator that extracts title, chapter count, character cards, background and a segmented storyline from a one-line idea, then writes the text, has AI score and comment on it, and can add illustrations
entries.note: 需 Gemini API，配图要自建 diffusers 服务；提示词有越南语和英语两套
entries.note_en: Needs the Gemini API; illustrations need a self-hosted diffusers service; prompts come in Vietnamese and English versions

entries.name: StoryPipeline
entries.desc: 用 CSV 定义人物、国家、阵营、时间线、事件和章节目标，分层约束模型逐章流式生成正文，每章写完更新故事线摘要供后文参考
entries.desc_en: Defines characters, countries, factions, timeline, events and chapter goals in CSV, has a layered-constraint model stream the text chapter by chapter, and updates a storyline summary after each chapter for later reference
entries.note: 只有后端（FastAPI），默认用 deepseek-chat
entries.note_en: Backend only (FastAPI); defaults to deepseek-chat

entries.name: write-continuous-novels
entries.desc: 强制「分章大纲→读上一章结尾→定本章目标与新冲突→写正文→查连贯与重复套路→不合格先改」逐章循环，要求每章产生实际剧情推进
entries.desc_en: Forces a per-chapter loop: chapter outline → read previous chapter's ending → set this chapter's goal and new conflict → write → check coherence and repeated tropes → fix if failing; every chapter must advance the plot
entries.note: README 开头和结尾是作者的 Token 中转站广告
entries.note_en: The README opens and closes with the author's advertisement for a token relay service

entries.name: novel_writting_skill
entries.desc: 仙侠玄幻网文技巧库：12 个维度（场景、情绪、对白、战斗、钩子等）的参考由本地 MCP 按维度检索，配写作、润色、定向优化、卡文诊断 4 个工作流和 6 份清单
entries.desc_en: Xianxia web-novel technique library: references on 12 dimensions (scene, emotion, dialogue, combat, hooks, etc.) retrieved by a local MCP; 4 workflows (write, polish, targeted optimization, block diagnosis), 6 checklists
entries.note: MCP 检索服务打包在 mcp-server.zip 里，需要先解压；也可以把 SYSTEM_PROMPT.md 直接当系统提示词用
entries.note_en: The MCP retrieval service is packed in mcp-server.zip and must be unzipped first; SYSTEM_PROMPT.md can also be used directly as a system prompt

entries.name: novel-writing-skills-for-agents
entries.desc: 7 个小说创作 skill：叙事结构（三幕式、轻小说卷级结构、伏笔回收、支线功能）、人物设计、世界观、文笔、主题象征与修订指南，供 agent 分步调用
entries.desc_en: 7 novel-writing skills for agents to call step by step: narrative structure (three-act, light-novel volume structure, foreshadowing payoff, subplot function), character design, worldbuilding, prose, theme and symbolism, and a revision guide
entries.note: README 很简略；SKILL.md 没有 YAML frontmatter，部分宿主需手动加载
entries.note_en: README is minimal; SKILL.md has no YAML frontmatter, so some hosts need it loaded manually

entries.name: Novelist-Skills
entries.desc: 18 个 SKILL：工程初始化、人物/世界观/文风卡建档、情节节奏与章节细纲、行文铁律、连续性检查、改稿，加词级/句式级去 AI 味特征库和 6 种类型文风
entries.desc_en: 18 skills: project init, character/worldbuilding/style cards, plot pacing and chapter outlines, prose rules, continuity checks, revision, word- and sentence-level de-AI libraries, 6 genre styles

entries.name: NovelLoom
entries.desc: 先推演世界关系图和事件因果图（强制 DAG）形成架构，再按图谱为一部正本和多本伴生传记同步规划章节、分批写作，正文抽取事实做跨书一致性审核
entries.desc_en: Builds a world relationship graph and event causality graph (forced DAG), then plans chapters and writes in batches for one main book plus companion biographies, extracting facts from the text for cross-book consistency review
entries.note: v0.1.0-alpha；自配 OpenAI 兼容 / Anthropic / Gemini API；作者说明真实模型的长篇成稿验收尚未完成
entries.note_en: v0.1.0-alpha; bring your own OpenAI-compatible / Anthropic / Gemini API; the author says acceptance testing of full long-form output with real models is not finished

entries.name: ollama_storyline_creator
entries.desc: 用本地 Ollama 模型按开端、发展、结局分阶段迭代续写故事，以余弦相似度拦截重复的剧情更新，再逐章生成摘要和配图提示词
entries.desc_en: Uses a local Ollama model to continue a story iteratively in stages (beginning, development, ending), blocks repetitive plot updates by cosine similarity, then generates per-chapter summaries and image prompts
entries.note: 本地 Ollama 运行；方法较简单
entries.note_en: Runs on local Ollama; the method is fairly simple

entries.name: cherry-agent-skills-public
entries.desc: 网文与跑团叙事模板 skill：先定类型、读者、欲望和核心冲突，按钩子→升级→反转→高潮搭大纲，人物按欲望/恐惧/错误信念设计，跑团分表层与隐藏真相
entries.desc_en: Web-novel and TRPG narrative template skills: set genre, reader, desire and core conflict, outline as hook → escalation → reversal → climax, design characters by desire / fear / false belief, TRPG split into surface and hidden truth
entries.note: Cherry Studio 转 Hermes Agent 的模板仓库，只有 moyu-webnovel-dm 与叙事有关（另两个是 A 股和文献）；模板偏简
entries.note_en: Template repo for moving from Cherry Studio to Hermes Agent; only moyu-webnovel-dm is narrative-related (the other two cover A-shares and literature); templates are fairly thin

entries.name: Chinese-Novel-Workflow
entries.desc: 长篇网文全流程：设定→总纲→卷纲→含完整事件链的章节细纲→带前文衔接包的单章指令→正文→连续性审稿→去 AI 润色→章节记忆回写设定库
entries.desc_en: Web-novel workflow: setting → master outline → volume outline → chapter detailed outlines with event chains → chapter instructions with prior-text bridge pack → text → continuity review → de-AI polish → chapter memory back to setting bible

entries.name: CN-writer
entries.desc: 中文长篇写/审/改三模式分开：写作时加载叙事距离、感官沉浸、断章钩子、代价节拍等 skill，审稿扫 AI 味与视角，四个 agent 按优先级修复
entries.desc_en: Chinese long-form tool with separate write / review / revise modes: writing loads skills like narrative distance, sensory immersion, chapter-end hooks and cost beats; review scans AI tone and point of view; four agents fix by priority

entries.name: multi-agent-novel-system
entries.desc: 七个 agent 分工写小说：规划师出大纲，世界、角色、情节三位策划做设定和转折，主笔逐章写，编辑统一文风，审核员查一致性；可上传作家文本生成风格 agent
entries.desc_en: Seven agents: planner outlines; world, character and plot designers do setting and twists; lead writer drafts chapter by chapter; editor unifies style; reviewer checks consistency; writer text can generate a style agent

entries.name: writer-skill
entries.desc: 长篇小说 skill：章纲→场景分解→质量循环三层嵌套；每章后更新元/实体/叙事三层记忆和变更日志，内层做一致性检查和 AI 腔检测后修订
entries.desc_en: Long-form novel skill with three nested layers (chapter outline → scene breakdown → quality loop); after each chapter updates meta/entity/narrative memory and a change log, and the inner loop checks consistency and AI tone before revising
entries.note: AI 腔检测兜底依赖 humanizer-zh skill（可选）
entries.note_en: AI-tone fallback detection relies on the humanizer-zh skill (optional)

entries.name: clark-typer
entries.desc: 硬科幻长篇 skill 流程：选题→设定（科学三层标注）→人物→大纲，写作/文学+科学审稿/润色/读者盲读循环，可回溯状态机加 sqlite-vec 一致性扫描
entries.desc_en: Hard sci-fi long-form skill flow: topic→setting (three-level science annotation)→characters→outline, write/review/polish/blind-read loop, rollback state machine, sqlite-vec consistency scan
entries.note: 仓库根目录同时放着作者自己的创作产物（0-角色档案…7-正文），/typer-init 可重置；支持导入外部作品续写/二创；附 Web 工作台；无许可证
entries.note_en: Repo root also holds the author's own output (0-character profiles ... 7-draft), resettable with /typer-init; supports importing external works for continuation/derivative work; includes a web workbench; no license

entries.name: lengdu
entries.desc: 中文短篇创作与冷读：先写完正文，再由独立校准 Agent 和全新读者 Agent 首读，检验看懂、流畅、好看
entries.desc_en: Chinese short story creation and cold reading: writes the full text first, then an independent calibration Agent and a fresh reader Agent do a first read, checking comprehension, fluency and appeal
entries.note: PolyForm Noncommercial 许可，禁止任何商业使用
entries.note_en: PolyForm Noncommercial license, any commercial use prohibited

entries.name: SEED-Story
entries.desc: 多模态大模型生成图文交错长故事：给定开头图文逐段续写文本，同时生成角色与画风一致的配图，用注意力汇聚机制支撑长序列
entries.desc_en: Multimodal LLM generating interleaved image-text stories: continues text from an image-text opening while generating character/style-consistent images, with attention sink for long sequences
entries.note: 基于 SEED-X 微调，需 GPU 与 HF 权重；同时发布 StoryStream 数据集（训练数据来自动画片）
entries.note_en: Fine-tuned from SEED-X, needs a GPU and HF weights; also releases the StoryStream dataset (training data from cartoons)

entries.name: qiaomu-novel-generator
entries.desc: 先拆成情绪承诺→高压关系→冲突场→经典桥段重构→升级节奏→结尾余味的可选剧情引擎，确认大纲后写完整短篇，再按钩子与去 AI 味清单自检
entries.desc_en: Optional plot engines (emotional promise→pressure relationship→conflict arena→trope rebuild→escalation→lingering ending); writes a short story after outline sign-off, self-checks hooks and de-AI
entries.note: 可联网检索参考作品，只借桥段功能不搬原作；附 evaluate_story.py 质检脚本
entries.note_en: Can search the web for reference works, borrowing only trope functions rather than copying originals; includes evaluate_story.py QA script

entries.name: bookflow-skill
entries.desc: 番茄短篇项目化生产：选题打分、对标拆解、人物、大纲到 beat 再写正文，每步定输入输出与人工确认点，写后 QA 与复盘
entries.desc_en: Project-style Fanqie short story production: topic scoring, benchmark teardown, characters, outline down to beats, then prose, with inputs, outputs and human confirmation points defined at each step, plus post-write QA and retrospective

entries.name: salt-story
entries.desc: 对齐知乎盐选投稿标准写付费短篇：按官方篇幅与拒稿原因自检，规定每段 1-3 句、独句段≥30%、对白占 40-50%，参照爆款拆解设计反转
entries.desc_en: Writes paid short stories to Zhihu Yanxuan submission standards: self-checks official length and rejection reasons, 1-3 sentences per paragraph, at least 30% one-line paragraphs, 40-50% dialogue, twists designed from hit-story teardowns
entries.note: 无 README，仅 SKILL.md 与 references；最后更新 2026-03，按平台化方法独特收录
entries.note_en: No README, only SKILL.md and references; last updated 2026-03, included for its distinctive platform-specific method

entries.name: AI100Stories
entries.desc: 通用故事提示词：识别类型、主题与文化背景，选三幕、英雄之旅或起承转合，设定主角渴望、需求、谎言、幽灵和冲突升级再成文；附 100 篇 AI 概念故事
entries.desc_en: General story prompt: identifies genre, theme and culture, picks three-act, hero's journey or kishotenketsu, sets the protagonist's want, need, lie, ghost and conflict escalation before writing; includes 100 stories about AI concepts
entries.note: 仓库主体是用 story_prompt.md 写成的 100 篇 AI 概念故事和 EPUB；概念知识没有核查步骤
entries.note_en: The repo is mainly 100 AI-concept stories and an EPUB written with story_prompt.md; there is no fact-checking step for the concepts

entries.name: oh-my-folkstoryphoto
entries.desc: Codex 民间怪谈伪纪录图文技能：先定拍摄者与设备，写声音卡和八段式证据链故事，逐图字幕过连续三图测试与 AI 腔审计，再分镜生图并自审返修
entries.desc_en: Codex skill for folk-horror faux-documentary photo stories: fixes photographer and device, writes a sound card and eight-part evidence-chain story, captions pass a three-in-a-row test and AI-tone audit, then storyboard, images, self-review
entries.note: 成品是 30–39 张 4:5 图文轮播，需要生图能力；字幕去公式化规则借鉴 op7418/Humanizer-zh
entries.note_en: Output is a 30-39 image 4:5 carousel and needs image generation; caption de-formula rules borrow from op7418/Humanizer-zh

entries.name: Picture_book_production
entries.desc: 批量绘本：按主题列表用含故事类型指南和结构要求的提示词生成 JSON 故事（标题、角色描述、段落），再做场景分析，用角色特征库保持形象一致并配图
entries.desc_en: Batch picture books: per topic, a prompt with story-type guides and structure requirements generates a JSON story (title, character descriptions, paragraphs), then scene analysis, with a character feature library keeping images consistent
entries.note: 故事由单次结构化提示生成，方法重心偏插图一致性；需 OpenAI 和 Fal.ai Key；README 含第三方 API 中转推荐和推广链接；README 写 MIT 但未声明许可证
entries.note_en: Stories come from a single structured prompt, so the method leans toward illustration consistency; needs OpenAI and Fal.ai keys; README contains third-party API relay recommendations and promo links; README says MIT but no license is declared

entries.name: StoryWriter
entries.desc: AI2Apps 短篇写作 agent：先由 AI 生成背景设定，再按指示逐段写、每次给三个备选，可逐段 AI 改写和配插图，靠设定和内容提炼续写长文
entries.desc_en: AI2Apps short-story agent: AI generates the background, then writes paragraph by paragraph on instruction with three alternatives each, AI rewrite and illustrations, continues from summaries
entries.note: 需在 AI2Apps 环境（在线或本地部署）运行；GPT-3.5/4；受 MidReal 启发
entries.note_en: Must run in an AI2Apps environment (online or self-deployed); GPT-3.5/4; inspired by MidReal

entries.name: storybook-generator-skill
entries.desc: 绘本生产 skill：先定故事节拍和逐页计划（每页叙事功能、翻页钩子、图文契约），再建角色/风格圣经，逐页写出图提示词，最后按排版规则和 QA 清单验收
entries.desc_en: Picture book skill: story beats and page plan (narrative function, page-turn hook, text-image contract), character/style bibles, per-page image prompts, then layout rules and QA checklist
entries.note: 支持中文、拼音、英文排版；附 KDP 上架验证的商业流程说明
entries.note_en: Supports Chinese, pinyin and English layout; includes a commercial workflow note verified against KDP listing

entries.name: AI_writing_novel
entries.desc: 本地 Ollama 循环：自动出写作要求→按目标字数写完整篇→多维度评分→生成修改建议并一键改写，可连续无人值守产出
entries.desc_en: Local Ollama loop: auto-generates writing requirements, writes a full piece to target word count, scores it on several dimensions, suggests revisions and rewrites in one click, runs unattended
entries.note: 单文件 Tkinter 应用；仓库里 Scripts/*.exe 是误提交的 Windows 虚拟环境，可忽略
entries.note_en: Single-file Tkinter app; Scripts/*.exe in the repo is a mistakenly committed Windows virtualenv and can be ignored

entries.name: StoryReasoning
entries.desc: 根据图片序列写故事：微调 Qwen2.5-VL 先用思维链列出人物、物体、场景与叙事结构表，再写出用标签绑定画面实体的故事，跨帧保持角色身份一致、减少指代幻觉
entries.desc_en: Image-sequence storytelling: fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL lists characters, objects, scenes and structure as chain-of-thought tables, then writes with tags binding visual entities across frames
entries.note: 论文配套代码，同时发布 StoryReasoning 数据集（4,178 个故事）与 QwenStoryteller 模型；需 GPU 运行 7B 视觉语言模型
entries.note_en: Companion code for a paper, also releases the StoryReasoning dataset (4,178 stories) and the QwenStoryteller model; needs a GPU to run a 7B vision-language model

entries.name: Agentic_Story_Book_Workflow
entries.desc: 基于 AutoGen 的儿童绘本多 agent 流程：接待员收集需求，故事、分镜、提示词编辑各配审稿 agent，不通过就打回重写，最后出图并合成视频/PPT
entries.desc_en: AutoGen children's picture book flow: receptionist gathers requirements, story, storyboard and prompt editors each have a reviewer agent that sends failures back for rewrite, then images are generated and composed into video/PPT
entries.note: 推荐 Azure OpenAI GPT-4o；出图用 DALL-E 3 或 Replicate Flux，配音用 Azure Speech
entries.note_en: Azure OpenAI GPT-4o recommended; images via DALL-E 3 or Replicate Flux, voiceover via Azure Speech

entries.name: lofn
entries.desc: 多模态创作 skill 集里的故事管线：6 专家+1 唱反调小组辩论选概念，6 组不同叙事结构并行写节拍、成稿，艺术家⇄批评家修订后过 QA 关卡
entries.desc_en: Story pipeline in a multimodal creative skill set: 6 experts plus a devil's advocate debate concepts, 6 groups write beats and drafts in parallel structures, artist⇄critic revision, QA gate
entries.note: 主体是图像/音乐/视频/故事多模态系统，故事只是其中一条管线；需先跑 lofn 主 skill 生成编排包
entries.note_en: Mainly a multimodal image/music/video/story system and the story pipeline is just one part; run the lofn main skill first to generate the orchestration pack

entries.name: llm-storyteller
entries.desc: Streamlit 故事生成器：三步提示链，先生成详细大纲，再写正文，最后润色语法与连贯性；可调风格、语言和长度
entries.desc_en: Streamlit story generator with a three-step prompt chain: detailed outline, then the story, then polish for grammar and coherence; style, language and length adjustable
entries.note: 界面为西班牙语；用本地 OpenAI 兼容模型或 OpenRouter 免费模型
entries.note_en: Interface is in Spanish; uses a local OpenAI-compatible model or OpenRouter free models

entries.name: fanqie-hit-short-story
entries.desc: 番茄短篇 skill：核心梗拆解→8-10 章大纲（事件/情绪/反转/钩子）→标题导语→12000 字正文→短篇编辑审稿→整篇重写→去 AI 味一句一行终稿
entries.desc_en: Fanqie short story skill: core-hook teardown, 8-10 chapter outline (event / emotion / twist / hook), title and teaser, 12,000-character prose, editor review, whole-piece rewrite, then a de-AI final draft with one sentence per line

entries.name: fanqie-short-story.skill
entries.desc: 番茄短故事创作：8 条赛道逐级选题、标题生成打分、5 段式结构与章末三层钩子、字数校验与手机排版
entries.desc_en: Fanqie short story skill: 8 tracks with tiered topic selection, scored titles, 5-part structure with three-layer chapter-end hooks, word count validation and mobile formatting
entries.note: README 未写安装步骤，目录示例为 CodeBuddy skills 路径；输出路径默认写死为 Windows D 盘
entries.note_en: README gives no install steps, directory example is a CodeBuddy skills path; output path is hardcoded to a Windows D: drive

entries.name: spark-novel
entries.desc: 短篇写作工作台：素材库积累世界观与人物，技能库保存提示词与写作流程，故事工作区按设定→大纲→正文推进
entries.desc_en: Short story workbench: a material library accumulates worldbuilding and characters, a skill library stores prompts and workflows, and the story workspace advances setting, outline, prose
entries.note: 无开源许可证；README 方法描述较少；含 Android 客户端
entries.note_en: No open-source license; README says little about method; includes an Android client

entries.name: semi-ai-chat-demo
entries.desc: Semi-UI AIChat 多 agent 演示：大纲 agent 调用背景要点工具写大纲，正文 agent 按大纲写成故事
entries.desc_en: Semi-UI AIChat multi-agent demo: an outline agent calls a background-points tool to write the outline, and a prose agent writes the story from it
entries.note: 主要是 UI 组件演示，流程很简单；支持 OpenAI、OpenRouter、Kimi、豆包、GLM
entries.note_en: Mainly a UI component demo with a very simple flow; supports OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, Doubao, GLM

entries.name: storybloom
entries.desc: 一句话生成 8 页中英双语儿童绘本：按年龄段规则控制句式、冲突和情绪节奏，固定 8 页故事节拍和镜头规划，可先审大纲，Character Bible 锁定角色
entries.desc_en: Generates an 8-page bilingual Chinese-English picture book from one sentence: age-group rules control sentences, conflict and emotional rhythm, fixed 8-page beats and shot plan, optional outline review, Character Bible locks characters
entries.note: 需自配 OpenAI 兼容文本模型和生图服务；视频导出依赖 Remotion，需另看其许可
entries.note_en: Bring your own OpenAI-compatible text model and image service; video export depends on Remotion, check its license separately

entries.name: Storybook-Generator
entries.desc: CrewAI 绘本：大纲 agent 定故事结构、人物档案和五章大纲，写作 agent 每章约百字成文，再用 FLUX 配图排成 PDF，面向 4–8 岁
entries.desc_en: CrewAI picture book: an outline agent sets story structure, character profiles and a five-chapter outline, a writing agent writes about a hundred words per chapter, then FLUX illustrates and lays out a PDF, aimed at ages 4-8
entries.note: 需 Gemini 和 Hugging Face（FLUX.1-dev）Key
entries.note_en: Needs Gemini and Hugging Face (FLUX.1-dev) keys

entries.name: short_novel_write
entries.desc: 中文短篇流水线：类型×标签抽卡出创意→多套故事方案与写作简报→正文草稿→AI 腔/模板感诊断→按风格画像局部改写并复检，SQLite 归档
entries.desc_en: Chinese short story pipeline: genre x tag card draws give ideas, then story plans and brief, draft, AI-tone diagnosis, local rewrite by style profile with recheck, archived in SQLite
entries.note: 最后更新 2026-04-10，略早于时效线，因方法完整独特保留；需 OpenAI 兼容接口
entries.note_en: Last updated 2026-04-10, slightly before the recency cutoff, kept for its complete and distinctive method; needs an OpenAI-compatible interface

entries.name: horror-weird-fiction-skill
entries.desc: 怪异恐怖短篇写作 skill：从日常场景放入单一异常，按同一方向升级 2 到 4 次，不解释来源收尾，避开鬼怪、血腥和惊吓桥段
entries.desc_en: Weird horror short story skill: puts one anomaly into an everyday scene, escalates it 2 to 4 times in one direction, ends without explaining it, avoiding ghosts, gore and jump scares
entries.note: 附两篇示例；CC BY-SA 4.0
entries.note_en: Includes two samples; CC BY-SA 4.0

entries.name: YouTube-StoryVideo-Generator
entries.desc: 恐怖故事合集流水线：Claude 先定合集主题、生成带钩子的故事构想并评分排序，成稿后 TTS 配音，再按实测时长挑选组合凑满 3 小时
entries.desc_en: Horror story compilation pipeline: Claude sets the series theme, generates story ideas with hooks and scores and ranks them, TTS voices the finished stories, and combinations are picked by measured duration to fill 3 hours
entries.note: 通过 Claude Code CLI 调用 Opus，配音依赖 Kokoro-FastAPI；目标是 YouTube 变现，画面和成片阶段未完成
entries.note_en: Calls Opus through the Claude Code CLI; voiceover depends on Kokoro-FastAPI; aimed at YouTube monetization, visuals and final video stages unfinished

entries.name: Emberglow-Story-Factory
entries.desc: 面向 YouTube 的长故事工厂：按种子题材生成 5–240 分钟旁白剧本，围绕人物转变和情感弧线展开，附标题排名、简介、缩略图和逐场画面提示词
entries.desc_en: YouTube long-story factory: 5-240 minute narration scripts from a seed theme around character change and emotional arcs, with title ranking, description, thumbnail and per-scene visual prompts
entries.note: 需 OpenAI API；题材以灵异、恐怖、求生为主，也有历史纪录片类非虚构内容
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI API; themes are mainly supernatural, horror and survival, plus historical documentary-style nonfiction

entries.name: tinyfabulist
entries.desc: 从动物角色、性格、场景、冲突、结局、寓意列表组合结构化提示词，批量让多种 LLM 写寓言，再由 LLM 评委按语法、创意、寓意清晰度打分
entries.desc_en: Combines lists of animal characters, traits, settings, conflicts, endings and morals into structured prompts to have many LLMs write fables in bulk, scored by LLM judges on grammar, creativity, moral clarity
entries.note: 用于生成 HF 数据集 klusai/ds-tf1-en-3m（300 万篇英文寓言），偏合成训练数据
entries.note_en: Used to generate the HF dataset klusai/ds-tf1-en-3m (3 million English fables); leans toward synthetic training data

entries.name: aiStories
entries.desc: 儿童睡前故事应用：从主角、配角、世界、地点、物件五栏选元素，选五种故事类型并设年龄、长度、复杂度，由 GPT/Gemini 写成故事，可朗读
entries.desc_en: Children's bedtime story app: pick elements from five columns (protagonist, supporting cast, world, location, object), five story types, age/length/complexity; GPT/Gemini writes it, can read aloud
entries.note: 方法偏轻（元素组合 + 类型模板 + 可编辑提示词）；另含 ElevenLabs 朗读、Suno 儿歌和 Tonie 上传
entries.note_en: Light method (element combination + genre templates + editable prompts); also includes ElevenLabs read-aloud, Suno children's songs and Tonie upload

entries.name: human-story-writer
entries.desc: 单个 SKILL.md：列出 AI 写作的典型毛病（套路开头、强行升华、扁平人物），要求开头直切、结尾开放、对话带潜台词、情感靠细节来写中文短篇
entries.desc_en: Single SKILL.md that lists typical AI writing flaws (cliché openings, forced uplift, flat characters) and requires direct openings, open endings, dialogue with subtext and emotion carried by detail for Chinese short stories

entries.name: mira
entries.desc: 儿童睡前故事：输入孩子名字、年龄和兴趣，导演提示词先定四段式大纲，再由写手提示词成文，系统提示词禁止吓人内容，最后 TTS 朗读
entries.desc_en: Children's bedtime stories: input name, age and interests; a director prompt sets a four-part outline, a writer prompt drafts it, the system prompt bans frightening content, TTS reads it aloud
entries.note: 为小米 MiMo 激励计划而做，依赖 MiMo 推理、视觉、TTS 三个模型；无 key 时只能看种子故事并用浏览器朗读
entries.note_en: Built for Xiaomi's MiMo incentive program, depends on three MiMo models (reasoning, vision, TTS); without a key you can only view seed stories and use browser read-aloud

entries.name: pingshu-skill
entries.desc: 现代评书 skill：先核对素材来源与剧情细节，再按评书开场、节奏、停顿、醒木写成单人说书稿，附表演计划并用 TTS 合成交付音频
entries.desc_en: Modern pingshu (Chinese storytelling) skill: checks material sources and plot details, then writes a solo storyteller script following pingshu opening, pacing, pauses and the gavel, with a performance plan and TTS-synthesized audio
entries.note: 以改编已有作品/名场面为主，不鼓励凭空编；TTS 可用本地 VoxCPM2/Qwen3-TTS 或 API
entries.note_en: Mainly adapts existing works / famous scenes and discourages inventing from scratch; TTS can use local VoxCPM2/Qwen3-TTS or an API

entries.name: story-maker
entries.desc: 把主题、类型、世界观、读者层、时代、结局、叙述视角、角色等多轴设定组装成生成契约，并随机化以避开套路；生成后 AI 编辑打分再润色，可选文风解析
entries.desc_en: Assembles multi-axis settings (theme, genre, worldbuilding, readership, era, ending, POV, characters) into a randomized generation contract that avoids tropes; AI editor scores and polishes
entries.note: 纯前端静态网页，需自备 Gemini 或 OpenAI API Key；15 种输出模式含万字长篇；许可证为作者自定条款（NOASSERTION）
entries.note_en: Pure frontend static page, bring your own Gemini or OpenAI API key; 15 output modes including 10,000-word long form; license is custom author terms (NOASSERTION)

entries.name: storyforge-publishing
entries.desc: 4–8 岁插画故事书多 agent 工作室：Publisher 读需求后动态组建专家团队和任务图，并行写作，质量闸门打回定向修订，输出含插画说明的书稿
entries.desc_en: Multi-agent studio for illustrated storybooks for ages 4-8: a Publisher reads requirements and assembles an expert team and task graph, writers work in parallel, quality gates send back targeted revisions, output includes illustration notes
entries.note: 无开源许可证；课程作业性质的 MVP；默认走 Fireworks API；不生成图片
entries.note_en: No open-source license; a course-assignment MVP; defaults to the Fireworks API; does not generate images

entries.name: AI-fiction-generator
entries.desc: DeepSeek 脚本：读入提示词文件和参考文本样例，先生成大纲和标题，再按大纲逐章写成一万多字的小说并模仿样例文风，导出 Word
entries.desc_en: DeepSeek script: reads a prompt file and sample reference text, generates an outline and title, then writes a novel of over 10,000 characters chapter by chapter from the outline, imitating the sample's style, and exports to Word
entries.note: 需 DeepSeek API；README 写 MIT 但仓库无许可证文件，文档里的脚本名与实际文件（main.py）不一致
entries.note_en: Needs a DeepSeek API; README says MIT but the repo has no license file, and script names in the docs do not match the actual file (main.py)

entries.name: childbook-adk
entries.desc: Google ADK 儿童故事流水线：写手结合随机抽取的人物/场景/冲突卡起稿，编辑润色，批评型和读者型两个审稿 agent 打分，循环三版后配图出 PDF
entries.desc_en: Google ADK children's story pipeline: writer drafts from random character/scene/conflict cards, editor polishes, critic and reader agents score, three loops, then illustrates and outputs a PDF
entries.note: 黑客松项目；需 Gemini 和 Imagen（Google API 或 Vertex AI）
entries.note_en: Hackathon project; needs Gemini and Imagen (Google API or Vertex AI)

entries.name: futuring-machines
entries.desc: 人机共写思辨小说的工具：用 JSON 定义静态/生成动作链做故事模板，选中文本或新起一行时触发提示，由 LLM 带全文上下文续写或改写
entries.desc_en: Human-AI speculative fiction tool: story templates are JSON chains of static/generative actions, selecting text or starting a new line triggers a prompt where the LLM continues or rewrites with full-text context

entries.name: llm_novel_picture_writer

entries.name: jiamama-bedtime-story-skill

entries.name: ankey-story-skill

entries.name: picturebook-story-illustrations

entries.note_en: Personal learning and non-commercial use only; commercial use needs a paid license; historical-figure books must not invent key historical facts

entries.name: reality-remix-agent

entries.note_en: Needs the Gemini API; SerpAPI search is optional

entries.name: StoryTailor.ai

entries.note_en: Includes PII redaction, content-safety review and a teacher dashboard; needs the OpenAI API

entries.name: screenwriting-skills

entries.note_en: 13 genre templates, pacing curve and payoff matrix; supports overseas Hollywood format (INT./EXT.)

entries.name: dramatron

entries.name: AI-Short-Drama-Agent-Skill

entries.name: chuanzhang-ai-shortdrama-skills

entries.name: ManjuForge
entries.desc: 漫剧连载编剧：角色档案、伏笔表、故事圣经、关系图等 7 个记忆文件逐集更新，伏笔按埋设→发酵→回收追踪，22 项跨文件一致性检查，顺带出分镜和提示词
entries.desc_en: Comic drama serial screenwriting: 7 memory files (profiles, foreshadowing table, story bible, relationship graph) updated per episode, foreshadowing tracked plant to payoff, 22 consistency checks

entries.name: aishiji-director
entries.desc: 成人科幻动画短片 skill：先定 hook、世界规则、角色欲望与主题伤口，按 6-10 beat 写剧本和导演注释，再出镜头表并查原创性与 IP 风险
entries.desc_en: Adult sci-fi animated short skill: fixes hook, world rules, character desire and thematic wound, writes a 6-10 beat script with director notes, then a shot list with originality and IP-risk checks
entries.note: 成人向黑色科幻/奇幻/恐怖题材；参照《爱死机》气质但要求原创；也输出关键帧和视频运动提示词
entries.note_en: Adult dark sci-fi/fantasy/horror; takes its tone from Love, Death & Robots but requires originality; also outputs keyframes and video motion prompts

entries.name: how-to-make-script
entries.desc: 编剧知识基建：按意图×媒介×阶段×产出把请求路由到 29 个子技能，加载协议、评分量表和知识原子生成节拍表或剧本，按量表自检后回收反馈
entries.desc_en: Screenwriting knowledge base: routes requests by intent x medium x stage x output to 29 sub-skills, loads protocols, scoring rubrics and knowledge atoms to make a beat sheet or script, self-checks against the rubric, gathers feedback
entries.note: 也覆盖品牌广告脚本和互动分支脚本；中英双语文档
entries.note_en: Also covers brand ad scripts and interactive branching scripts; bilingual Chinese/English docs

entries.name: storycine
entries.desc: 短剧全流程平台，剧本段由 7 个 LangGraph agent 串联：标签解析→大纲→人物→剧情架构→撰写→校验，支持续写和小说转剧本，再接分镜与生图生视频
entries.desc_en: Full short drama platform whose script segment chains 7 LangGraph agents: tag parsing, outline, characters, plot architecture, writing, checking, with continuation and novel-to-script support, then storyboard and image/video generation
entries.note: 无开源许可证；后半段依赖豆包 Seedream / Seedance 生图生视频
entries.note_en: No open-source license; the second half depends on Doubao Seedream / Seedance for image and video generation

entries.name: tj-short
entries.desc: 短剧带货 skill：产品分析→brief→产品证明圣经→角色/场景/道具/证据四库与 12 镜头表；先立冲突和关系压力，产品后置为证据，再出首帧和视频提示词
entries.desc_en: Short-drama product skill: product analysis → brief → product-proof bible → character/scene/prop/evidence libraries and 12-shot list; conflict and relationship pressure first, product later as evidence; then first-frame/video prompts
entries.note: 面向电商带货短剧；默认用 salpx 中转站生图、MiniMax H3 API 生视频
entries.note_en: For e-commerce promotional short dramas; defaults to the salpx relay for images and the MiniMax H3 API for video

entries.name: aivideo-production-skills
entries.desc: AI 影视生产门禁式技能集：先出节拍表和场景表，经角色心理、叙事红队、观众模拟、连续性锁定等关卡把关，再做镜头规划和提示词打包
entries.desc_en: Gate-style skill set for AI film production: beat and scene lists vetted by character psychology, narrative red team, audience simulation and continuity lock gates, then shot planning and prompt packaging
entries.note: 以 AI 视频生产为主，另含成本门禁、模型路由等非叙事 skill
entries.note_en: Mainly for AI video production, also includes non-narrative skills such as cost gates and model routing

entries.name: script-to-storyboard
entries.desc: 短剧/微电影八步工作流：破题出 3 个方向→梗概→人物卡→背景→四幕结构→场次→正文→剧本医生诊断，每步生成后自检、通过或回滚
entries.desc_en: Eight-step short drama/micro-film workflow: three directions→synopsis→character cards→background→four-act structure→scenes→script→script doctor, each step self-checked, passed or rolled back
entries.note: Electron 桌面 + Web；剧本后接分镜流水线（即梦提示词）；支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini 接口格式
entries.note_en: Electron desktop + Web; script feeds a storyboard pipeline (Jimeng prompts); supports OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini API formats

entries.name: Film-Production-Toolkit
entries.desc: Showrunner 出大纲、节奏曲线和人物小传（Ghost/Lie/Flaw），编剧按集写，剧本医生审查、驳回并存记忆快照；按微短剧/长剧/电影切换审核标准
entries.desc_en: A Showrunner produces the outline, pacing curve and character bios (Ghost/Lie/Flaw), writers write by episode, a script doctor reviews, rejects and saves memory snapshots; review standards switch between micro-drama, long series and film
entries.note: 另含预算审计、场景拆解、分镜提示词等制片模块；仓库无许可证
entries.note_en: Also includes production modules for budget audit, scene breakdown and storyboard prompts; repo has no license

entries.name: narrative-core
entries.desc: 多集剧本流水线：概念经 RAG 检索文化叙事库（五卷书、情味弧线），生成三幕式分集大纲和知识图谱，角色带向量记忆，分层摘要控上下文后成稿并质检

entries.note: 2025-04 后未更新，因注入印度文化叙事框架的思路少见而收；可输出 SSML 供音频制作

entries.name: short-drama-scriptwriter
entries.desc: AI 竖屏剧/漫剧编剧流程：立项选题→剧本圣经（世界观、人物、节拍、分集大纲）→分批写场次稿并做硬阈值质检→全剧复核后交付，状态文件门禁防跳步
entries.desc_en: Vertical short drama workflow: topic→script bible (worldbuilding, characters, beats, outline)→batched scene drafts with hard-threshold QA→full review; state-file gates prevent skipping steps
entries.note: 明确不做分镜、视频提示词和配音；区分抖音国内与 TikTok 出海市场
entries.note_en: Explicitly excludes storyboards, video prompts and voice-over; distinguishes domestic Douyin from overseas TikTok markets

entries.name: ai-screenplay-writer
entries.desc: LangGraph 编剧室：先建世界圣经，每集按场景规划→大纲校验→逐场写作→组装，连续性检查不过就重写，状态存盘可续写多季
entries.desc_en: LangGraph writers' room: builds a world bible first, then per episode scene planning, outline validation, scene-by-scene writing and assembly, rewrites when the continuity check fails, and saves state so multiple seasons can continue

entries.name: cineflow-skill
entries.desc: 影视创作 skill：念头裂变出 3 个高概念方向，按 22 集波浪情绪曲线写人物档案、叙事大纲和逐集细纲，再接分镜与视频提示词
entries.desc_en: Film and TV skill: splits an idea into 3 high-concept directions, writes character profiles, narrative outline and per-episode outlines on a 22-episode wave-shaped emotion curve, then continues to storyboards and video prompts
entries.note: 12 条路径里多数是分镜/视频提示词，剧本相关是路径一、二
entries.note_en: Most of the 12 paths are storyboard / video prompts; the script-related ones are paths one and two

entries.name: MbhStoryboardScriptAssistant

entries.name: script-weaver

entries.name: douyin-transcript-exporter

entries.name: Hermes_Script_Cool

entries.name: ai-short-drama-from-zero

entries.name: Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL
