entries.note_en: Focus is storyboards and video prompts, the script is the earlier stage; no open-source license

entries.name: wr-AI-ter
entries.desc: iOS 编剧助手：按灵感冲击→追问→普遍情感→故事节拍结构→导出梗概四阶段推进，每步由 AI 给候选、作者挑选，研究保持作者归属感
entries.desc_en: iOS screenwriting assistant in four stages: inspiration jolt→follow-up questions→universal emotion→story beat structure→synopsis export; AI offers candidates and the author picks
entries.note: IMX 2024 论文配套；产出到 treatment 梗概而非完整剧本；需在源码里填 OpenAI Key；作者另有网页版
entries.note_en: Companion to an IMX 2024 paper; outputs a treatment synopsis, not a full script; OpenAI key must be set in source; the author also has a web version

entries.name: kitten-punch-screenwriting
entries.desc: 中文编剧 skill：把故事状态当账本维护，每场先过 14 道证据式 QC 才提交，失败按来源层单调回修，长篇靠记忆快照续写
entries.desc_en: Chinese screenwriting skill keeping story state as a ledger: each scene passes 14 evidence-based QC checks before commit, failures repaired by source layer, memory snapshots continue long works
entries.note: 覆盖概念超短片、电影、剧集与竖屏短剧；README 称也可装进 DeepSeek Harness
entries.note_en: Covers concept shorts, films, series and vertical short drama; README says it can also be installed into DeepSeek Harness

entries.name: Narr-Light
entries.desc: 剧本杀创作平台：分阶段生成大纲、人物、幕次、线索和时间线，带逻辑校验和插画生成，编辑器可逐项修改
entries.desc_en: Murder-mystery game creation platform: generates outline, characters, acts, clues and timeline in stages, with logic validation and illustration generation, and an editor to revise item by item
entries.note: 需 Supabase；含定价、配额、支付、社区和运营后台；默认 mock 模式，真实生成需配 DeepSeek/Kimi 等 key
entries.note_en: Needs Supabase; includes pricing, quotas, payment, community and an operations backend; mock mode by default, real generation needs keys such as DeepSeek/Kimi

entries.name: Novel2Script_AI
entries.desc: 小说转剧本：按章让 LLM 改写成场景化剧本，人物地点存 ChromaDB 长期记忆、章节摘要作短期记忆，可选 LangGraph 多 Agent 审稿
entries.desc_en: Novel-to-script: an LLM rewrites each chapter into a scene-based script, characters and places in ChromaDB long-term memory, chapter summaries as short-term memory, optional LangGraph review
entries.note: 需 OpenAI 兼容接口（默认 DeepSeek）；支持 EPUB 输入；README 叫「分镜脚本」，实际产出场景、动作、对白结构的剧本初稿
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI-compatible interface (default DeepSeek); supports EPUB input; README calls it a storyboard script, but it actually outputs a first-draft script with scenes, action and dialogue

entries.name: zhiyuzi/StoryForge
entries.desc: 短剧运行时：采访→梗概→评审自动修正→用户确认硬卡点→剧本或分镜，再由叙事/角色/逻辑/格式评审 agent 循环修正，附赛道与结构知识库
entries.desc_en: Short drama runtime: interview→synopsis→review with auto-fix→user-confirmation checkpoint→script or storyboard, then review agents loop on narrative/character/logic/format; track and structure knowledge bases

entries.name: gushi-skill
entries.desc: 蒸馏麦基《故事》：故事三角、节拍→场景→序列→幕层级、鸿沟原理、激励事件到结局五步设计、场景 7 项检查，附 AI 短剧适配
entries.desc_en: Distills McKee's Story: story triangle, beat to scene to sequence to act hierarchy, the gap principle, five-step design from inciting incident to ending, a 7-item scene check, with an adaptation for AI short drama

entries.name: kunka-screenwriting-master
entries.desc: 13 个编剧 skill 按阶段调度：前提→因果结构→人物→场景与对白；改稿附文本证据并核对时间线和人物知情，story-bible 分记已定与暂定设定
entries.desc_en: 13 screenwriting skills by stage: premise, causal structure, characters, scenes and dialogue; revisions come with text evidence and check timeline and who-knows-what; story-bible records settled and tentative settings separately

entries.name: manju-full-pipeline
entries.desc: 小说改竖屏漫剧：原著章节索引→改编契约→故事引擎与分集地图→单集剧本，再做资产图、九宫格和 MiniMax H3 视频提示词，独立审核后交付
entries.desc_en: Adapts novels into vertical motion comics: source chapter index, adaptation contract, story engine and episode map, single-episode scripts, then asset images, nine-grid and MiniMax H3 video prompts, delivered after independent review
entries.note: 后半段是资产图、分镜和视频提示词生产；附无第三方依赖的 Python 结构检查脚本
entries.note_en: The second half is production of asset images, storyboards and video prompts; includes a Python structure-check script with no third-party dependencies

entries.name: MiaoMuse
entries.desc: 短剧剧本工作台：故事设定→角色小传→阶段大纲→分集大纲→分集正文逐级流式生成，另有剧本改写和网文改编入口，可导出 Word
entries.desc_en: Short drama script workbench: setting, character bios, stage outline, episode outlines, episode prose generated level by level with streaming; script rewriting, web novel adaptation, Word export
entries.note: Go 后端和 Vue 前端各只有一个源文件；需 MySQL；钱包、会员、充值界面仅作演示；作者留微信接定制开发
entries.note_en: Go backend and Vue frontend each have only one source file; needs MySQL; wallet, membership and top-up screens are demo only; the author offers custom development via WeChat

entries.name: screenplay-writer-agent
entries.desc: CrewAI 剧本 agent：分析素材→建人物、情节与分场→写剧本→严格格式化→质量评估五阶段，人物与对白专员分工，可接 Mem0 保持人物一致
entries.desc_en: CrewAI screenplay agent in five stages: analyze material→characters, plot, scenes→script→strict formatting→quality assessment, with character and dialogue specialists, optional Mem0 consistency
entries.note: 仓库由 Paraschamoli/screenplay-writer-agent 转移而来；基于 bindu 模板；需 OpenAI 或 OpenRouter
entries.note_en: Repo transferred from Paraschamoli/screenplay-writer-agent; based on the bindu template; needs OpenAI or OpenRouter

entries.name: write-screenplay-skill
entries.desc: 小说/设定改编短剧剧本：剥离心理描写、把情绪外化成可拍动作并拆成单动作节拍，过黄金三秒、集尾钩子等六项门禁，含英文对白出海模式
entries.desc_en: Adapts novels into short drama scripts: strips inner monologue, externalizes emotion as filmable single-action beats, six gates (golden three seconds, episode-end hook), English dialogue mode

entries.name: zhang-yimou-skill
entries.desc: 短剧 skill：把张艺谋式色彩叙事、仪式化调度、空间权力、道具母题等原则转成写作规则，从一句灵感写出短剧剧本，再拆镜头表、故事版和 Seedance 提示词
entries.desc_en: Short drama skill turning Zhang Yimou-style principles (color narrative, ritual staging, spatial power, prop motifs) into writing rules: script from one line, then shot list, storyboard, Seedance prompts
entries.note: 不扮演张艺谋本人，只用公开可观察的导演原则；七步流程中后五步是分镜/视频/剪辑
entries.note_en: Does not impersonate Zhang Yimou, uses only publicly observable directing principles; the last five of seven steps are storyboard/video/editing

entries.name: Story-Film-Skills
entries.desc: 从故事简报、节拍表、人物与世界圣经写到小说和剧本，再接分镜、生成与剪辑的技能套件；用稳定 ID 和项目文件记录故事状态，跨长片保持连续
entries.desc_en: Skill suite from story brief, beat sheet, and character and world bibles through novel and screenplay, then storyboard, generation and editing; stable IDs and project files track story state to keep continuity across long works
entries.note: 同一套件还覆盖生图、配音、视频生成、剪辑和发行；故事部分见 write-story、write-book、beat-sheet、story-state、revise-screenplay 等技能
entries.note_en: The same suite also covers image generation, voiceover, video generation, editing and distribution; the story skills are write-story, write-book, beat-sheet, story-state, revise-screenplay, etc.

entries.name: nova-story
entries.desc: AI 短剧创作工具：先做多章故事规划和故事圣经，按分层上下文逐章写正文并评估改动影响，定稿后转分场剧本，再提取角色、场景、道具资产做分镜、关键帧和视频
entries.desc_en: AI short-drama tool: multi-chapter story plan and story bible, chapter writing with layered context and edit-impact assessment, final draft to scene-by-scene script, then character/scene/prop assets for storyboards, keyframes and video
entries.note: 出图和视频依赖本地或远程 ComfyUI；单机单用户
entries.note_en: Images and video depend on local or remote ComfyUI; single machine, single user

entries.name: story-room-the-legacy-patch
entries.desc: OpenClaw 多代理编剧室：任务简报先锁钩子和悬念，再做季圣经→分集大纲→连贯骨架→批量剧本→审校检查点→分镜与制片资产包，按协议分工交接
entries.desc_en: OpenClaw multi-agent writers' room: brief locks hooks and suspense, then season bible → episode outlines → continuity skeleton → batch scripts → review checkpoints → storyboard and production asset pack, roles handed off by protocol
entries.note: 最初用于都市家庭伦理短剧，附示例项目 perfect-heir；开新项目只复制方法层文件
entries.note_en: Originally built for urban family-ethics short dramas, with the example project perfect-heir; when starting a new project, copy only the method-layer files

entries.name: AI-ShortVideo-Story-Engine
entries.desc: 一句话生成人生副本、商业反转类短视频剧本：先立故事契约（情绪承诺、权力对抗、核心反转、伏笔回收表），配钩子库和压力阶梯，再出分镜与配音施工表
entries.desc_en: One sentence → life-redo / business-reversal short-video script: first a story contract (emotional promise, power confrontation, core reversal, foreshadowing table), hook library, pressure ladder, then storyboard and voiceover sheet
entries.note: 附爆款视频逆向拆解法和商业模式拆解子 skill；分镜 Prompt 与抖音/小红书发布包随附
entries.note_en: Includes a sub-skill for reverse-engineering viral videos and breaking down business models; storyboard prompts and Douyin/Xiaohongshu publishing packs are bundled

entries.name: fount
entries.desc: 剧本修订引擎：把剧本解析成带稳定场景 / 元素 ID 的结构模型，AI 生成多个备选页面，追踪大改动对前后场的影响并修复，由人决定哪些进入定稿
entries.desc_en: Script revision engine: parses a script into a structural model with stable scene/element IDs, AI generates alternative pages, tracks and repairs how big changes affect other scenes, and a human decides which go into the final draft
entries.note: Elixir / Phoenix，支持 Fountain 无损往返；依赖 System One SDK 和 Codex 登录
entries.note_en: Elixir / Phoenix; supports lossless Fountain round-trip; depends on the System One SDK and Codex login

entries.name: AI-Drama-Skill
entries.desc: 短剧多 agent 技能包：市场分析→定位→IP 与人物→100 集结构→分集→剧本→QA，内置前 30 秒钩子、每 10 集高潮等规则和项目记忆
entries.desc_en: Short-drama multi-agent skill pack: market analysis → positioning → IP and characters → 100-episode structure → episodes → script → QA, with built-in rules (hook in first 30 seconds, climax every 10 episodes) and project memory
entries.note: 作者称只在 Codex 上测过；精简量产版见 rouql/ai-short-drama-production
entries.note_en: The author says it was only tested on Codex; a slimmer mass-production version is rouql/ai-short-drama-production

entries.name: AI-novel-to-script
entries.desc: 上传 3 章以上小说，自动切章→AI 抽取人物/场景/剧情线→按网剧/电影/短剧逐章改编成动作、台词、转场，输出用 ID 引用人物场景的 YAML 剧本
entries.desc_en: Upload a 3+ chapter novel; auto-splits chapters, AI extracts characters/scenes/plot lines, adapts chapter by chapter into actions, dialogue and transitions for web series / film / short drama, as YAML scripts with ID-referenced characters
entries.note: 需要文心一言或通义千问 API
entries.note_en: Needs the Wenxin Yiyan or Tongyi Qianwen API

entries.name: danydenis560-beep/storyforge-ai
entries.desc: AI 影视故事工作室：一句话生成故事、分集、对白和故事圣经，锁定角色外观生成一致性标记，检索故事圣经标出前后漂移，再编译成各视频平台提示词
entries.desc_en: AI film/TV story studio: one sentence → story, episodes, dialogue and story bible; locks character appearance as consistency markers, retrieves from the story bible to flag drift, then compiles prompts for each video platform
entries.note: 故事、角色、分镜模块仍是 MVP，另一半重心是编译 Veo/Kling 等视频提示词；支持 Anthropic/OpenAI/Ollama，可用 mock 免密钥试用
entries.note_en: Story, character and storyboard modules are still an MVP; the other half of the focus is compiling Veo/Kling etc. video prompts; supports Anthropic/OpenAI/Ollama, and a mock mode works without keys

entries.name: emma-screenwriting-skills
entries.desc: 八个短剧编剧方法：拆对标结构、迁移剧情引擎做改编、设计全剧期待与兑现链，按观众期待→戏剧机制→可拍呈现修集尾钩子，再扩集纲、诊断对白、删冗余
entries.desc_en: Eight short drama writing methods: benchmark structure teardown, plot-engine transfer for adaptation, expectation/payoff chains, episode-end hook fixes, outline expansion, dialogue diagnosis, cuts

entries.name: hongguo-shortdrama-screenwriting
entries.desc: 以 short-drama-factory 结构引擎为底，并入红果《短剧编剧第一课》的选题、黄金开场、钩子与情绪点方法，机检加查黄金三角与对白占比
entries.desc_en: Built on the short-drama-factory structure engine, adds the topic selection, golden opening, hook and emotion-point methods from Hongguo's "Short Drama Writing Lesson 1", with machine checks adding golden-triangle and dialogue-ratio checks
entries.note: 方法论来源为作者自述，未核实
entries.note_en: Methodology source is the author's own claim, unverified

entries.name: Marinara-Engine
entries.desc: 角色扮演与游戏引擎：AI 游戏主持带队伍/任务/战斗，可按需安装叙事导演、连续性检查、世界状态与关系追踪、长期记忆、Lorebook 维护等代理
entries.desc_en: Roleplay and game engine: an AI game master with party / quests / combat, and optional agents for narrative director, continuity check, world state and relationship tracking, long-term memory and Lorebook maintenance
entries.note: AGPL-3.0，Beta；代理需从 Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents 下载；仓库附带 Windows 启动器 exe，但源码完整；可导入 SillyTavern 数据
entries.note_en: AGPL-3.0, Beta; agents are downloaded from Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents; the repo ships a Windows launcher exe but source is complete; can import SillyTavern data

entries.name: OpenStory
entries.desc: 多智能体故事世界推演框架：角色按感知→计划→执行→反思插件自主行动演出剧情，玩家可下指令、回溯分支；WorldKernel 一句话生成角色、地点与规则
entries.desc_en: Multi-agent story-world simulation: characters act via perceive, plan, act, reflect plugins, players can command and backtrack branches; WorldKernel generates characters, locations and rules from one line
entries.note: 基于 ZJU-LLMs/Agent-Kernel，需本地 Redis；内置红楼梦、西部世界示例；另有 DeepSeek Harness 插件
entries.note_en: Based on ZJU-LLMs/Agent-Kernel, needs local Redis; ships Dream of the Red Chamber and Westworld examples; also has a DeepSeek Harness plugin

entries.name: AI4VisualNovel
entries.desc: 视觉小说多 agent 框架：制片、编剧、演员、美术分工，先出大纲再生成拓扑排序的 DAG 分支剧情图，演员 agent 按人设演对白并审立绘，导出可玩游戏
entries.desc_en: Visual novel multi-agent framework: producer, screenwriter, actor and artist roles; outline, then a topologically sorted DAG branching plot graph, actor agents perform dialogue per persona and review character art, exports a playable game
entries.note: 论文尚未发布；需要文本和图像生成 API；可导出 Ren'Py 工程，支持自定义原创角色（OC）
entries.note_en: Paper not yet published; needs text and image generation APIs; can export a Ren'Py project and supports custom original characters (OC)

entries.name: Sonder_Engine
entries.desc: 互动小说引擎：导演裁定客观因果，感知层决定每个角色能知道什么，角色代理只凭私有记忆行动，叙述者只写玩家可见部分，再统一提交状态
entries.desc_en: Interactive fiction engine: a director rules on objective causality, a perception layer decides what each character can know, agents act only on private memory, the narrator writes only what the player can see, then state is committed
entries.note: 本地单人引擎；每回合多次模型调用，成本较高；每个阶段可重掷或手改
entries.note_en: Local single-player engine; multiple model calls per turn so cost is higher; each stage can be rerolled or hand-edited

entries.name: SillyTavern
entries.desc: LLM 角色扮演前端：World Info 世界书按关键词注入设定，配合角色卡、群聊、视觉小说模式和扩展生态支撑长篇互动叙事
entries.desc_en: LLM roleplay frontend: World Info world books inject settings by keyword, combined with character cards, group chat, visual novel mode and an extension ecosystem to support long-form interactive narrative
entries.note: 基于 TavernAI 1.2.8 分叉后独立发展；通用 LLM 前端，叙事机制主要靠世界书与扩展；AGPL-3.0
entries.note_en: Forked from TavernAI 1.2.8 and developed independently since; a general LLM frontend whose narrative mechanics rely mainly on world books and extensions; AGPL-3.0

entries.name: KoboldAI-Client
entries.desc: 浏览器里的 AI 写作前端，用 Memory、Author's Note、World Info 三件套管理上下文，可在小说、文字冒险、聊天模式间切换
entries.desc_en: In-browser AI writing front end that manages context with Memory, Author's Note and World Info, switching between novel, text-adventure and chat modes
entries.note: 已停止维护，跑不了新模型，后继是 KoboldCpp 和 KoboldAI Lite
entries.note_en: Unmaintained and cannot run newer models; successors are KoboldCpp and KoboldAI Lite

entries.name: TavernAI-v1
entries.desc: 角色扮演/故事写作前端：角色卡、多角色群聊、故事模式，World Info 世界书注入设定，可接 KoboldAI、NovelAI、OpenAI 等后端
entries.desc_en: Roleplay/story writing frontend: character cards, multi-character group chat, story mode, World Info injects settings, connects to KoboldAI, NovelAI, OpenAI and other backends
entries.note: README 自称旧版仓库，新版为 TavernAI/TavernAI；SillyTavern 由其分叉而来
entries.note_en: README calls it the old repo, the new version is TavernAI/TavernAI; SillyTavern was forked from it

entries.name: Risuai
entries.desc: 跨平台 LLM 角色扮演客户端：lorebook 按关键词注入设定，HypaMemory/SupaMemory 压缩长对话记忆，支持多角色群聊和条件变量提示词
entries.desc_en: Cross-platform LLM roleplay client: lorebook keyword-injects settings, HypaMemory/SupaMemory compress long-chat memory, multi-character group chat and conditional-variable prompts
entries.note: 主要定位角色扮演聊天前端；支持多家 API、插件与 TTS
entries.note_en: Positioned mainly as a roleplay chat front end; supports many APIs, plugins and TTS

entries.name: ChineseAiDungeonChatGPT
entries.desc: 早期中文 AI 地牢：玩家每回合输入行动，ChatGPT 按文字冒险设定续写剧情，支持存档读档与 GUI
entries.desc_en: Early Chinese AI Dungeon: the player types an action each turn and ChatGPT continues the plot under text-adventure settings, with save/load and a GUI
entries.note: 2023 年项目，按影响力收录；依赖 revChatGPT 非官方接口，大概率已无法直接运行
entries.note_en: 2023 project, included for influence; depends on the unofficial revChatGPT interface and most likely no longer runs as is

entries.name: novel-to-game
entries.desc: 小说改编游戏：带原文出处的设计文档、网页游戏构建与基于证据的 QA，附三个可玩示例
entries.desc_en: Novel-to-game adaptation: design documents with source citations, web game build, and evidence-based QA, with three playable examples

entries.name: AI-Chat
entries.desc: Narratium 角色扮演与冒险平台：兼容 SillyTavern 角色卡和世界书，冒险模式由玩家选择推动剧情，用 React Flow 可视化会话记忆与分支
entries.desc_en: Narratium roleplay and adventure platform: SillyTavern card and world book compatible, adventure mode driven by player choices, React Flow visualizes session memory and branches
entries.note: 已归档、停止开发（2026-03 最后更新），按 ≥100★ 保留
entries.note_en: Archived and no longer developed (last updated 2026-03), kept under the >=100 stars rule

entries.name: TenCyclesofFate
entries.desc: 《浮生十梦》文字冒险：每天十次入梦轮回，AI 实时生成一世人生，关键行动请求 D100“天命判定”按成败改写走向，另有 AI 反作弊识别玩家的提示词注入
entries.desc_en: Text adventure Ten Cycles of Fate (浮生十梦): ten dream loops per day, the AI generates a life in real time, key actions request a D100 fate check that rewrites the course, and an AI anti-cheat detects player prompt injection
entries.note: 需 OpenAI 兼容 API 与 Linux.do OAuth 登录；GitHub 未识别许可证
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI-compatible API and Linux.do OAuth login; GitHub does not recognize the license

entries.name: open-dungeon
entries.desc: 本地 AI 角色扮演/文字冒险：Do/Say/Story 三种输入推进叙事，旧段落滚动压缩成「前情提要」保长篇记忆，角色立绘同时喂给叙事模型与生图保持视觉连续
entries.desc_en: Local AI roleplay/text adventure: Do/Say/Story inputs advance narration, old passages roll up into a recap for long-form memory, character portraits feed both narrator and image model for visual continuity
entries.note: 默认 Ollama + Gemma 4，可接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点；默认叙事提示词允许成人内容；Mac 版 DMG 在 Releases
entries.note_en: Defaults to Ollama + Gemma 4, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works; default narration prompt allows adult content; Mac DMG in Releases

entries.name: ai-novel-studio
entries.desc: 互动小说引擎：冻结世界快照和已提交状态，玩家行动后模型只提出正文与状态补丁，服务端校验人物、场景不变量后再事务提交，防止设定漂移
entries.desc_en: Interactive fiction engine: freezes a world snapshot and committed state; the model only proposes prose and a state patch, the server validates invariants before a transactional commit, preventing drift
entries.note: 公开版只含合成示例数据，不含线上站内容；完整运行需 MySQL、Redis、RabbitMQ；go run ./cmd/demo 可离线看校验演示
entries.note_en: Public version has only synthetic sample data, not the live site's content; a full run needs MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ; go run ./cmd/demo shows the validation demo offline

entries.name: Aventuras
entries.desc: AI 文字冒险/协作写作前端：按章自动摘要并检索前情，lorebook 按场景注入且有 agent 自动合并补全，逐回合追踪在场人物、地点与物品
entries.desc_en: AI text adventure / co-writing frontend: per-chapter summaries with retrieval of earlier events, scene-based lorebook injection with an agent that merges and fills entries, turn-by-turn tracking of present characters, locations and items
entries.note: 有冒险与创意写作两种模式；提示词均为可编辑 Liquid 模板；提供桌面与 Android 安装包，也可源码构建
entries.note_en: Has adventure and creative writing modes; prompts are all editable Liquid templates; desktop and Android installers provided, or build from source

entries.name: lite.koboldai.net
entries.desc: 单 HTML 的 LLM 写作前端：故事/冒险/聊天/指令四种模式，支持 Memory、Author's Note、World Info 世界书和预设剧本库
entries.desc_en: Single-HTML LLM writing front end: story, adventure, chat and instruct modes, with Memory, Author's Note, World Info lorebooks and a preset scenario library
entries.note: 随 KoboldCpp 捆绑，是旧版 KoboldAI 的继任前端；可接 KoboldCpp、AI Horde、OpenAI、Claude 等
entries.note_en: Bundled with KoboldCpp, successor front end to the old KoboldAI; connects to KoboldCpp, AI Horde, OpenAI, Claude and others

entries.name: AI-Gamble
entries.desc: 互动小说游戏：开局先生成整篇故事结构图（Mermaid 可视化分支与多结局）和文风描述，再按玩家选择逐段生成情节
entries.desc_en: Interactive fiction game: starts by generating the whole story structure graph (Mermaid visualization of branches and multiple endings) and a style description, then generates plot passage by passage from the player's choices
entries.note: 2026-01 后未更新，按 ≥100★ 保留；用 OpenAI 接口
entries.note_en: Not updated since 2026-01, kept under the 100+ stars rule; uses the OpenAI interface

entries.name: WhatIf
entries.desc: 把中文小说变成可玩世界：抽取事件、角色、地点、物品与实体状态变化，玩家进入原著自由行动、偏离主线，引擎保持叙事连贯
entries.desc_en: Turns Chinese novels into playable worlds: extracts events, characters, locations, items and entity state changes; the player enters the original work, acts freely and deviates from the main plot while the narrative stays coherent
entries.note: Alpha 阶段；小说原文需自备
entries.note_en: Alpha; you supply the novel text

entries.name: dsh-nexttavern
entries.desc: DSH 长篇角色扮演：导入或对话共创酒馆角色卡，按需读世界书，关键词+语义混合检索长期记忆，多角色 Agent 独立推演，可分支世界线并导出小说
entries.desc_en: DSH long-form roleplay: imports or co-creates tavern character cards, reads the lorebook on demand, hybrid keyword+semantic long-term memory, independent multi-character agents, branching timelines, novel export
entries.note: DeepSeek Harness 插件，需 Node 24+ 与 DSH 宿主；Release 另提供 Windows/Linux 安装器
entries.note_en: DeepSeek Harness plugin, needs Node 24+ and the DSH host; Releases also provide Windows/Linux installers

entries.name: app
entries.desc: 隐私优先的角色扮演客户端：自定义角色卡和结构化系统提示模板，长期记忆以上下文摘要加可编辑记忆条目实现，BYOK 接 20+ 模型含本地 llama.cpp
entries.desc_en: Privacy-first roleplay client: custom character cards and structured system prompt templates, long-term memory via context summaries plus editable memory entries, BYOK access to 20+ models including local llama.cpp
entries.note: 偏角色聊天，也可作陪伴用途；叙事机制主要是长期记忆；Android / 桌面多端
entries.note_en: Leans toward character chat and can serve as a companion; the narrative mechanic is mainly long-term memory; Android / desktop

entries.name: jubensha-ai
entries.desc: AI 先生成剧本杀（背景、角色秘密、证据、场景），可用自然语言改稿，再由 AI 扮演全部角色走自我介绍、搜证、讨论、投票、揭晓等 8 个阶段
entries.desc_en: AI generates a murder-mystery game (background, secrets, evidence, scenes), editable in natural language, then plays all characters through 8 phases: intro, evidence search, discussion, vote, reveal
entries.note: 可选 TTS（MiniMax/CosyVoice）和文生图（ComfyUI/MiniMax）
entries.note_en: Optional TTS (MiniMax/CosyVoice) and text-to-image (ComfyUI/MiniMax)

entries.name: vellium
entries.desc: 本地桌面 RP 与写作工作台：多角色聊天带分支时间线、LoreBook、作者注与场景状态；写作按章节/场景组织，配 Character Forge 与 RAG
entries.desc_en: Local desktop roleplay and writing workbench: multi-character chat with branching timelines, LoreBook, author's notes and scene state; writing is organized by chapter/scene, with Character Forge and RAG

entries.name: diceframe
entries.desc: 自部署 AI 跑团引擎：GM 模型接收自然语言行动，系统自动判定检定并掷骰、更新 HP/理智/物品，世界书按关键词注入，长团压缩摘要加向量召回
entries.desc_en: Self-hosted AI tabletop RPG engine: a GM model takes natural-language actions, the system rules checks, rolls dice and updates HP / sanity / items, a world book injects by keyword, long campaigns use compressed summaries plus vector recall
entries.note: 支持 CoC 7e / D&D 5e 轻量规则与无骰叙事；可接 QQ 群聊 Bot（NapCat）；AGPL-3.0
entries.note_en: Supports CoC 7e / D&D 5e lite rules and dice-free narrative; can connect to a QQ group chat bot (NapCat); AGPL-3.0

entries.name: SillyTavern-Pathweaver
entries.desc: ST 剧情导演扩展：读近期对话，按顺势、反转、新角色、类型风格生成最多 6 条走向供发给 AI；Surprise Me 提前埋入隐藏事件
entries.desc_en: ST story-director extension: reads recent chat and generates up to 6 directions (go with it, twist, new character, genre style) to send to the AI; Surprise Me plants hidden events in advance
entries.note: 含可选 NSFW 建议类别；2026-03 后未更新，但 ≥100★
entries.note_en: Includes optional NSFW suggestion categories; not updated since 2026-03, but >=100 stars

entries.name: Auto-Cards
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 场景脚本：从剧情中识别命名实体，定期让 AI 自动写成故事卡，并为重要卡片做长期记忆更新和摘要，缓解剧情中的物体恒存问题
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon scenario script: detects named entities in the story, periodically has the AI write them into story cards, and updates long-term memory and summaries for key cards to ease object permanence problems
entries.note: 需装进 AI Dungeon 平台的场景脚本中使用；提供 API 供其他脚本作者调用
entries.note_en: Must be installed as a scenario script on the AI Dungeon platform; provides an API for other script authors

entries.name: NarrativeEngine-P
entries.desc: 自托管 AI 跑团主持：导入世界设定和规则文件自动分块索引，长战役靠智能记忆、活 NPC、地点账本和世界自动管理推进，附多套现成世界
entries.desc_en: Self-hosted AI tabletop host: imports world setting and rules files with automatic chunk indexing, long campaigns run on smart memory, living NPCs, a location ledger and automatic world management, with several ready-made worlds
entries.note: 只需 Node 20+；另有 Android 客户端 NarrativeEngine-M；仓库含 mods/ability-compendium.7z 数据包和 .bat 启动/修复脚本
entries.note_en: Needs only Node 20+; has an Android client NarrativeEngine-M; the repo includes the mods/ability-compendium.7z data pack and .bat launch/repair scripts

entries.name: sillytavern-DeepLore
entries.desc: ST 世界书检索引擎：设定存在 Obsidian 库，关键词+BM25 粗筛、AI 读摘要精选、按时代/地点/角色门控后注入；图书管理员代理补写缺失条目
entries.desc_en: ST world book retrieval engine: lore kept in an Obsidian vault, keyword+BM25 prefilter, AI picks from summaries, gates by era/place/character before injection; a librarian agent fills in missing entries
entries.note: 需 SillyTavern + Obsidian Local REST API 插件；AI 检索每轮多一次调用
entries.note_en: Needs SillyTavern + the Obsidian Local REST API plugin; AI retrieval adds one extra call per turn

entries.name: otaku
entries.desc: LLM 创作/角色扮演前端：对话与小说两种模式，前 20 与后 150 条原文保文风，中段自动切场景换成摘要，识别角色并各记见闻日志，模型可留私密笔记
entries.desc_en: LLM writing/roleplay front end: chat and novel modes, keeps first 20 and last 150 raw messages for style, auto-cuts the middle into scene summaries, per-character witness logs, private model notes
entries.note: 终端 TUI + Web；lorebook 尚在计划中
entries.note_en: Terminal TUI + Web; lorebook still planned

entries.name: Promised_Land_AI
entries.desc: 多人在线文字冒险：DeepSeek 按玩家属性、装备和阶段生成剧情，用 TF-IDF 检索剧情库做 RAG，AI 可直接读写玩家数据库，配迷雾 ASCII 地图
entries.desc_en: Multiplayer online text adventure: DeepSeek generates plot from player stats, gear and stage, TF-IDF retrieval over a plot library for RAG, AI reads/writes the player database directly, fog ASCII map
entries.note: 需 DeepSeek API
entries.note_en: Needs a DeepSeek API

entries.name: filmgame
entries.desc: 互动影游五阶段：世界锚点→规模方案→章/幕/节点分支结构→逐节点写对白（角色声纹卡）→全局结构校验和五位导演终审，可导出 ink
entries.desc_en: Five stages for interactive film games: world anchor, scale plan, chapter/act/node branching, per-node dialogue (character voice cards), global structure validation and five-director final review, ink export
entries.note: 编剧主导、AI 协作；后端可用本地 Claude CLI 或 Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini API；需 Postgres
entries.note_en: Screenwriter-led with AI collaboration; backend can use local Claude CLI or Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini APIs; needs Postgres

entries.name: ludo-npc-ai
entries.desc: 游戏叙事与 NPC 工作台：世界设定→角色→场景→分支对白卡→审阅 AI 候选稿→试玩彩排，中英双语 Skills 和本地 MCP 让外部 AI 参与起草
entries.desc_en: Game narrative and NPC workbench: worldbuilding, characters, scenes, branching dialogue cards, review of AI candidate drafts, then playtest rehearsal, with bilingual Chinese-English Skills and a local MCP so external AI can join drafting
entries.note: AI 只出候选稿，作者终审；0.1.0 预览版
entries.note_en: The AI only offers candidate drafts and the author has final say; 0.1.0 preview

entries.name: aisandboxgame
entries.desc: 浏览器文字 RPG：设计模式访谈生成世界卡（设定/人物/地点/开场），游玩时模型推理并叙述，NPC 各自维护认知与关系状态，d20 检定裁定行动
entries.desc_en: Browser text RPG: a design-mode interview produces a world card (setting / characters / locations / opening), the model reasons and narrates during play, each NPC keeps its own cognition and relationship state, d20 checks adjudicate actions
entries.note: 纯前端 PWA，BYOK；代码 AGPL-3.0，提示词 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
entries.note_en: Pure front-end PWA, BYOK; code AGPL-3.0, prompts CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

entries.name: front-porch-AI
entries.desc: 本地角色扮演桌面应用：Realism Engine 追踪角色情绪、信任、需求和记忆，随故事时钟变化；支持 lorebook、群像角色和故事工作室
entries.desc_en: Local roleplay desktop app: a Realism Engine tracks character emotion, trust, needs and memory changing with a story clock; supports lorebooks, ensemble characters and a story studio
entries.note: 主打角色聊天，可导入 Backyard AI 的 .byaf；内置 TTS 和图像生成，支持本地 KoboldCpp
entries.note_en: Focused on character chat, can import Backyard AI .byaf; built-in TTS and image generation, supports local KoboldCpp

entries.name: Inner-Self
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 模组：给每个 NPC 独立的私有记忆、目标、秘密和计划，被提及时自我反思、整理思绪并驱动后续情节，可合并 Auto-Cards 建设定卡
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon mod giving each NPC private memory, goals, secrets and plans that self-reflect when mentioned and drive later plot; can combine with Auto-Cards to build setting cards
entries.note: 需在 AI Dungeon 场景脚本里使用；2026-01 后无更新，NPC 自主心智的思路少见，按例外收录
entries.note_en: Must be used in AI Dungeon scenario scripts; no updates since 2026-01, listed as an exception for its rare autonomous-NPC-mind idea

entries.name: NeverEndingQuest
entries.desc: AI 地下城主跑 D&D 5e（SRD）战役：LLM 只负责叙事，独立规则引擎管骰子/背包/状态，配合冒险模块工具包与对话压缩保持长期战役记忆
entries.desc_en: AI dungeon master running D&D 5e (SRD) campaigns: the LLM only narrates while a separate rules engine handles dice / inventory / state, with an adventure-module toolkit and dialogue compression keeping long-campaign memory
entries.note: 基于 WOTC SRD 5.2.1 内容；默认 OpenAI GPT-5.x，可接 Gemini/本地模型；规则引擎 bin/nql-apply.exe 为编译二进制，Windows 安装用 .bat 脚本
entries.note_en: Based on WOTC SRD 5.2.1 content; defaults to OpenAI GPT-5.x, can use Gemini/local models; the rules engine bin/nql-apply.exe is a compiled binary and Windows install uses .bat scripts

entries.name: chasm_engine
entries.desc: 生成式文字冒险服务器：几句话指定世界，边玩边生成地点和角色；地点、物品、背包、任务持久化，全局事件与角色对话记忆存向量库，NPC 会移动

entries.note: 已停止维护（已归档），后继为重写版 atisharma/chasm；需配合客户端使用；Hy 语言，AGPL-3.0
entries.note_en: Unmaintained (archived), successor is the rewrite atisharma/chasm; needs a client; written in Hy, AGPL-3.0

entries.name: loreweaver
entries.desc: AI 跑团主持引擎：AI KP 读模组、扮演全部 NPC、守线索，检定、伤害、理智都由代码掷骰结算；规则、设定、角色打包成可分享的文件包
entries.desc_en: AI tabletop RPG host: the AI keeper reads the module, plays all NPCs and guards clues while code rolls dice for checks, damage and sanity; rules, setting and characters pack into a shareable bundle

entries.note_en: Built-in CoC 7e and D&D 5e SRD, bilingual Chinese/English; can import SillyTavern character cards and add AI teammates; desktop client is at 1A7432/loreweaver-studio; install script pulls the latest dev version by default

entries.name: Smart-Memory
entries.desc: ST 多层记忆扩展：自动抽取角色事实、关系史、各角色知道的信息与秘密、实体状态、场景史、故事弧和滚动摘要，按预算注入上下文
entries.desc_en: ST layered memory extension: automatically extracts character facts, relationship history, what each character knows and their secrets, entity state, scene history, story arcs and a rolling summary, injected into context within a budget
entries.note: 需单独配置记忆用 LLM，可选 Ollama embeddings；群聊中每个角色有独立记忆
entries.note_en: Needs a separately configured memory LLM, optional Ollama embeddings; in group chats each character has its own memory

entries.name: hordestudio
entries.desc: 本地 AI 角色扮演工作室：角色卡与群聊房间、带地点和后果的持久世界、可选 RPG 规则与多人团，另有按日程、需求、关系推演生活的虚拟人
entries.desc_en: Local AI roleplay studio: character cards and group chat rooms, persistent worlds with places and consequences, optional RPG rules and multiplayer, plus virtual people living by schedule, needs and relations
entries.note: SillyTavern 式角色卡 + AI Dungeon 式世界；含虚拟人陪伴模块；仓库无许可证
entries.note_en: SillyTavern-style character cards + AI Dungeon-style worlds; includes a virtual-companion module; no license

entries.name: covel
entries.desc: 插件化 AI RPG 框架：叙事、NPC、设定、建卡各为插件 agent，世界包打包设定与规则，回合后投影共享事实层 WorldIR，隐藏事件按条件触发
entries.desc_en: Plugin-based AI RPG framework: narrative, NPC, setting and character creation as plugin agents, world packs bundle rules, a WorldIR fact layer updates each turn, hidden events fire on conditions
entries.note: 早期版本，存档格式常有破坏性变更；另有视觉小说式舞台模式
entries.note_en: Early version, save format often has breaking changes; also has a visual-novel-style stage mode

entries.name: vina
entries.desc: 一句提示生成整部视觉小说：GPT 先出情节、带性格的人物和地点，再按场景写对白并配表情，SD 画背景，打包成可玩的 Ren'Py 工程
entries.desc_en: Generates a whole visual novel from one prompt: GPT first produces plot, characters with personalities and locations, then writes dialogue per scene with expressions, SD draws backgrounds, packaged as a playable Ren'Py project
entries.note: 黑客松作品；需 OpenAI API、本地 SD WebUI 和 Ren'Py
entries.note_en: Hackathon project; needs OpenAI API, a local SD WebUI and Ren'Py

entries.name: ai-murder-mystery
entries.desc: AI 剧本杀：每个角色是有人格、记忆和秘密的独立 agent，回复经生成→批评→修订防泄露；剧本编辑器支持 AI 辅助创作与质检，另有证物系统
entries.desc_en: AI murder-mystery game: each character is an independent agent with personality, memory and secrets, replies go generate, critique, revise to prevent leaks; script editor with AI help and QA, evidence system
entries.note: 基于 ironman5366/ai-murder-mystery-hackathon（防泄露机制来自原版），新增自定义剧本编辑器、质检和证物系统；许可证 NOASSERTION；配图需火山引擎
entries.note_en: Based on ironman5366/ai-murder-mystery-hackathon (leak prevention comes from the original), adding a custom script editor, QA and evidence system; license NOASSERTION; illustrations need Volcano Engine

entries.name: RPGraph
entries.desc: 本地角色扮演工作室：节点工作流把每轮拆成翻译、扮演、说话人标注、故事时间、事件等独立 LLM 调用，Storybook 助手生成场景人物，带角色手机应用
entries.desc_en: Local roleplay studio: a node workflow splits each turn into separate LLM calls for translation, acting, speaker tagging, story time and events, a Storybook assistant generates scene characters, and there is an in-world character phone app
entries.note: 默认工作流按 Gemma 4 31B 调校，模型需稳定输出 JSON；含成人向社交应用；可选 ComfyUI 生图配音
entries.note_en: Default workflow is tuned for Gemma 4 31B and the model must output JSON reliably; includes an adult-oriented social app; optional ComfyUI image and voice generation

entries.name: ChatGPT-Adventure

entries.desc_en: Initial prompt that makes ChatGPT act as a mainframe text-adventure program: it specifies two-way room connections, containers, keys and locked doors, search, inventory and combat commands, and the model generates the world on the fly
entries.note: 只有提示词和游玩记录（另含让 ChatGPT 下国际象棋的提示词）；写于 2022-12
entries.note_en: Only prompts and play logs (plus a prompt for ChatGPT to play chess); written 2022-12

entries.name: Project_Infinity
entries.desc: 5e 规则跑团：规则引擎掷骰结算并写机制面板，LLM 只写叙事；开局生成四王国政治世界或时间旅行设定，带角色锻造和战斗追踪

entries.note: 需 Ollama Cloud 或 Gemini；Gemini Key 解锁配图；基于 D&D SRD 5.1
entries.note_en: Needs Ollama Cloud or Gemini; a Gemini key unlocks illustrations; based on D&D SRD 5.1

entries.name: noras-tavern
entries.desc: 基于 SillyTavern 的角色扮演应用：以世界组织角色、会话与世界书，剧情账本记长线进展，Nora agent 经 MCP 管理世界、角色与记忆
entries.desc_en: SillyTavern-based roleplay app: organizes characters, sessions and world books by world, a plot ledger records long-run progress, and the Nora agent manages worlds, characters and memory through MCP
entries.note: 基于 SillyTavern 二次开发，兼容角色卡/世界书生态；Nora 需 Hermes Agent 与 IM 平台，只装酒馆也可游玩；安装包未签名
entries.note_en: A SillyTavern derivative compatible with its character card / world book ecosystem; Nora needs Hermes Agent and an IM platform, the tavern alone is playable; installer is unsigned

entries.name: open-dungeon-master
entries.desc: AI 地下城主跑 D&D 5e：模型叙事并扮演 NPC，按隐藏故事主线（前提、赌注、反派）推进并随战役重生成，骰子与数值全由服务端规则引擎结算，支持多人
entries.desc_en: AI dungeon master for D&D 5e: the model narrates and plays NPCs along a hidden story spine (premise, stakes, villain) regenerated with the campaign; a server rules engine handles dice and numbers; multiplayer
entries.note: 基于 newideas99/open-dungeon 扩展而来；可用 Claude Code / Codex / opencode / Grok Build 订阅当叙事者

entries.name: project-lunar

entries.name: AnyWorld

entries.name: GameMasterAI

entries.name: interactive-fiction-skill
entries.desc: 选项驱动互动小说：每轮写一段正文并给 A–E 五个选项，角色卡还原人设，自动存档记录好感与支线，设定核对和伏笔回收保长线一致

entries.name: Qiuerjun/storyforge-ai

entries.note_en: Compatible with OpenAI API and local Ollama

entries.name: yikes

entries.desc_en: Context engineering spec for text adventures: state in system/character/world layers, LLM returns narration, effects and actions as fixed JSON, validated effects write back, Node.js implementation
entries.note: 参考实现需本地 Ollama
entries.note_en: Reference implementation needs local Ollama

entries.name: ai-text-adventure
entries.desc: 选择式文字冒险：AI 先生成可选角色的特质和背景，每段剧情附 2–4 个带风险等级的选项，每段压成摘要（位置、物品、关系）供后文保持连贯

entries.note_en: Bring your own OpenAI key, DALL·E for images; README is minimal, the method is in the prompts under src/hooks

entries.name: ChatRPG
entries.desc: C# Blazor 选择冒险游戏：叙事者、档案员、检查者、导航者、书记员等 ReAct agent 分工，LLM 当主持人推进战斗、NPC 与任务

entries.name: ghostpad

entries.desc_en: Mobile-first rework of KoboldAI: continues the story at the cursor, with memory, author's notes and world info entries stored in a library and assembled into scenes and characters, plus voice input/output and live editing
entries.note: 基于 KoboldAI/KoboldAI-Client；跑本地模型（支持 Llama.cpp、AutoAWQ）；仓库带上游的安装脚本和 umamba.exe
entries.note_en: Based on KoboldAI/KoboldAI-Client; runs local models (supports Llama.cpp, AutoAWQ); repo includes the upstream install scripts and umamba.exe

entries.name: gpt-adventures
entries.desc: 文字冒险引擎：GPT 先生成含标题、情节、玩家、带出口的地点和物品的游戏结构，基础指令由引擎处理，其余行动交给模型当 GM 并改写游戏状态
entries.desc_en: Text adventure engine: GPT first generates a game structure (title, plot, player, locations with exits, items); the engine handles basic commands, the model acts as GM for the rest and rewrites game state

entries.name: VerseCraft
entries.desc: 自由输入行动的互动小说引擎：回合路由先查世界知识与角色认知边界，模型生成叙事候选后经校验提交状态增量，后台世界导演推进 NPC 议程
entries.desc_en: Free-text interactive fiction engine: turn routing checks world knowledge and each character's knowledge boundary, narrative candidates are validated before state deltas commit, a background world director advances NPC agendas

entries.note_en: Example world is Chinese suspense horror; full operation needs PostgreSQL and Redis

entries.name: ai-death-game
entries.desc: 5 个不同人设的 AI 代理在死亡游戏里辩论、投票互相淘汰，主持人播报流程，玩家以 GM 身份插话下指令、投票或强制淘汰来改变走向

entries.note: 需自备 Gemini API key，浏览器直连；README 日英双语

entries.name: AIDscripts
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 场景脚本合集：Encounters 按条件向故事注入动态事件，RPGmech 加入属性与技能检定，另有维持角色形态的上下文注释等工具
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon scenario scripts: Encounters injects conditional dynamic events, RPGmech adds attributes and skill checks, plus tools such as context notes that keep character form
entries.note: 需在 AI Dungeon 场景脚本中使用；合集里也有改写文字风格的玩笑脚本；附带的 zip 是可直接导入的脚本包，同仓有 JS 源码

entries.note_en: Tuned for a fully local AMD Strix Halo stack (llama.cpp, FLUX, Maya1 TTS), deployed with docker-compose

entries.name: velvet-ascent-skill

entries.name: rekallhalo

entries.name: RPG-AI-Assistant
entries.desc: 本地小模型跑文字 RPG：每轮拆成多阶段短提示，先取场上物件描述，再让每个 NPC 单独定意图后合成场景，按物件存取联想式长期记忆，加随机事件
entries.desc_en: Text RPG on small local models: each turn split into short staged prompts, first fetching object descriptions in the scene, then each NPC decides intent separately before the scene is composed, with associative memory and random events
entries.note: 需 LM Studio 和支持 Tools/Thinking 的模型（Qwen 3.5 9B、Gemma-4 等）；支持 spec-v3 角色卡；俄/英双语
entries.note_en: Needs LM Studio and a model supporting Tools/Thinking (Qwen 3.5 9B, Gemma-4 and others); supports spec-v3 character cards; Russian and English

entries.name: Dungeo_ai_lan_play
entries.desc: 本地 Ollama 多人回合制跑团：2–5 人建角选题材，AI 当 DM 叙事，世界追踪器记录 NPC、阵营和行动后果，世界状态永久变化并可存档
entries.desc_en: Local Ollama multiplayer turn-based TRPG: 2-5 players create characters and pick a genre, the AI acts as DM narrating, a world tracker records NPCs, factions and consequences of actions, and world state changes permanently and can be saved
entries.note: 需本地 Ollama，可选 AllTalk TTS 语音；仅局域网多人；同作者另有单人版 Laszlobeer/Dungeo_ai
entries.note_en: Needs local Ollama, optional AllTalk TTS voice; LAN multiplayer only; the same author has a single-player version, Laszlobeer/Dungeo_ai

entries.name: DUNGEON_ARCHITECT
entries.desc: 酒馆无限流副本生成：按主题/评级/人数/PVE-PVP 参数生成表层与真相分离的副本大纲（机制、NPC、Boss、反转埋点），注入世界书供 AI 推剧情
entries.desc_en: SillyTavern infinite-flow dungeon generator: from theme/rating/headcount/PVE-PVP parameters builds outlines with surface and hidden truth (mechanics, NPCs, boss, twists) injected as a world book
entries.note: SillyTavern 酒馆助手脚本（导入 JSON）；作者推荐 Gemini 2.5/3.1 Pro；未声明许可证
entries.note_en: SillyTavern Tavern Helper script (import JSON); author recommends Gemini 2.5/3.1 Pro; no license declared

entries.name: fanfic-roleplay-design
entries.desc: 同人角色扮演设计：联网整理原作资料，生成或合并 SillyTavern 世界书，分还原模式与人物模式，可按主线阶段配置 MVU 变量
entries.desc_en: Fan fiction roleplay design: researches source material online, generates or merges SillyTavern lorebooks in faithful or character modes, MVU variables configurable by main-plot stage
entries.note: 产物是 SillyTavern 世界书 JSON；MVU/EJS 功能需预装 Tavern Helper 与 MVU
entries.note_en: Output is a SillyTavern lorebook JSON; MVU/EJS features need Tavern Helper and MVU preinstalled

entries.name: RyokanApp
entries.desc: Windows/Android 互动故事客户端：导入 V3 角色卡与关联 lorebook，可克隆分支对话、切换玩家身份，房主出模型、好友用浏览器加入多人共写
entries.desc_en: Windows/Android interactive story client: imports V3 character cards and lorebooks, clonable branching chats, player identity switching; host supplies the model, friends join by browser to co-write
entries.note: 本地模型或 API；多人房间端到端加密
entries.note_en: Local models or API; multiplayer rooms are end-to-end encrypted

entries.name: text-rpg-adventure
entries.desc: C# 控制台 D&D 文字冒险：创建角色后掷骰决定场景、敌人和目标，分四章调用 OpenAI 生成冒险，配背包、属性和战斗模拟
entries.desc_en: C# console D&D text adventure: after creating a character, dice rolls decide scenes, enemies and goals, OpenAI generates the adventure over four chapters, with inventory, stats and combat simulation
entries.note: README 只有一句，方法要看代码；个人练习性质
entries.note_en: README is one sentence, read the code for the method; personal practice project

entries.name: chasm
entries.desc: 生成式文字冒险：世界是一个 markdown 文件的 git 仓库，叙事者经 pi harness 读写地点、人物、事件状态，跨会话持久，可分发给他人续玩
entries.desc_en: Generative text adventure: the world is a git repo of markdown files, the narrator reads and writes locations, characters and event state via the pi harness, persisting across sessions and shareable
entries.note: 需支持工具调用的模型；作者旧版 chasm_client 已归档
entries.note_en: Needs a model with tool calling; the author's older chasm_client is archived

entries.name: multiverse
entries.desc: 生成文学原型：读者与 GPT-3 对话式续写并分叉，在交互式空间地图上浏览、回溯已探索的文本分支，是硕士论文和 IoT'20 论文的配套代码
entries.desc_en: Generative literature prototype: the reader continues and forks a conversation with GPT-3, browsing and revisiting explored text branches on an interactive spatial map; code accompanying a master's thesis and an IoT'20 paper
entries.note: 需 OpenAI key；旧版本地模型 client-server 版本见 README 指定的 commit
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI key; the older local-model client-server version is at the commit specified in the README

entries.name: The-Endless-Tale
entries.desc: 目标驱动的互动小说引擎：故事按 JSON 目标清单推进，评估玩家行动是否完成目标；每个角色独立思考并自行决定进出场景，世界状态随时间推移变化
entries.desc_en: Goal-driven interactive fiction engine: story advances along a JSON goal list, judging whether player actions meet goals; each character thinks independently and enters or leaves scenes; world state evolves
entries.note: 需 Google Gemini API（建议两把 key 并行）；每轮约 40 秒
entries.note_en: Needs a Google Gemini API (two keys in parallel recommended); about 40 seconds per turn

entries.name: world-walker
entries.desc: 互动小说规则核心+MCP：玩家行动交给 85+ 学术公式结算战斗/交易/社交/业力，Agent 只做文学转写；三层记忆撑长局，兼容酒馆角色卡与世界书
entries.desc_en: Interactive fiction rules core + MCP: player actions settle combat/trade/social/karma via 85+ academic formulas while the Agent only renders prose; three-layer memory, tavern card/world book compatible
entries.note: 示例设定为修仙世界
entries.note_en: Example setting is a cultivation world

entries.name: chronicles-of-chaos
entries.desc: 三国互动叙事 RPG：LLM 理解行动并叙事，本地结构化状态校验写回人物/势力/领地事实，NPC 分层记忆且离屏行动，战斗先规则结算再叙述
entries.desc_en: Three Kingdoms interactive RPG: LLM interprets actions and narrates, local structured state validates and writes back person/faction/territory facts, NPCs have layered memory and offscreen actions, rules resolve combat first
entries.note: 目前只有三国世界包；代码 AGPL，叙事素材 CC BY-NC-SA
entries.note_en: Only a Three Kingdoms world pack so far; code is AGPL, narrative material is CC BY-NC-SA

entries.name: dungeongod-agi
entries.desc: 通用 AI 地下城主：用 YAML 定义规则、冒险模组、角色队伍和提示词，模型按规则主持并记住玩家，支持多套游戏
entries.desc_en: General-purpose AI dungeon master: rules, adventure modules, character parties and prompts are defined in YAML, and the model runs the game by the rules and remembers players, supporting multiple games
entries.note: README 只有两句，方法要看 data/games 下的模组、规则和提示词文件；含微调脚本
entries.note_en: README is two sentences; the method is in the modules, rules and prompt files under data/games; includes fine-tuning scripts

entries.name: Infinite-RPG
entries.desc: 网页无限 RPG：Gemini 生成世界地图、地点描述、遭遇和社交场景，日志系统记录任务和隐藏叙事 flag，让之前的选择影响后续事件
entries.desc_en: Web infinite RPG: Gemini generates world map, location descriptions, encounters and social scenes, a log records quests and hidden narrative flags so earlier choices affect later events
entries.note: vibe coding 作品，Google AI Studio 应用；需 Gemini API；含回合制战斗和像素头像生成
entries.note_en: Vibe-coded Google AI Studio app; needs a Gemini API; includes turn-based combat and pixel avatar generation

entries.name: taleweave-ai
entries.desc: 文字冒险/MUD 引擎：一句话生成世界，LLM 角色按计划→行动轮次自主模拟，追踪情绪、饥渴、天气等状态，用行动摘要和笔记促成涌现剧情，可接 Discord
entries.desc_en: Text adventure/MUD engine: world from one line, LLM characters simulate in plan-then-act rounds tracking mood, hunger, weather; action summaries and notes give emergent plots; Discord support
entries.note: 支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI 兼容接口；可选 ComfyUI 出图
entries.note_en: Supports Ollama and OpenAI-compatible interfaces; optional ComfyUI image generation

entries.name: True-Auto-Stats-for-AIDungeon-RPG-Scenarios
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 场景脚本：根据玩家输入和 AI 输出自动建立并更新属性、背包、技能、伤病、饥饿等状态，存进故事卡再转述给模型，限制玩家全能
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon scenario script: builds and updates stats, inventory, skills, injuries and hunger from player input and AI output, stores them in story cards and relays them to the model
entries.note: 粘贴到 AI Dungeon 脚本编辑器的四个钩子中使用
entries.note_en: Paste into the four hooks of the AI Dungeon script editor

entries.name: BetterDungeon
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 浏览器扩展：给冒险加笔记、剧情和角色预设、Story Card 扫描分析，Navigator 助手读冒险上下文后提出可审阅的设定修改
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon browser extension: adds notes, plot and character presets to adventures and Story Card scanning and analysis; a Navigator assistant reads the adventure context and proposes reviewable setting changes
entries.note: 依附 AI Dungeon 使用，Navigator 等 AI 功能需自备模型 key；source-available 许可，不是 OSI 开源
entries.note_en: Works only on top of AI Dungeon; Navigator and other AI features need your own model key; source-available license, not OSI open source

entries.name: DungeonGPT-JS
entries.desc: AI 地下城主网页 RPG：骰点、战斗和战役里程碑由确定性引擎裁决，AI 只负责叙述结果；程序生成世界与城镇，RAG 检索历史剧情保持记忆
entries.desc_en: AI dungeon master web RPG: dice, combat and campaign milestones adjudicated by a deterministic engine while the AI narrates; procedural worlds and towns, RAG retrieval of past plot for memory
entries.note: 基于同作者 Python 版 EdwardAThomson/DungeonGPT；线上版有会员分级
entries.note_en: Based on the same author's Python version EdwardAThomson/DungeonGPT; the online version has membership tiers

entries.name: living-story-world
entries.desc: 持续世界的配图章节生成：用知识图谱记住人物、地点和剧情线，玩家选择影响后续章节，文本与插图模型分别可换
entries.desc_en: Illustrated chapter generation for a persistent world: a knowledge graph remembers characters, places and plotlines, player choices affect later chapters, and text and image models are swappable separately
entries.note: 默认本地 Ollama，可选 Gemini/Groq/OpenRouter 等；配图可接 ComfyUI/AI Horde
entries.note_en: Local Ollama by default, optional Gemini/Groq/OpenRouter and others; illustrations can use ComfyUI/AI Horde

entries.name: Story-Arc-Engine
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 脚本：每隔设定回合调用 AI 生成由关键事件组成的故事弧，写进作者笔记持续引导叙事，失败自动重试，故事弧可在故事卡里查看和修改
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon script: every set number of turns the AI generates a story arc of key events, written into author's notes to steer the narrative, auto-retries on failure, editable in story cards
entries.note: 需在 AI Dungeon 平台作为场景脚本使用；作者标注 WIP；仓库未声明许可证
entries.note_en: Must be used as a scenario script on the AI Dungeon platform; author marks it WIP; no license declared

entries.name: TRPG-AI-DM
entries.desc: 单人跑团 AI 主持：导入剧本后生成世界状态与知识图谱，主 DM 分派规则/战斗/记忆/图谱子 Agent，DM 与玩家信息隔离，后台定期推进剧情
entries.desc_en: Solo tabletop RPG AI GM: imports a scenario, builds world state and a knowledge graph, a main DM dispatches rules / combat / memory / graph sub-agents, DM and player information isolated, a background process advances the plot
entries.note: 内置 D&D 5e/4e、COC 7e 规则；长期记忆带衰减与遗忘，可选 BGE-M3 / pgvector
entries.note_en: Built-in D&D 5e/4e and COC 7e rules; long-term memory has decay and forgetting, optional BGE-M3 / pgvector

entries.name: yumina-oss
entries.desc: AI 原生互动小说引擎：世界文件声明世界书条目、类型化变量、规则与反应、空间/战斗/社交模拟系统，模型只发指令由引擎改状态，配会话记忆与分支回滚
entries.desc_en: AI-native interactive fiction engine: world files declare world book entries, typed variables, rules and reactions, and spatial/combat/social simulation; the model only issues commands and the engine changes state, with memory and rollback
entries.note: 起源于 SillyTavern 分支，现为独立引擎；AGPL-3.0；托管版 yumina.io
entries.note_en: Originated from a SillyTavern fork, now an independent engine; AGPL-3.0; hosted version at yumina.io

entries.name: delvewright
entries.desc: 故事提示→Minecraft 冒险地图：agent 写世界/NPC/任务计划等 schema 文档，人确认设计后编译，静态遍历任务路径并让机器人通关验证
entries.desc_en: Story prompt to Minecraft adventure map: an agent writes schema documents for world / NPC / quest plans, a human confirms the design before compiling, then quest paths are statically traversed and a bot plays through to verify
entries.note: 产物是 Minecraft Java 原版数据包而非文本小说；需 Python 3.11+、Java 21+、Docker
entries.note_en: Output is a vanilla Minecraft Java datapack, not a text novel; needs Python 3.11+, Java 21+, Docker

entries.name: dmcp
entries.desc: AI 主持人用的 MCP 服务：170 个工具管理规则、世界、角色、任务、派系、秘密、时间和叙事日志，开局访谈后由 agent 设计规则并主持冒险
entries.desc_en: MCP server for AI game masters: 170 tools manage rules, worlds, characters, quests, factions, secrets, time and a narrative log; after an opening interview the agent designs rules and runs the adventure
entries.note: 内置 HTTP Web UI 看角色卡和地图；含图片存储与 NPC 语音描述，支持多 agent 协作
entries.note_en: Built-in HTTP Web UI for viewing character sheets and maps; includes image storage and NPC voice descriptions, supports multi-agent collaboration

entries.name: freytag-forge
entries.desc: 作者用 Markdown 写有弧线的故事，引擎记录物件、位置和状态充当裁判，LLM 叙事者回应玩家任意行动；秘密要靠行动解锁，时钟持续推进
entries.desc_en: Authors write an arc-shaped story in Markdown, the engine tracks objects, locations and state as referee, an LLM narrator answers any player action; secrets unlock only through action, clocks advance

entries.name: Hashtag-DnD
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 场景脚本：用 # 命令管理队伍角色属性与传记、背包、骰子检定、回合战斗、地点地图和不占上下文的笔记，可开 Auto-Cards 记忆卡
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon scenario script: # commands manage party character stats and bios, inventory, dice checks, turn-based combat, location maps and notes that take no context space, with optional Auto-Cards memory cards
entries.note: 叙事由 AI Dungeon 平台模型完成；集成 LewdLeah 的 Auto-Cards；另含卡牌等小游戏
entries.note_en: Narration is done by the AI Dungeon platform model; integrates LewdLeah's Auto-Cards; also includes mini-games such as cards

entries.name: openovel
entries.desc: 互动小说双循环：前台叙事者只管流式出正文，后台 Showrunner、导演、世界、记忆等 agent 异步读回合，改写 Markdown/JSON 状态文件
entries.desc_en: Interactive fiction with two loops: a front-end narrator only streams prose while background Showrunner, director, world and memory agents asynchronously read turns and rewrite Markdown/JSON state files
entries.note: beta；不用向量库，故事状态全是普通文件；Electron 桌面版
entries.note_en: Beta; no vector store, story state is plain files; Electron desktop version

entries.name: UnscriptedAdventures
entries.desc: 5e 风格文字 RPG：先建角色（特质、职业、背景），LLM 主持人和 NPC 随玩家选择推进剧情，奖励系统评估玩家投入度并调整主持策略
entries.desc_en: 5e-style text RPG: build a character first (traits, class, background), an LLM host and NPCs advance the story with the player's choices, and a reward system evaluates player engagement and adjusts hosting strategy
entries.note: 作者标注 Alpha 阶段
entries.note_en: The author marks it Alpha

entries.name: Dungeo-ai-new
entries.desc: Ollama 终端文字冒险：选题材和角色后，DM 提示强制「行动→即时后果」，先分析玩家动作的动词和力度再注入题材规则续写，可存档和重抽
entries.desc_en: Ollama terminal text adventure: after picking genre and character, the DM prompt enforces "action then immediate consequence", analyzes the verb and force of the player's action, then injects genre rules to continue; save and reroll
entries.note: 作者旧版为 Laszlobeer/-Dungeo_ai-otudated-
entries.note_en: The author's old version is Laszlobeer/-Dungeo_ai-otudated-

entries.name: InteractiveFilm-CharacterDailyAgent
entries.desc: 角色卡→Gemini 规划带精力和心情的全天日程→生成事件（R 级简单选择、SR 级多段分支）→导演分镜脚本→调用生图和视频模型演出
entries.desc_en: Character card, then Gemini plans a full-day schedule with energy and mood, generates events (simple choices to multi-part branches), a director's storyboard, and calls image/video models to stage it
entries.note: 需 Gemini 和 nano_banana/seedream、sora2/kling 等图像视频 API；含亲密度养成，偏虚拟角色日常
entries.note_en: Needs Gemini and image/video APIs such as nano_banana/seedream and sora2/kling; includes affection-raising mechanics, leans toward virtual character daily life

entries.name: SceneIntruderMCP
entries.desc: 故事工作台：把文本拆成场景、角色、物品和分支剧情供互动演绎，剧本模块生成初稿并逐章修订，场景还能转成漫画和视频
entries.desc_en: Story workbench: splits text into scenes, characters, items and branching plots for interactive performance, a script module generates a first draft and revises chapter by chapter, and scenes can be turned into comics and video
entries.note: Go + React；漫画、视频工作台占很大比重；需配置 LLM、图像、视频提供方
entries.note_en: Go + React; comic and video workbenches make up a large part; LLM, image and video providers must be configured

entries.name: StatefulLore
entries.desc: ST 状态化世界书：用 JS lore 模块保存数值、状态、地点与机制，每轮生成权威状态快照注入提示，模型只管写作不管记忆
entries.desc_en: Stateful world book for ST: JS lore modules store values, states, places and mechanics, an authoritative state snapshot is injected each turn, so the model writes and never manages memory
entries.note: 每个世界要写一个 JS 模块（附有让 AI 把现有世界书转成模块的指南）
entries.note_en: Each world needs a JS module written (a guide for having AI convert an existing world book into a module is included)

entries.name: Story-Editor
entries.desc: ST 连续性审稿扩展：独立编辑模型只审新写内容，提出状态、设定、人物认知、剧情线变更与带引文的矛盾警告，作者批准后才写入记忆
entries.desc_en: SillyTavern continuity review extension: an independent editor model reviews only new text, proposes state, setting, character knowledge and plotline changes plus quoted contradictions; nothing enters memory until the author approves
entries.note: alpha 版，需 SillyTavern ≥1.19
entries.note_en: Alpha version, needs SillyTavern 1.19 or later

entries.name: StoryWeaver-AI
entries.desc: 无限流互动小说：按题材开局逐章生成 300–500 字并给选项，边缘函数注入文风指导、禁词过滤和上下文一致性校验，读者阅读时预生成后续分支
entries.desc_en: Infinite-flow interactive fiction: opens by genre and generates 300-500 character chapters with choices, edge functions inject style guidance, banned-word filtering and consistency checks, later branches pre-generated while the reader reads
entries.note: 阿里云 ESA 活动作品；依赖通义千问、通义万相和 ESA 边缘函数
entries.note_en: Entry for an Alibaba Cloud ESA contest; depends on Tongyi Qianwen, Tongyi Wanxiang and ESA edge functions

entries.name: theatre
entries.desc: 历史“见证引擎”：结局不可改，玩家只改变在场姿态（旁观→发问→联结→共鸣）四态状态机，姿态决定人物说什么，按条件注入史实彩蛋，剧本用 yaml 扩展
entries.desc_en: Historical "witness engine": the ending cannot change, the player only changes presence posture in a four-state machine (watch, ask, connect, resonate) that decides what characters say; conditional historical easter eggs; yaml scripts
entries.note: 目前只有一个剧本（盛唐 744，李白杜甫）；2026-04-14 后未更新，因机制少见而收
entries.note_en: Only one script so far (High Tang 744, Li Bai and Du Fu); not updated since 2026-04-14, included for its rare mechanism

entries.name: chungs10/dnd-ai
entries.desc: 本地 D&D 主持人实验：mem0 + ChromaDB 存角色与世界的长期记忆，掷骰、战斗等规则走确定性函数调用，提示模板维持人设和世界观
entries.desc_en: Local D&D dungeon master experiment: mem0 + ChromaDB long-term memory of characters and world, dice and combat as deterministic function calls, prompt templates maintaining personas and worldbuilding
entries.note: 学生课程项目，多份实验脚本并存；需本地 Ollama（Qwen3:8B）；README 安装命令里的仓库名写错了
entries.note_en: Student course project with several experiment scripts side by side; needs local Ollama (Qwen3:8B); the repo name in the README install command is wrong

entries.name: Cyber-Eros.skill
entries.desc: 沉浸式角色扮演 skill 套件：从小说蒸馏设定与文风或由种子生成世界，导演引擎监测剧情停滞时注入变量，记忆归档折叠上下文并存读档
entries.desc_en: Immersive roleplay skill suite: distills setting and style from a novel or generates a world from a seed, a director engine injects variables when the plot stalls, memory archive folds context and saves/loads
entries.note: 成人内容（NSFW 角色扮演）；一键安装是 curl | bash / irm | iex 远程脚本
entries.note_en: Adult content (NSFW roleplay); one-click install is a curl | bash / irm | iex remote script

entries.name: GameMaster-GPT
entries.desc: 命令行 AI 跑团 GM：读入角色卡文本，按角色生成冒险前提，玩家掷骰由程序结算后回报 GM，附对话压缩脚本控制上下文长度
entries.desc_en: Command-line AI TRPG GM: reads character card text, generates a premise per character, player dice rolls resolved by the program and reported to the GM, dialogue compression script limits context

entries.name: interactive-novel
entries.desc: 把小说片段变成可游玩的互动故事：提取世界状态和人物，用户扮演其中角色，系统接管 NPC 与世界反应，带分层记忆和存读档
entries.desc_en: Turns a novel excerpt into a playable interactive story: extracts world state and characters, the user plays a character while the system takes over NPCs and world reactions, with layered memory and save/load
entries.note: skill 在 interactive-novel/ 子目录；附 state-helper.js（Node）做存读档和一致性检查；含 NSFW 协议
entries.note_en: The skill is in the interactive-novel/ subdirectory; includes state-helper.js (Node) for save/load and consistency checks; includes an NSFW protocol

entries.name: OpenCrawlEngine
entries.desc: 本地单人 RPG 引擎：LLM 主持人通过结构化工具调用叙事和驱动世界，属性、战斗、检定、势力、产业等由确定性规则引擎结算，战役存 SQLite
entries.desc_en: Local single-player RPG engine: an LLM host narrates and drives the world via structured tool calls, a deterministic rules engine settles stats, combat, checks, factions and industry, campaigns saved in SQLite
entries.note: C++ / Dear ImGui 桌面程序；Releases 有 AppImage/deb，源码可自行构建
entries.note_en: C++ / Dear ImGui desktop program; Releases have AppImage/deb, or build from source

entries.name: tracyhill-rp
entries.desc: 自托管多人长篇 RP 客户端：按战役持久化会话，维护结构化世界状态，系统提示词做版本管理，对话中途可切换十家模型
entries.desc_en: Self-hosted multiplayer long-form RP client: persists sessions per campaign, maintains structured world state, versions system prompts, and can switch between ten model providers mid-conversation
entries.note: 可直接登录自己的 Claude / ChatGPT 订阅使用
entries.note_en: Can log in directly with your own Claude / ChatGPT subscription

entries.name: venger
entries.desc: GPT 跑团式选择冒险：先按提示生成世界和角色，再按 d20 规则推进玩家行动，每步给出选项
entries.desc_en: GPT tabletop-style choose-your-own adventure: generates the world and characters from a prompt, then advances player actions by d20 rules, offering options at each step
entries.note: 已停止维护（仓库已归档）
entries.note_en: Unmaintained (repo archived)

entries.name: AI-Game-From-Story
entries.desc: 把任意小说 txt 抽取成世界书再转成 MUD 式互动游戏：状态层 JSON 记录世界真相，提示词由世界书、状态、滑动窗口和长期记忆组装
entries.desc_en: Extracts any novel txt into a world book and turns it into a MUD-style interactive game: a state-layer JSON records the world truth, and prompts are assembled from the world book, state, a sliding window and long-term memory
entries.note: 自带示例游戏《剑起归墟》，可导出单文件 HTML5
entries.note_en: Ships with the sample game Sword Rising over Guixu (剑起归墟), exportable as a single-file HTML5

entries.name: AI-TRPG-Demo
entries.desc: DeepSeek 当跑团主持人：规则插件（COC/VHS 等）定义状态栏、技能判定和专属提示模板，状态管理跟踪玩家数值，附三套剧本和语音播报
entries.desc_en: DeepSeek as TRPG host: rule plugins (COC/VHS etc.) define status bars, skill checks and prompt templates, state management tracks player stats, with three scenarios and voice narration
entries.note: 需要 DeepSeek API
entries.note_en: Needs a DeepSeek API

entries.name: AiChatTrpg
entries.desc: 导入规则书 PDF 和模组跑团：预处理→生成→后处理三段流水线，结构化 JSON 场景/NPC/剧情线加压缩叙事双记忆，预掷骰池使检定可审计
entries.desc_en: Runs tabletop RPGs from an imported rulebook PDF and module: pre-process, generate, post-process pipeline, structured JSON scene/NPC/plot memory plus compressed narrative, pre-rolled auditable dice pool
entries.note: Pre-alpha；需 PostgreSQL；仓库里的 .agents/skills 是开发流程用的，不是创作 skill
entries.note_en: Pre-alpha; needs PostgreSQL; .agents/skills in the repo is for the development workflow, not a writing skill

entries.name: dreamengine
entries.desc: LLM 角色扮演模拟引擎：维护物品位置、角色特质/隐藏状态/触发器、羁绊关系和世界规则，角色只知道亲历之事，上下文动态压缩
entries.desc_en: LLM roleplay simulation engine: tracks item locations, character traits/hidden state/triggers, bonds and world rules, characters only know what they experienced, context compressed dynamically
entries.note: WIP，Electron 应用，面向 llama.cpp / vLLM 本地模型；支持条件化 NSFW 内容
entries.note_en: WIP, Electron app for local llama.cpp / vLLM models; supports conditional NSFW content

entries.name: ITMO-Agentic-AI/ai-dungeon-master
entries.desc: LangGraph 八 agent 跑 D&D：故事架构师规划节拍，DM 叙述，世界引擎、规则裁判、动作结算、传说构建分工，共享一个 GameState
entries.desc_en: LangGraph D&D with eight agents: a story architect plans beats, the DM narrates, and a world engine, rules referee, action resolver and lore builder split the work around one shared GameState
entries.note: Chainlit 界面；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容接口；仓库未声明许可证
entries.note_en: Chainlit UI; supports any OpenAI-compatible API; license not declared in the repo

entries.name: llm-dungeon
entries.desc: 本地单人跑团：AI DM 维护持久世界记录和隐藏秘密，d100 由代码掷骰，可自写设定/剧本/角色或用冒险模板，英俄双语
entries.desc_en: Local solo tabletop RPG: an AI DM keeps a persistent world record and hidden secrets, d100 rolled by code, custom settings/scenarios/characters or adventure templates, English and Russian
entries.note: Node.js 免安装依赖；默认 Gemini，可接 OpenRouter/OpenAI/Anthropic/DeepSeek/xAI
entries.note_en: Node.js with no dependencies to install; defaults to Gemini, can connect to OpenRouter/OpenAI/Anthropic/DeepSeek/xAI

entries.name: MC-CIV
entries.desc: Minecraft 服务器里的 AI 叙事：世界叙事者轮询服务器状态，触发天气、刷怪和剧情广播；LLM 驱动的 NPC 群体带三层记忆自主行动、与玩家对话
entries.desc_en: AI narrative inside a Minecraft server: a world narrator polls server state to trigger weather, mob spawns and plot broadcasts; LLM-driven NPC groups with three-layer memory act on their own and talk to players
entries.note: 早期 alpha；需自建 Minecraft Java 服务器（RCON）和 Node.js Mineflayer；大部分代码是机器人行动能力，叙事者部分较轻
entries.note_en: Early alpha; needs your own Minecraft Java server (RCON) and Node.js Mineflayer; most of the code is bot action capability, the narrator part is light

entries.name: payador
entries.desc: ICCC 论文代码：把 LLM 落到结构化世界（物品、角色、地点）上，先预测玩家输入引起的世界状态变换，再据新状态生成叙事
entries.desc_en: Code for an ICCC paper: grounds an LLM in a structured world (items, characters, locations), first predicting the world-state change from player input, then generating narrative from the new state
entries.note: 默认 Gemini API；预置英语/西语世界
entries.note_en: Defaults to the Gemini API; ships English/Spanish worlds

entries.name: speckit-preset-game-narrative-writing
entries.desc: Spec Kit 游戏叙事预设：叙事简报→故事地图→对白与场景写作任务，支持分支、多结局、多视角与状态机，输出 Twine/Ink 并做校验
entries.desc_en: Spec Kit game narrative preset: narrative brief, story map, then dialogue and scene writing tasks, supporting branches, multiple endings and perspectives, state machines; outputs and validates Twine/Ink
entries.note: 需 GitHub Spec Kit ≥0.5.0；与 fiction-book-writing 同一作者
entries.note_en: Needs GitHub Spec Kit 0.5.0+; same author as fiction-book-writing

entries.name: thousand-lives
entries.desc: AI 文字人生模拟器：10 个剧本各有属性、事件池与结局，属性值落入命名状态作为硬指令注入 AI，选项或自写行动由 AI 裁定，也可一句主题生成新剧本
entries.desc_en: AI text life simulator: 10 scenarios with attributes, event pools and endings; attribute values fall into named states injected as hard instructions, the AI adjudicates choices or free actions, a theme sentence generates new scenarios
entries.note: 纯前端；免 Key 时用手写事件池，AI 模式自填 Key（24 家服务商预设）
entries.note_en: Pure front end; without a key it uses hand-written event pools, AI mode takes your own key (24 provider presets)

entries.name: tragedy-narrative-guard
entries.desc: 长会话角色扮演的爱情悲剧护栏：阻止模型甜化、过早修复冲突和无代价承诺，用终局锚点守住不圆满的结局方向，关键选择留给作者
entries.desc_en: Guardrail for love tragedies in long roleplay: stops the model from sweetening, resolving conflict too early or making costless promises, holds the unhappy ending with an ending anchor, and leaves key choices to the author

entries.name: ai-jubensha
entries.desc: AI 剧本杀：按主题生成完整剧本（角色背景、时间线、作案手法、线索网），DM/玩家/裁判/记录员多 Agent 主持搜证、讨论与投票，RAG 记忆
entries.desc_en: AI murder-mystery game: generates a full script by theme (character backgrounds, timeline, method, clue network), DM/player/judge/recorder agents host evidence search, discussion and voting, with RAG memory
entries.note: Spring Boot + LangChain4J + React
entries.note_en: Spring Boot + LangChain4J + React

entries.name: loom-engine
entries.desc: Rust 终端文字 RPG：玩家用自然语言行动，LLM 通过工具函数实时读写数值、标签特质和背包来推进叙事，建项目时写入世界设定
entries.desc_en: Rust terminal text RPG: the player acts in natural language, the LLM reads/writes stats, tag traits and inventory through tool functions to advance the narrative, with world setting written at project creation
entries.note: Releases 提供预编译二进制，仓库含源码；支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama
entries.note_en: Releases provide prebuilt binaries, repo has source; supports OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama

entries.name: ScrollWeaver
entries.desc: 从小说/设定文档用 RAG 抽取世界观、地点与人物，Orchestrator 按事件链调度场景，Performer 角色代理带记忆自主行动，玩家入场改写剧情
entries.desc_en: Extracts worldbuilding, locations and characters from novels via RAG; an Orchestrator schedules scenes along event chains, memory-bearing Performer agents act autonomously, players enter and rewrite the plot
entries.note: 2025 Soul AI Agent 大赛三等奖；内置三国、红楼梦等示例世界，另含狼人杀等社交推理玩法
entries.note_en: Third prize in the 2025 Soul AI Agent contest; ships example worlds such as Three Kingdoms and Dream of the Red Chamber, plus social deduction games such as Werewolf

entries.name: SillyStage
entries.desc: Rust 多 agent 互动叙事引擎：规划、架构、导演、演员、旁白、记录者分工，围绕故事图推进角色扮演剧情
entries.desc_en: Rust multi-agent interactive narrative engine: planner, architect, director, actors, narrator and recorder split the work, driving roleplay along a story graph
entries.note: README 只有构建说明，agent 分工见 AGENTS.md 和项目文档站
entries.note_en: README has only build instructions, agent division is in AGENTS.md and the project docs site

entries.name: story-collab-ai
entries.desc: Storium 式协作写作应用：叙事者用地点、人物、障碍卡布置场景，各角色由 AI agent 或真人认领并打出故事卡推进剧情，可异步多人参与
entries.desc_en: Storium-style collaborative writing app: a narrator sets scenes with place, character and obstacle cards, characters are claimed by AI agents or humans who play story cards, asynchronous multiplayer
entries.note: Flutter + Python；需 NVIDIA NIM API；Release 提供 exe，仓库含源码
entries.note_en: Flutter + Python; needs an NVIDIA NIM API; Releases provide an exe, repo has source

entries.name: WorldForge
entries.desc: LLM 主持的文字 RPG 沙盒：一句前提生成世界 DNA、势力与关键 NPC；状态变更先按规则结算留凭据，再由叙述者写正文，NPC 分层唤醒
entries.desc_en: LLM-hosted text RPG sandbox: one-line premise generates world DNA, factions and key NPCs; state changes are settled by rules with receipts first, then a narrator writes the prose, and NPCs wake in tiers

entries.name: ai-dungeon-scripts
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 脚本集：追踪时间推进、角色好感与记忆，隐藏任务分阶段触发加随机世界事件，SAE 模式把跑偏的剧情拉回当前任务阶段
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon script collection: tracks time passing, character affinity and memory, triggers hidden quests in stages plus random world events, and an SAE mode pulls drifting plots back to the current quest stage
entries.note: 粘贴进 AI Dungeon 的 Scripting 使用，叙事由平台模型完成；Auto Card 版会自动更新 Story Cards；隐藏任务模式作者标注仍在开发
entries.note_en: Paste into AI Dungeon's Scripting; narration is done by the platform's model; the Auto Card version auto-updates Story Cards; the author marks hidden-quest mode as still in development

entries.name: DeekSeek-V4-text-adventure-prompt-builder
entries.desc: 元提示词 skill：把世界观描述编译成文字冒险 DM 提示词，内嵌三幕蓝图、冲突预算与无聊度降阈、选择账本定期回调和每轮 think 自检
entries.desc_en: Meta-prompt skill compiling a worldbuilding description into a text adventure DM prompt, with three-act blueprint, conflict budget with lowered boredom threshold, a choice ledger that calls back periodically, and per-turn think self-check
entries.note: 针对 DeepSeek V4 调优；含后宫、福利等成人向模块
entries.note_en: Tuned for DeepSeek V4; includes adult modules such as harem and fan-service

entries.name: gemini-tales
entries.desc: 儿童互动童话：Gemini Live 叙事者边讲边配水彩插图，孩子完成真实动作挑战才继续；Agent 模式下由研究员、评审、故事匠多 agent 先编排剧本
entries.desc_en: Interactive children's fairy tales: a Gemini Live narrator paints watercolor illustrations as it tells, the child must do a real-world action challenge to continue; Agent mode plans scripts with multiple agents
entries.note: 黑客松作品；依赖 Gemini Live、Veo 3.1、Google ADK 和 Cloud Run
entries.note_en: Hackathon entry; depends on Gemini Live, Veo 3.1, Google ADK and Cloud Run

entries.name: glyphkeeper
entries.desc: COC7 AI 守密人：LangGraph 拆成意图→确定性规则裁定→叙事→状态固化节点，事件溯源做唯一事实源，LightRAG 加结构化库双脑记忆
entries.desc_en: COC7 AI keeper: LangGraph splits it into intent, deterministic rules adjudication, narration and state-commit nodes, event sourcing is the single source of truth, and LightRAG plus a structured store give dual-brain memory
entries.note: 作者已停止开发，自评规则仲裁过严、限制叙事，转做 OpenCOCKeeper；仓库不附规则书原文
entries.note_en: The author stopped development, judged the rules arbitration too strict and limiting to narration, and moved to OpenCOCKeeper; the repo does not include rulebook text

entries.name: LivingCharacters
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 脚本：轮转调度关系卡、随机卡和世界事件，让 NPC 之间自发产生关系、冲突和支线，可选角色内心独白卡
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon script: rotates relationship cards, random cards and world events so NPCs spontaneously develop relationships, conflicts and side plots among themselves, with optional character inner-monologue cards
entries.note: 需装进 AI Dungeon 场景脚本；内心独白卡与 Optimized Context 不兼容
entries.note_en: Must be installed as an AI Dungeon scenario script; inner-monologue cards are incompatible with Optimized Context

entries.name: LT
entries.desc: 本地互动叙事平台：从世界观、角色卡、NPC 快照开冒险，运行时状态中心追踪人物关系、地点、势力和时间线，按 token 预算组装上下文
entries.desc_en: Local interactive narrative platform: starts adventures from worldbuilding, character cards and NPC snapshots, a runtime state hub tracks relationships, locations, factions and timeline, and context is assembled within a token budget
entries.note: Flutter 全平台；资源生成走规划→蓝图→分段生成→校验；含本地神经 TTS
entries.note_en: Flutter on all platforms; asset generation goes plan, blueprint, segmented generation, validation; includes local neural TTS

entries.name: novel-rpg
entries.desc: 小说 RPG skill：导入 PDF 小说自动切章、抽角色、生成场景图，玩家扮演任一角色做选择，属性影响选项，偏离度记录与原著的分歧
entries.desc_en: Novel RPG skill: imports a PDF novel, auto-splits chapters, extracts characters and generates scene images; the player plays any character, attributes affect options, divergence from the original is tracked
entries.note: 内置《呼啸山庄》《西游记》场景数据；支持存档续玩
entries.note_en: Ships scene data for Wuthering Heights and Journey to the West; supports save and resume

entries.name: ReputeX-Engine
entries.desc: AI Dungeon 脚本引擎：用正则词典判读玩家意图，维护派系与个人声望、世界时钟和日/月/年事件，把声望摘要和分视角地点设定注入上下文
entries.desc_en: AI Dungeon script engine: reads player intent with a regex dictionary, maintains faction and personal reputation, a world clock and daily/monthly/yearly events, injects reputation summaries and per-perspective location settings into context
entries.note: 叙事由 AI Dungeon 平台模型完成；示例是海拉鲁派系，需自行填派系和事件；仓库无许可证
entries.note_en: Narration is done by the AI Dungeon platform's model; the example is Hyrule factions, you fill in factions and events yourself; repo has no license

entries.name: RPG-OS
entries.desc: 纯指令文件夹式单人跑团：AI 主持按 OS/AGENTS.md 运行游戏，世界、角色与战役状态写进可读文件跨对话续玩，附规则机制与主持契约文档
entries.desc_en: Instruction-folder solo TRPG: the AI game master runs the game by OS/AGENTS.md, world, character and campaign state are written to readable files so play resumes across conversations, with rules mechanics and game master contract documents
entries.note: 需能读写本地文件的 agent（README 以 Codex 桌面版为例）；游戏包是 Release 中约 320KB 的 Markdown 压缩包
entries.note_en: Needs an agent that can read and write local files (the README uses the Codex desktop app as an example); the game package is a roughly 320KB Markdown zip in Releases

entries.name: SillyTavern-CreativeStudio
entries.desc: 一句话生成整套 ST 角色扮演：前提→角色→角色卡→多个不同开场→能触发的世界书→预设与正则，每步结构化调用后自我批评修正
entries.desc_en: Generates a whole SillyTavern roleplay setup from one line: premise, characters, cards, several openings, triggerable lorebook, presets and regex, each step a structured call with self-critique
entries.note: SillyTavern 扩展，需 ST ≥1.19；可选 ComfyUI 生成立绘与表情
entries.note_en: SillyTavern extension, needs ST 1.19+; optional ComfyUI for portraits and expressions

entries.name: agentic-quest
entries.desc: Claude Code/Codex 里的文字 RPG：从任意小说文本生成世界，谜题由 Python 校验函数判成败，同伴是真子 agent，按玩法偏好生成新区域
entries.desc_en: Text RPG in Claude Code/Codex: generates a world from any novel text, puzzles judged by Python validation functions, companions are real sub-agents, new areas generated by play preference
entries.note: 最后更新 2026-04-07，早于时效线；因谜题用代码校验、同伴派子 agent 的思路少见而保留
entries.note_en: Last updated 2026-04-07, before the recency cutoff; kept because code-verified puzzles and sub-agent companions are rare ideas

entries.name: AI-text-adv
entries.desc: 终端文字冒险引擎：AI 每轮生成剧情和普通/检定/门槛三类选项，六维属性、背包、概率检定持久化，历史自动压缩以控制 token
entries.desc_en: Terminal text-adventure engine: each turn the AI generates plot and three kinds of options (normal / check / gate), with six attributes, inventory and probability checks persisted, and history compressed automatically to control tokens
entries.note: 需要 OpenAI 兼容 API；配置里可调色情、暴力等偏好
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI-compatible API; the config lets you adjust preferences such as sexual content and violence

entries.name: AIDND
entries.desc: 单文件 Pygame 跑团引擎：LLM 当 DM 叙事，角色卡、物品、属性用结构化 JSON 维护，程序负责 d20 掷骰和数值，带存档与历史追踪
entries.desc_en: Single-file Pygame TRPG engine: the LLM acts as DM narrating, character sheets, items and stats kept as structured JSON, the program handles d20 rolls and numbers, with save and history tracking
entries.note: 作者标注 WIP，只有一个 Python 文件；兼容 OpenAI 接口及 Ollama / LM Studio
entries.note_en: Author marks it WIP, a single Python file; works with OpenAI APIs and Ollama / LM Studio

entries.name: Aphelion
entries.desc: 离线桌面 AI 的角色扮演模块：每轮回复后更新场景状态（服装、道具、地点）和 10 项角色数值并注入下一轮，限制用户替角色决定行为，配滚动摘要记忆
entries.desc_en: Roleplay module of an offline desktop AI: after each reply updates scene state (clothing, props, place) and 10 character stats for the next turn, stops the user deciding for characters, rolling summary memory
entries.note: 通用本地 AI 助手（另有代码、文档、专家问答），角色扮演/写故事/对话树只是其中模块；基于 llama.cpp；角色数值含亲密与性唤起维度，涉成人内容
entries.note_en: A general local AI assistant (also code, documents, expert Q&A) where roleplay/story writing/dialogue trees are just modules; based on llama.cpp; character stats include intimacy and arousal dimensions, involving adult content

entries.name: cognee-dnd-game
entries.desc: 局域网多人 D&D：AI 地下城主讲述剧情，Cognee 把每次决策、NPC 和战役事件写进知识图谱与 Markdown 设定库，叙事时检索调用
entries.desc_en: LAN multiplayer D&D: an AI dungeon master narrates while Cognee writes decisions, NPCs and campaign events into a knowledge graph and Markdown setting bible, retrieved during narration
entries.note: 多人模式用 Groq API，单人模式用 Claude CLI；本质是 Cognee 图记忆的演示项目
entries.note_en: Multiplayer uses the Groq API, single-player uses Claude CLI; essentially a demo of Cognee graph memory

entries.name: dnd_ai_dm

entries.name: llmadventure

entries.name: Pliego-Lab

entries.desc_en: Local roleplay workbench: lorebook, NPC tracker profiling recurring characters, Memoria Viva maintaining continuity and canon, Recast for multi-round prose rewriting, automatic illustration

entries.name: reveriesoil

entries.note: BYOK（DeepSeek/Kimi 等），图像与 TTS 可选；Windows/Android 安装包在 Releases
entries.note_en: BYOK (DeepSeek/Kimi etc.), image and TTS optional; Windows/Android installers in Releases

entries.name: samvoisin/ai-dungeon-master
entries.desc: Discord 跑团 GM 机器人：GPT-4 + LlamaIndex 按玩家行动即时推进剧情、扮演 NPC 对话并执行 TTRPG 规则，带存档目录
entries.desc_en: Discord TRPG GM bot: GPT-4 + LlamaIndex advances the story instantly by player actions, plays NPC dialogue and enforces TTRPG rules, with a save directory

entries.note_en: Bring your own OpenAI API and Discord bot token

entries.name: WhisperQuest
entries.desc: 语音选择冒险：Whisper 识别玩家口述的选择，LLM 按惊悚等预设或自定义题材逐回合讲故事，配场景图和多种 TTS、声音克隆朗读
entries.desc_en: Voice-choice adventure: Whisper recognizes the spoken choice, an LLM tells the story turn by turn in preset or custom genres, with scene images, multiple TTS and voice-cloning readers

entries.name: AaaliceTavern
entries.desc: 规则引擎先结算行动条件、结果分支和 NPC 自主决策，再把结果、角色状态和世界书条目拼进提示词让 LLM 写旁白；内容按 addon 包组织

entries.name: ai-dungeon-game

entries.desc_en: Gradio text dungeon adventure: Llama 3.2 procedurally generates multi-chain quests by player progress and narrates responses, code tracks inventory and world state, and LLaMA Guard reviews each output

entries.name: ai-gamestudio

entries.name: Corvus-Story-Core
entries.desc: 本地文字 RPG 主持引擎：每回合叙述后由隐藏 GM 抽取数值/物品/NPC 态度增量写盘，NPC 卡自带记忆，旧对话自动压成章节摘要

entries.name: ell-hosse/AI-Dungeon-Master

entries.desc_en: LLM dungeon master web game: generates adventure premise and main/side quests, updates inventory, stats and quest state per action, clearing all quests wins

entries.note_en: Needs an OpenRouter API

entries.name: Evermind

entries.note_en: Extends the ChatRPG prompt Sean Huggins published on Medium; includes a Portuguese version

entries.name: AIGC-Game
entries.desc: LangGraph 用 Router 调度多个 NPC 智能体，NPC 带情感和记忆，按场景任务对话推进剧情，退场时由 WorldState 结算任务、更新世界
entries.desc_en: LangGraph with a Router dispatching multiple NPC agents that have emotions and memory; the story advances through scene-task dialogue, and on exit a WorldState settles tasks and updates the world
entries.note: 需 OpenAI 兼容 API；Unity 前端不在仓库里，场景和 NPC 设定改 data/ 下的 JSON
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI-compatible API; the Unity frontend is not in the repo; edit the JSON under data/ for scenes and NPC settings

entries.name: LED.AI
entries.desc: 角色扮演提示框架：Friction Engine 不让 AI 替玩家化解冲突、NPC 按私利行事；感官规则禁抽象形容词；每轮附 State Ledger 防漂移
entries.desc_en: Roleplay prompt framework: a Friction Engine stops the AI from resolving conflict for the player and makes NPCs act on self-interest; sensory rules ban abstract adjectives; a State Ledger attached each turn prevents drift

entries.name: MyLifeStory
entries.desc: 世界模拟式互动叙事：建世界和分级 NPC（含隐藏特质），事件确认后触发关系与状态漂移、场景解锁，事件超阈值压缩成摘要，按预算裁剪上下文
entries.desc_en: World-simulation interactive narrative: builds a world and tiered NPCs (with hidden traits); confirmed events trigger relationship/state drift and scene unlocks, over-threshold events compress into summaries, context trimmed to a budget
entries.note: 从目录结构看基于 SillyTavern 代码库改造，新增 world-simulation 模块
entries.note_en: From the directory structure it appears adapted from the SillyTavern codebase, with a new world-simulation module

entries.name: OpenCOCKeeper
entries.desc: CoC 7 版 AI 守秘人：BM25 检索用户导入的模组原文和规则库，mem0/Qdrant 语义记忆，d100 检定与理智规则由纯函数经工具调用执行
entries.desc_en: CoC 7th edition AI keeper: BM25 retrieval over user-imported scenario text and rules library, mem0/Qdrant semantic memory, and d100 checks and sanity rules executed by pure functions via tool calls
entries.note: 开发中；不含规则书和模组，需自备；架构参考 Concordia 与 ChatRPG v2
entries.note_en: In development; does not include rulebooks or scenarios, bring your own; architecture references Concordia and ChatRPG v2
