entries.name: ripple
entries.desc: 输入任一历史时刻，玩家以当事决策者身份面对真实抉择，模型生成选项和后果并在地球仪上展示涟漪，最后对照真实历史给出评述
entries.desc_en: Enter any historical moment and the player faces a real decision as the person involved; the model generates options and consequences, shows the ripples on a globe, and finally offers commentary compared against real history
entries.note: 黑客松项目；需 K2 Think、Groq、Gemini 等多个 API
entries.note_en: Hackathon project; needs several APIs including K2 Think, Groq and Gemini

entries.name: spark-world
entries.desc: 回合制叙事模拟：生成有个性的 agent，靠结盟获得生命能量，也可掠夺或向神秘角色乞求；Storyteller agent 把每回合事件写成叙事
entries.desc_en: Turn-based narrative simulation: generates agents with personalities who gain life energy by forming alliances, or may plunder or beg a mysterious figure; a Storyteller agent writes each turn's events as narrative
entries.note: 需要 OpenAI API；基于 DSPy，Streamlit 界面
entries.note_en: Needs the OpenAI API; built on DSPy with a Streamlit UI

entries.name: Veins-of-Erid-n
entries.desc: Gemini 按世界圣经当叙事者实时生成文字冒险，每轮回传日志、阵营声望、NPC 名录和背包作为记忆，玩家选择改变后续剧情，配 Imagen 插图和 TTS
entries.desc_en: Gemini acts as narrator in a real-time text adventure built from a world bible; each turn it feeds back the log, faction reputation, NPC roster and inventory as memory, player choices change later plot, with Imagen illustrations and TTS
entries.note: 已停止维护（仓库已归档）；固定原创世界观 Eridûn；需 Google Gemini API
entries.note_en: No longer maintained (repo archived); fixed original setting Eridûn; needs the Google Gemini API

entries.name: VySol
entries.desc: 把按顺序排列的 TXT/EPUB 原著分块建向量库，在该世界的 Chronicle 会话里检索原著上下文进行角色扮演，目标是 GraphRAG 与实体消解
entries.desc_en: Chunks in-order TXT/EPUB source works into a vector store and retrieves source context in that world's Chronicle session for roleplay; the goal is GraphRAG and entity resolution
entries.note: 开发中：main 是新版基础，知识图谱/GraphRAG 尚未完成，早期原型在其他分支；Windows 启动
entries.note_en: In development: main is the base of the new version, the knowledge graph/GraphRAG is not finished, and the early prototype is on other branches; Windows launch

entries.name: harnessNovel
entries.desc: 先对参考小说分三阶段拆书（结构、世界观、情节单元、文风），把情节抽象成叙事模式，再按核心玩法→舞台路线→章纲→正文仿写，章节级去 AI 味
entries.desc_en: Tears down a reference novel in three stages (structure, worldbuilding, plot units, style), abstracts plots into narrative patterns, then imitates through core gameplay, stage route, chapter outline and text, with chapter-level de-AI
entries.note: pip 安装后有 CLI 和本地 Web 工作台；需 OpenAI 兼容 API，三组模型可分开配；系统文/领主文可开机制层管面板与资源；去 AI 味后处理基于 op7418/Humanizer-zh
entries.note_en: After pip install there is a CLI and a local Web workbench; needs an OpenAI-compatible API, with three model groups configurable separately; system-novel/lord-novel genres can enable a mechanics layer for panels and resources; de-AI post-processing is based on op7418/Humanizer-zh

entries.name: longzu.skillls
entries.desc: 江南、烽火戏诸侯文风蒸馏 skill：全文统计 1465 万字语料加等距精读，得出共享叙事骨架和可替换语言皮肤，支持风格杂交，附审计脚本和盲测
entries.desc_en: Style distillation skill for Jiang Nan and Fenghuo Xi Zhuhou: statistics over a 14.65M-character corpus plus close reading give a narrative skeleton and swappable language skins, style crossbreeding, blind tests
entries.note: 同人/仿写性质，仓库只有风格笔记、不含原文；盲测方法改造自 alchaincyf/nuwa-skill
entries.note_en: Fan/imitation work; repo contains only style notes, no original text; blind-test method adapted from alchaincyf/nuwa-skill

entries.name: jiangnan.skill
entries.desc: 用 Nuwa 蒸馏出的江南 9 个心智模型，先引导式提问提取用户的结局构想，再按彩蛋式或最终章式写《龙族》结局，最后走 5 步江南化润色
entries.desc_en: Nine Jiangnan mental models distilled with Nuwa: guided questions first extract the user's ending idea, then it writes a Dragon Raja ending in Easter-egg or final-chapter style, and finishes with a 5-step Jiangnan-style polish
entries.note: 聚焦《龙族》同人结局；基于 alchaincyf/nuwa-skill 蒸馏；公开版不含原文素材
entries.note_en: Focused on Dragon Raja fan-fiction endings; distilled based on alchaincyf/nuwa-skill; the public version contains no source text

entries.name: novel-writer-style-cn
entries.desc: 在七步规格驱动写作法上加风格学习：用分词、句长、情感等 NLP 指标量化分析样本作者，生成风格配置供 AI 仿写，并校验风格一致性
entries.desc_en: Adds style learning to the seven-step spec-driven writing method: quantifies a sample author with NLP metrics (word segmentation, sentence length, sentiment), generates a style config for the AI to imitate, and checks style consistency
entries.note: 基于 wordflowlab/novel-writer；另有开发中的 WebUI 版 lsg1103275794/novel-writer-style-cn-webui
entries.note_en: Based on wordflowlab/novel-writer; a WebUI version, lsg1103275794/novel-writer-style-cn-webui, is in development

entries.name: xin-skills
entries.desc: 122 个文风锁定 skill：从番茄热门书和金庸、古龙等指定小说萃取十维风格规范，只仿文笔不抄剧情
entries.desc_en: 122 style-locking skills: extracts ten-dimension style specs from hit Fanqie books and designated novels by Jin Yong, Gu Long and others, imitating prose only, not plots
entries.note: 每个技能附对应原作的段落摘录作风格样本
entries.note_en: Each skill includes passage excerpts from the corresponding source as style samples

entries.name: sun-yuchen-writing
entries.desc: 冷峻账单式第一人称短篇 skill：先建数字、物件、劳动、空缺四本素材账和叙述者盲点表，按新题材重造双层故事，排六到八个场景、结尾回收物件；附十维审稿量表
entries.desc_en: Cold, ledger-style first-person short stories: four material ledgers (numbers, objects, labor, absences) and a narrator blind-spot table, a two-layer story rebuilt for a new topic, 6-8 scenes ending on a returning object; 10-dimension review rubric
entries.note: 写法提炼自孙宇晨《我的女友景甜》，SKILL.md 要求不复用原文句子、人物关系和情节；仓库附带原文全文
entries.note_en: Technique distilled from Justin Sun's essay "My Girlfriend Jing Tian"; SKILL.md forbids reusing the original's sentences, relationships and plot; the repo includes the full original text

entries.name: Skills-for-Long-Online-Novel-Authors
entries.desc: 网文作者蒸馏 skill：导入作者小说、读者评论与社交内容，提取写作风格和作者人格，生成可调用的作者 skill，按其风格续写或开书
entries.desc_en: Web novel author distillation skill: imports an author's novels, reader comments and social content, extracts style and persona into a callable author skill that continues or opens books in that style
entries.note: 没有 README.md，说明在 README_ZH.md；CLI 目录附带预编译 exe，建议用 Python 源码；需自备作者原文
entries.note_en: No README.md, instructions are in README_ZH.md; the CLI directory bundles a prebuilt exe, Python source is recommended; you must supply the author's original text

entries.name: wenfeng-skill
entries.desc: 给一部小说文本，提炼叙事模型、语言指纹、母题、人物与情节技法，生成可直接调用的仿写 SKILL.md
entries.desc_en: Given a novel's text, extracts its narrative model, language fingerprint, motifs, character and plot techniques, and generates a directly callable imitation SKILL.md
entries.note: 仓库不含原作文本，需自备有权处理的小说文本
entries.note_en: Repo contains no source novel text, you must supply text you have the right to process

entries.name: make-ur-Agent-writer
entries.desc: 导入原作切章，抽取人物、事件、关系并人工确认后选续写起点，经方向辩论、章节规划、5+1 审稿和文风漂移检测逐章续写，也支持原创
entries.desc_en: Imports a source work, extracts characters, events and relationships for human confirmation, then continues chapter by chapter via direction debate, planning, 5+1 review and style-drift detection; supports original work
entries.note: 原作语料不入库；短剧实现单独放在 codex/short-drama 分支
entries.note_en: Source corpus is not stored in the repo; short drama implementation is on the separate codex/short-drama branch

entries.name: novel-deconstruct
entries.desc: 输入番茄小说链接或正文，按麦基《故事》、许荣哲《小说课》等框架做定量扫描、逐场景拆解和价值变化追踪，输出 18 章拆书报告供仿写参考
entries.desc_en: Takes a Fanqie Novel link or text and does a quantitative scan, scene-by-scene teardown and value-change tracking (McKee's Story, Xu Rongzhe's fiction course), outputting an 18-chapter book teardown report for style imitation
entries.note: 本身只产出拆书报告，README 建议把技法规律注入 awesome-novel-skill 用于写作；含番茄字体解码与章节抓取脚本
entries.note_en: Only produces the teardown report; the README suggests injecting the technique patterns into awesome-novel-skill for writing; includes Fanqie font decoding and chapter-scraping scripts

entries.name: stephen-chow-skill
entries.desc: 无厘头喜剧 skill：先定人物欲望、喜剧规则与地位关系，从 8 类喜剧机制选 2-3 个搭升级链再写台词，最后做原创性检查与可拍性评分迭代
entries.desc_en: Absurdist comedy skill: fixes character desire, comedy rules and status relations first, picks 2-3 of 8 comedy mechanisms to build an escalation chain before writing lines, then iterates on an originality check and a shootability score
entries.note: 非周星驰官方；只抽象喜剧机制，不收录台词，内置近似文本检查
entries.note_en: Not official Stephen Chow; abstracts only the comedy mechanisms and includes no lines, with a built-in near-text check

entries.name: AI-DaLiu
entries.desc: 精读刘慈欣 26 部作品提炼构思与叙事方法来写科幻，三体同人遵守原作设定，并仿 Generative Agents 每天生成「大刘日记」积累生活质感
entries.desc_en: Close-reads Liu Cixin's 26 works for ideation and narrative methods to write science fiction; Three-Body fan fiction follows the original settings; a Generative Agents-style daily diary adds lived texture
entries.note: 风格和同人技能绑定刘慈欣/三体；仓库含大量生成的作品与日记文本；另有短片制作技能
entries.note_en: Style and fan fiction skills are tied to Liu Cixin / Three-Body; repo contains many generated works and diary texts; also has a short-film production skill

entries.name: novel-style-skills
entries.desc: 从小说样本蒸馏作者文风为 style.json，按声音/句法/对白分层融合多位作者，写前检查欲望-阻力-选择-代价故事引擎，写后评测风格漂移与 AI 味
entries.desc_en: Distills an author's style from novel samples into style.json, blends multiple authors by layer of voice / syntax / dialogue, checks a desire-obstacle-choice-cost story engine before writing, and evaluates style drift and AI tone afterward
entries.note: 受 YIKUAIBANZI/forge-skill（人物蒸馏）启发，非其 fork；样本需用户自备
entries.note_en: Inspired by YIKUAIBANZI/forge-skill (character distillation), not a fork; you supply the samples

entries.name: works-dna-extractor
entries.desc: 把小说拆成 16 层「作品 DNA」（叙事引擎、POV、对话系统、情感算法、信息控制等），再按五步续写协议仿写/改写，用 8 维量表评估吻合度
entries.desc_en: Breaks a novel into a 16-layer "work DNA" (narrative engine, POV, dialogue system, emotion algorithm, information control and more), then imitates or rewrites via a five-step continuation protocol and scores fit on an 8-dimension rubric
entries.note: 也提供 Hermes Agent 入口
entries.note_en: Also offers a Hermes Agent entry point

entries.name: author-style-extractor
entries.desc: 仿写前置 skill：补查作者生平与文学渊源，分批通读原文累积提炼，按 references/作者名/ 写出作者信息、风格指南和作品参考供仿写调用
entries.desc_en: Pre-imitation skill: researches the author's life and literary lineage, reads the original in batches with cumulative extraction, writes author info, style guide and references under references/author-name/
entries.note: 仓库只有一个 SKILL.md，无 README 与 License；配套的 author-imitation skill 不在本仓库
entries.note_en: The repo is a single SKILL.md with no README or license; the companion author-imitation skill is not in this repo

entries.name: xin-novel-style-builder
entries.desc: 文风 skill 生成器：清洗小说前 20 章正文，从视角、句式、对话、节奏、钩子等十个维度萃取文风，生成可安装的文风锁定 SKILL.md 供 AI 仿写
entries.desc_en: Style skill generator: cleans a novel's first 20 chapters, extracts style on ten dimensions (POV, sentence patterns, dialogue, pacing, hooks), and generates an installable style-locking SKILL.md
entries.note: 只仿文笔不抄剧情；仓库附自身 skill 的 zip 打包，与目录内容一致
entries.note_en: Imitates prose style only, does not copy plot; the repo includes a zip of its own skill, identical to the directory contents

entries.name: character-card-fiction-workflow-skill
entries.desc: 从草稿、聊天记录或小说提炼带原文证据的角色设定；续写前先定六项风格参数、规划事件与优先级，再出正文和一致性清单，也能导出 SillyTavern 角色卡
entries.desc_en: Distills character profiles with source-text evidence from drafts, chats or novels; before continuing sets six style parameters, plans events and priorities, outputs text and a consistency checklist, can export SillyTavern character cards

entries.name: Novel-RAG
entries.desc: 为 AI 写作建「写作范本层」：小说切成 Scene，筛除垃圾、评估参考价值并结构化标注，四路向量召回+重排，按「试探感对白」等创作需求检索范本场景
entries.desc_en: Builds a writing exemplar layer: cuts novels into Scenes, filters junk, assesses reference value and annotates structure, four-route vector recall plus reranking, retrieves exemplar scenes for needs like tentative-feeling dialogue
entries.note: 本身不生成正文，是 novel-creator 写作系统的拆书/范本检索服务；需 PostgreSQL + Qdrant + Ollama
entries.note_en: Does not generate text itself; it is the teardown/exemplar retrieval service for the novel-creator writing system; needs PostgreSQL + Qdrant + Ollama

entries.name: justin-sun-narrative
entries.desc: 孙宇晨《我的女友景甜》冷叙事体 skill：写中文第一人称长文，用物理换算开场，精确数字当人物，把奢侈写成后勤和浪费，收在空处不讲道理
entries.desc_en: Cold-narrative skill for Justin Sun's "My Girlfriend Jing Tian": first-person Chinese long-form opening with a physical conversion, exact numbers as characters, luxury written as logistics and waste, ending on emptiness without moralizing
entries.note: 只抽写法，不转载原文；CC0
entries.note_en: Extracts technique only, does not reproduce the original; CC0

entries.name: justin-sun-skill
entries.desc: 从一篇虚构长文抽取白描、深场景、数字反差、物件三次回环、劳动侧写等机制，先做事实审计再选锚点场景写中文叙事，附失败门槛和 24 分评分表
entries.desc_en: Extracts mechanisms from a fictional article (plain description, deep scenes, number contrasts, object recurring three times, labor profiles); fact audit first, then anchor scenes for Chinese narrative; failure gates, 24-point rubric
entries.note: 仓库附带参考原文（已标注为虚构）；与 CosmicRing/sunwen-simulator-skill 源自同一篇文章
entries.note_en: The repo includes the reference original (marked as fiction); from the same article as CosmicRing/sunwen-simulator-skill

entries.name: jiangnan-writer
entries.desc: 先判断题材（校园、幻想、史诗、武侠、科幻、散文），再组合 9 个从江南作品统计提炼的叙事引擎写原创故事，长篇维护关系债务与伏线台账，附文本审计脚本
entries.desc_en: Judges genre first (campus, fantasy, epic, wuxia, sci-fi, prose), then combines 9 narrative engines distilled from statistics on Jiangnan's works for originals; long works keep a relationship-debt and foreshadowing ledger; text-audit script
entries.note: 构建方法参考 alchaincyf/nuwa-skill；仓库不含原文，同人请求会转成原创设定
entries.note_en: Built following alchaincyf/nuwa-skill; the repo contains no source text, and fan-fiction requests are converted into original settings

entries.name: sunwen-simulator-skill
entries.desc: 拆解孙宇晨《我的女友景甜》的叙事骨架（量化冷开场、账本抒情、首次拒绝、物件回收），迁移到任意题材写第一人称长文，附 100 分评分表
entries.desc_en: Breaks down the narrative skeleton of Justin Sun's "My Girlfriend Jing Tian" (quantified cold open, ledger lyricism, first refusal, object recovery) and transfers it to first-person long-form on any subject, with a 100-point scoring rubric
entries.note: 真实人物题材只用用户提供或可核实的事实；与 Leon-Drq/justin-sun-skill 蒸馏自同一篇文章，两者各自独立
entries.note_en: For real-person subjects it uses only user-provided or verifiable facts; distilled from the same article as Leon-Drq/justin-sun-skill, and the two are independent

entries.name: cuizouzhao-novelist
entries.desc: 蒸馏崔走召三部曲的民俗志怪写法：SKILL.md 定说书人腔和「日常→渗人」节奏，references 分世界观、结构、人物和样本库，可原创、续写、改写、诊断
entries.desc_en: Distills Cui Zouzhao's folk strange-tale trilogy: SKILL.md fixes a storyteller voice and "everyday → creepy" rhythm; references cover worldbuilding, structure, characters, samples; original, continuation, rewrite, diagnosis
entries.note: 只提炼写法，不含原文；附 Kelivo / RikkaHub 可导入世界书 JSON；已并入作者旧仓库 cuizouzhao-skill
entries.note_en: Extracts technique only, no original text; includes world-book JSON importable into Kelivo / RikkaHub; merged into the author's older repo cuizouzhao-skill

entries.name: didi-style-short-film-distiller
entries.desc: 蒸馏 B 站 DiDi_OK 的 14 部 AI 短片：「日常名词授予宇宙级权限」选题公式加六项自检，六拍叙事结构，三型结尾反转，伪纪录片视觉语法和出片工具选型
entries.desc_en: Distills 14 AI shorts by Bilibili's DiDi_OK: a "give everyday nouns cosmic permissions" topic formula with six self-checks, six-beat structure, three twist-ending types, mockumentary visual grammar, and production tool selection
entries.note: 第三方研究总结，与 DiDi_OK 无关联；纯方法文档，出片要另接 VEO / Sora / Runway 等
entries.note_en: A third-party research summary, unaffiliated with DiDi_OK; a pure method document, so you still need VEO / Sora / Runway etc. to make the film

entries.name: shizut0y0-skill
entries.desc: 模仿 @shizut0y0 的 kigurumi 体感叙事：把约 420 条推文归纳成六种范式（体感、拘束、短句、日记、连载、恶作剧），按五感和渐进堕落节奏写
entries.desc_en: Imitates @shizut0y0's kigurumi bodily-sensation narrative: condenses about 420 tweets into six paradigms (bodily sensation, restraint, short sentences, diary, serial, prank) and writes with the five senses and a gradual-corruption rhythm
entries.note: 成人内容（乳胶、拘束、调教向）
entries.note_en: Adult content (latex, restraint, dominance-oriented)

entries.name: sun-yuchen-writing-skill
entries.desc: 提炼「亿万富翁冷账叙事」写虚构短篇：微小数字→巨额数字，执念→奢华满足→第一次迟疑，人物离场后流程照走、旧物回环，用数字和服务劳动细节代替直接抒情
entries.desc_en: Extracts the "billionaire cold-ledger" narrative for fictional stories: tiny number → huge number, obsession → lavish satisfaction → first hesitation, process goes on after the character leaves, objects loop back; numbers replace emotion
entries.note: 风格来自网上流传的一篇虚构文章，与 LucienLL/writing-like-sun 同源；非本人授权
entries.note_en: The style comes from a widely circulated fictional article online, same source as LucienLL/writing-like-sun; not authorized by the person involved

entries.name: writing-like-sun
entries.desc: 从样文提炼标题、开头、节奏、物件回调等机制，按分析→故事圣经→重写→审稿流程换人物、换事件写新故事，还能转成短剧剧本
entries.desc_en: Extracts mechanisms (title, opening, rhythm, object callbacks) from a sample text, then analysis → story bible → rewrite → review, swapping characters and events to write a new story; can also convert it into a short-drama script
entries.note: 灵感来自同一篇 X 爆款文章，与 Bbbtt04/sun-yuchen-writing-skill 同源；默认只用虚构人物
entries.note_en: Inspired by the same viral X article as Bbbtt04/sun-yuchen-writing-skill; defaults to fictional characters only

entries.name: restrained-narrative
entries.desc: 克制叙事 skill：先定核心情感、贯穿物件、重复句和数字骨架，再只写动作与事实，初稿删去三分之一；附禁用语清单和 14 项自检，用于非虚构、回忆录和短篇
entries.desc_en: Restrained-narrative skill: fix the core emotion, a recurring object, a repeated line and a number skeleton, then write only actions and facts and cut a third of the draft; banned-phrase list and 14-item self-check; for nonfiction, memoir and short fiction
entries.note: 技法拆自孙宇晨《我的女友景甜》，参考文件摘录原文段落；没有 README 和许可证；与 AAAAAAAJ/sun-yuchen-writing 等源自同一篇文章
entries.note_en: Techniques taken from Justin Sun's essay "My Girlfriend Jing Tian"; the reference file quotes passages from it; no README or license; from the same article as AAAAAAAJ/sun-yuchen-writing and others

entries.name: director
entries.desc: 动画解说模式先定中心问题，按钩子、背景、矛盾、概念、误读、回答组织讲稿，区分事实与解读、不编造动机和对白，再做人物、分镜和视频生成
entries.desc_en: Animated-explainer mode sets a central question, script as hook, background, contradiction, concept, misreading, answer; separates fact from interpretation, invents no motives or dialogue; then characters, storyboard and video generation
entries.note: 另有个人经历故事动画、剧情影像两种模式；媒体生成依赖 LibTV CLI 或即梦 CLI
entries.note_en: Two other modes: personal-experience story animation and drama footage; media generation depends on the LibTV CLI or Jimeng CLI

entries.name: data2story-skill
entries.desc: 数据新闻 agent：侦探查背景、分析师跑代码出发现、编辑定故事主线与钩子–证据–转折结构，再出图写 HTML，每句话标注并校验到数据或出处
entries.desc_en: Data-journalism agent: detective researches background, analyst runs code for findings, editor sets storyline and hook → evidence → turn structure, then charts and HTML; every sentence annotated and verified against data or source
entries.note: 论文配套（arXiv，CAIS workshop Spotlight）；多媒体生成需 OpenRouter API；另有 14 角色扩展版 data2story-pro
entries.note_en: Companion to a paper (arXiv, CAIS workshop Spotlight); multimedia generation needs the OpenRouter API; also a 14-role extended version, data2story-pro

entries.name: good-story
entries.desc: 科研叙事 skill：从结果、图表和草稿里找出张力和主线，按证据链重排图序，输出故事卡和证据地图，按领域校准证据强度，查因果和普遍性有没有说过头，模拟审稿人
entries.desc_en: Research-story skill: finds tension and main line in results, figures, drafts, reorders figures by evidence chain, outputs a story card and evidence map, calibrates evidence strength by field, checks overclaiming, simulates reviewers

entries.name: Writingbook-AgenticWorkflow
entries.desc: AI 自传流水线：McAdams/Kvale 式 12 轮访谈→故事圣经（情感弧+起承转合）→逐章写并混合作家文风→对抗审稿+CoVe 事实核查→跨章一致性审计
entries.desc_en: AI autobiography pipeline: McAdams/Kvale-style 12-round interview → story bible (emotional arc + four-part structure) → chapters blended with writer style → adversarial review + CoVe fact-checking → cross-chapter consistency audit
entries.note: 文档为韩文，产出英/韩双语 PDF/EPUB；基于作者的 AgenticWorkflow 框架，8 个 agent 多用 Opus；三个人工审批点可切自动
entries.note_en: Docs are in Korean; outputs bilingual English/Korean PDF/EPUB; built on the author's AgenticWorkflow framework, 8 agents mostly on Opus; three human approval points can be switched to automatic

entries.name: aletheia
entries.desc: 文章、论文转纪录片：先建证据账本把主张和引文绑定出处，提 2–3 个叙事方向，按「张力→证据→解释→后果」因果链写旁白与逐镜分镜，确认后才生成素材
entries.desc_en: Articles and papers → documentary: evidence ledger binds claims and quotes to sources, 2-3 narrative directions, narration and shot storyboards on tension → evidence → explanation → consequence; assets generated only after confirmation
entries.note: 旁白确定性须与证据账本一致、直接引语逐条核验；后续含批量生图、本地 TTS/ASR、Three.js 渲染等完整成片流程
entries.note_en: Narration certainty must match the evidence ledger and direct quotes are verified one by one; the rest is a full production flow including batch image generation, local TTS/ASR and Three.js rendering

entries.name: simon-skills
entries.desc: 调查长片 skill：先定账目/代价/规则等六类核心问题并轮换，开场 5 秒用有事实支撑的冲突立起问题，结论有来源台账和事实核查；另含白板讲解视频
entries.desc_en: Investigative long-form skill: one of six core question types (ledger / cost / rules, etc.), rotated; opens in 5 seconds with a fact-backed conflict, source ledger and fact-check for conclusions; also whiteboard explainer videos
entries.note: 大部分篇幅是 Remotion 合成、火山 TTS、封面和发布文案，需要对应 API；叙事规则在 references/narrative-modes.md
entries.note_en: Most of the content is Remotion compositing, Volcano TTS, covers and publishing copy, needing the corresponding APIs; narrative rules are in references/narrative-modes.md

entries.name: image-story-video-wizard
entries.desc: 讲书、历史故事类图片联播视频向导：对标学习后组写作包，素材分可核事件、推断与传闻，交写作模型出稿后定点审稿核事实，再进配音、分镜和成片
entries.desc_en: Guide for history/book-talk slideshow videos: benchmark study builds a writing pack, material sorted into verifiable events, inference and hearsay, model drafts, spot-check fact review, then voiceover, storyboard and final video
entries.note: 完整 16 阶段视频流水线，文案只是其中一段；默认用 Kimi 写长文案、豆包 TTS 配音
entries.note_en: A full 16-stage video pipeline of which the copy is only one part; defaults to Kimi for long copy and Doubao TTS for voiceover

entries.name: wedding-video-guided-wizard
entries.desc: 14 步引导：五幕问卷采集新人真实故事并编号事实条目，写作包按主事件、细节、情绪安排段落与呼应，每句文案和分镜须回溯故事卡，再接配音、生图与剪辑
entries.desc_en: 14-step guide: five-act questionnaire collects the couple's real story as numbered fact entries, a writing pack arranges main event, details, emotion, every copy line and shot traces to a story card, then voiceover, images, editing
entries.note: 叙事在前 3 步，后续是配音、生图、视频、混音；推荐 Kimi K3 写文案、豆包 TTS，生图需在外部 GPT 手动完成
entries.note_en: Narrative is in the first 3 steps; the rest is voiceover, images, video and mixing; recommends Kimi K3 for copy and Doubao TTS; images must be made manually in an external GPT

entries.name: content-skills
entries.desc: storytelling skill：先定独特视角、先写结尾，中段用 but/therefore 交替制造冲突，按句长变化写口播；规定只用真实素材、不编造经历
entries.desc_en: Storytelling skill: set a distinctive perspective and write the ending first, alternate but/therefore in the middle to create conflict, and vary sentence length for voiceover; requires real material only and no invented experiences
entries.note: 5 个写作 skill，其中 storytelling 和叙事直接相关；其余是通俗化改写、钩子审查、去 AI 味和个人语气
entries.note_en: 5 writing skills, of which storytelling is directly narrative-related; the others are plain-language rewriting, hook review, de-AI and personal voice

entries.name: case-study-storytelling
entries.desc: 把产品设计作品集案例讲成面试故事：/plan 梳理论点、因果弧线与证据缺口，/script 写逐页讲稿和情绪推进，/follow-up 预演追问，不编造数据
entries.desc_en: Tells product-design portfolio cases as interview stories: /plan sorts thesis, causal arc and evidence gaps, /script writes a per-slide talk track with emotional progression, /follow-up rehearses follow-up questions; no data invented
entries.note: 规划结果输出为中英可切换的 HTML 审阅文件
entries.note_en: Plan results are output as a bilingual (Chinese/English) switchable HTML review file

entries.name: autopunk-media-skills
entries.desc: 400 多个媒体 skill 加 9 个多步 agent，叙事部分覆盖纪录片开发和解说、杂志特稿、调查报道、播客、编剧，配事实核查和法律风险检查
entries.desc_en: 400+ media skills plus 9 multi-step agents; the narrative part covers documentary development and commentary, magazine features, investigative reporting, podcasts and screenwriting, with fact-checking and legal-risk checks
entries.note: 大部分 skill 和叙事无关（版权、发行、PR、翻译等），叙事相关的集中在 tv-documentary、magazine-journalism、podcast、screenwriting 目录
entries.note_en: Most skills are unrelated to narrative (copyright, distribution, PR, translation, etc.); the narrative ones are concentrated in the tv-documentary, magazine-journalism, podcast and screenwriting directories

entries.name: ai-director-video-commentary
entries.desc: 影视剧解说：先做剧情调研出导演简报，把 ASR 和视觉分析融合成语义图，按因果链、情绪曲线和「故事五问」写解说，对时间戳校验，推断部分标低置信待审
entries.desc_en: Film/TV commentary: plot research → director's brief, ASR and visual analysis fused into a semantic graph, commentary along causal chains, emotion curves and "five story questions", timestamp validation, inferences marked low-confidence
entries.note: 素材是用户提供的剧集视频；需 FFmpeg、faster-whisper 和 DashScope Qwen-VL；成片可导入剪映配音
entries.note_en: Material is a user-provided episode video; needs FFmpeg, faster-whisper and DashScope Qwen-VL; the result can be imported into CapCut (Jianying) for voiceover

entries.name: portfolio-case-study-generator
entries.desc: 把零散项目笔记写成设计作品集案例：默认概述—挑战—过程—方案—影响—反思六段弧线，可换 STAR、英雄之旅、Pixar 体等 9 种故事结构，保留原事实与数据
entries.desc_en: Scattered project notes → design-portfolio case: default six-part arc (overview, challenge, process, solution, impact, reflection), swappable with 9 structures like STAR, hero's journey, Pixar-style; keeps original facts and data

entries.name: sunxue
entries.desc: 孙学白描写作 skill：从《我的女友景甜》拆出十条技法，先向用户取证收集时间线、物件和数字，再选天平开篇、押韵物件和旁观者证词成文并自检
entries.desc_en: Sun-Xue plain-description skill: ten techniques from "My Girlfriend Jing Tian"; first collects timeline, objects, numbers from the user as evidence, then writes with a scale opening, rhyming objects and bystander testimony, and self-checks
entries.note: 面向第一人称回忆录、人物特写、纪实散文；红线禁止编造数字和场景；另含镜像的「颖学」skill；结构参考 KKKKhazix/sun-style-writing，技法拆解独立；摘引原文片段
entries.note_en: For first-person memoir, profiles and documentary prose; red line forbids invented numbers and scenes; also includes a mirrored "Ying-Xue" skill; structure references KKKKhazix/sun-style-writing, technique breakdown is independent; quotes excerpts of the original

entries.name: SS-GEN
entries.desc: 为自闭症儿童生成社交故事（Social Stories™）：STARSOW 层级生成，章节主题→故事标题→按结构与叙事约束写全文，再人工过滤质量与安全
entries.desc_en: Generates Social Stories for autistic children: STARSOW-level generation of chapter theme → story title → full text under structural and narrative constraints, followed by manual filtering for quality and safety
entries.note: AAAI 2025 Oral 论文代码；附 SS-GEN 数据集，并用它微调轻量开源模型；需 OpenAI API
entries.note_en: Code for an AAAI 2025 Oral paper; includes the SS-GEN dataset, used to fine-tune a lightweight open-source model; needs the OpenAI API

entries.name: daily-bookcast
entries.desc: 书名→并行检索建事实底稿和高风险主张卡→按小说/思想/历史传记轨道定结构，每部分落一个已核验的场景或案例→分三块写约 7000 字听书稿，脚本计数
entries.desc_en: Book title → parallel retrieval builds a fact base and risky-claim cards → structure by fiction / ideas / history-biography track, each part a verified scene/case → ~7000-character audiobook script in three blocks, length counted by script
entries.note: 按 8 分钟硬时限设计，需要 Python 3 和联网检索
entries.note_en: Designed around a hard 8-minute limit; needs Python 3 and web search

entries.name: xigua-msvideo-skill
entries.desc: 先查一手资料写资料备注，区分事实、推断、模型与想象；每段须带来新发现，开头用具体处境引出问题，结尾回答标题；出英文口播和中文审稿，另含分镜配音合成
entries.desc_en: Primary-source notes separating fact, inference, model, imagination; each section brings a new finding, opening raises the question via a concrete situation, ending answers the title; English voiceover, Chinese review, storyboard
entries.note: 三个 skill 里 youtube-curiosity-stories 负责叙事写稿，可单独用；配图和合成要靠宿主生图能力、FFmpeg 和 edge-tts
entries.note_en: Of the three skills, youtube-curiosity-stories handles narrative scriptwriting and can be used alone; images and compositing rely on the host's image generation, FFmpeg and edge-tts

entries.name: doodle-explainer-video
entries.desc: 简笔画解说视频 skill：先用三问检验选题「悖论」，查证并保留具名来源（不编引用），按九步叙事弧写口播，再按 beat 配图并合成竖屏视频
entries.desc_en: Stick-figure explainer skill: tests the topic's "paradox" with three questions, verifies and keeps named sources (no invented citations), writes voiceover on a nine-step arc, pairs images per beat and composites a vertical video
entries.note: 生图和配音依赖付费的 Unsora MCP
entries.note_en: Image generation and voiceover depend on the paid Unsora MCP

entries.name: jingtian-style
entries.desc: 从《我的女友景甜》标本反推十六种手法与乐章结构，把任意文稿改写成记账式第一人称叙事；带量化自检表和反例，输出附「事实边界」，不补原文没有的事实
entries.desc_en: Derives sixteen techniques and a movement structure from the "My Girlfriend Jing Tian" specimen to rewrite any draft as ledger-style first-person narrative; quantified self-check, counterexamples; outputs a "fact boundary", adds no facts
entries.note: 方法提炼自孙宇晨《我的女友景甜》，标本句已删去真人隐私
entries.note_en: Method distilled from Justin Sun's "My Girlfriend Jing Tian"; private details of real people removed from the specimen sentences

entries.name: cinematic-confessional-writing
entries.desc: 先把材料理成时间线、人物关系、核心冲突与关键物件，再用场景、动作、短对白和首尾呼应写成克制的第一人称叙事；真实事件区分事实、陈述与未核实信息
entries.desc_en: Organizes material into timeline, relationships, conflict, key objects, then writes restrained first-person narrative with scenes, actions, short dialogue and echoing open/close; real events split into fact, statement, unverified
entries.note: 技法拆自孙宇晨与景甜相关的流传文本，不对事件作事实认定；也可用于虚构
entries.note_en: Techniques taken from circulating texts about Justin Sun and Jing Tian; makes no factual determination about the events; can also be used for fiction

entries.name: vision-reel-playbook
entries.desc: 产品/想法短片方法：苏格拉底式访谈找出唯一值得拍的点，从三种叙事格式选一种，写 beat sheet 和旁白，每个主张配可见证据，再用 React 渲染
entries.desc_en: Product/idea short-film method: a Socratic interview finds the one point worth filming, picks one of three narrative formats, writes a beat sheet and narration, pairs each claim with visible evidence, then renders with React
entries.note: 偏产品/品牌概念片，渲染工程占比大
entries.note_en: Leans toward product/brand concept films; much of the repo is rendering engineering

entries.name: storytelling-frameworks
entries.desc: 个人品牌短视频故事 skill：按故事类型选六种叙事框架（英雄之旅、坑中人等），先访谈问出真实细节，再按节拍逐段写口播稿
entries.desc_en: Personal-brand short-video story skill: picks one of six narrative frameworks (hero's journey, man in a hole, etc.) by story type, interviews for real details first, then writes the voiceover script beat by beat
entries.note: 框架取自 @personalbrandlaunch 的爆款视频拆解；规则要求不编造细节，缺什么问用户；附中文版框架
entries.note_en: Frameworks come from @personalbrandlaunch's viral-video teardowns; rules forbid invented details and require asking the user for what is missing; includes a Chinese version of the frameworks

entries.name: yizhi-oral-history
entries.desc: 老人口述史平台：AI 根据上一段回答生成下一问做访谈，原音与照片存入家庭私有档案，后台异步整理人物、事件、事实与章节，汇成「人生之书」
entries.desc_en: Elder oral-history platform: AI generates the next question from the previous answer, original audio and photos go to a private family archive, a background job organizes people, events, facts and chapters into a "Book of Life"
entries.note: 依赖腾讯云实时 ASR、COS 和 DeepSeek，Docker 自托管
entries.note_en: Depends on Tencent Cloud real-time ASR, COS and DeepSeek; Docker self-hosted

entries.name: AutoYY
entries.desc: 纪录片二创 skill：以原片字幕为骨架写第三人称中文口播（钩子、逐步揭示、收尾），去 AI 味后核查：引语须逐字匹配 SRT、数字须有据，审校过闸才定稿
entries.desc_en: Documentary re-creation skill: original subtitles as skeleton for third-person Chinese voiceover (hook, step-by-step reveal, close), strips AI tone; quotes must match the SRT verbatim and numbers be sourced; final only after review gate
entries.note: SKILL.md 为英文、产出中文；搬运 YouTube 素材二创，注意版权和平台规则；主要支持 Windows；内置 blader-humanizer
entries.note_en: SKILL.md is in English, output in Chinese; re-creates from YouTube footage, so mind copyright and platform rules; mainly supports Windows; bundles blader-humanizer

entries.name: concept-fable
entries.desc: 8 步写寓言讲抽象概念：按概念性质选故事类型与基调，动笔前校验比喻与概念因果链逐环对应，三幕结构控制揭示时机，文末附解释并做 7 项自检
entries.desc_en: 8-step fable writing for abstract concepts: story type and tone by concept nature, metaphor checked link by link against the concept's causal chain before drafting, three acts time the reveal, explanation and 7-item self-check appended
entries.note: 思路来自 Amanda Askell 的「用寓言讲概念、不点名」技巧
entries.note_en: Idea comes from Amanda Askell's technique of explaining a concept through a fable without naming it

entries.name: diaolong-skill
entries.desc: 26 个非虚构场景叙事技能（品牌、创始人、公益、患者故事等），先要求填真实素材，按场景故事结构成稿，再过八刀评估、去 AI 味和伦理审查
entries.desc_en: 26 nonfiction scenario narrative skills (brand, founder, charity, patient stories, etc.): requires real material first, drafts with the scenario's story structure, then eight-cut evaluation, de-AI and an ethics review
entries.note: 部分场景偏营销文案（朋友圈、销售话术）；另含小说、剧本用的 narrative-creative 技能和在线网页版
entries.note_en: Some scenarios lean toward marketing copy (WeChat Moments, sales scripts); also includes a narrative-creative skill for fiction and scripts and an online web version

entries.name: muse-podcast-pipeline
entries.desc: 多主持人新闻播客流水线：多版块调研后按脱口秀写法成稿（热梗、节奏、callback 钩子），配人设圣经模板，再经文本质检、TTS 预扫和混音发布
entries.desc_en: Multi-host news podcast pipeline: after multi-section research, writes in a talk-show style (trending jokes, rhythm, callback hooks) with a persona bible template, then text QA, TTS pre-scan and mixing for release
entries.note: 完整流水线依赖 Meta 内部工具，外部可复用的是写作指南、人设圣经模板和质检 / 混音脚本；README 含 Muse 邀请码
entries.note_en: The full pipeline depends on Meta-internal tools; what is reusable externally is the writing guide, persona bible template and QA / mixing scripts; the README contains a Muse invitation code

entries.name: biblical-content-engine
entries.desc: 把圣经人物和故事映射到现代职场痛点，按热点、见证弧（之前→打断→相遇→恩典）等固定叙事框架写短视频与图文，经文经 API.Bible 核验并附主张清单
entries.desc_en: Maps biblical figures and stories onto modern workplace pain points as short video and image-text posts with fixed frameworks (trending topics, testimony arc before → interruption → encounter → grace); scripture checked via API.Bible
entries.note: 基督教灵修与传播内容；含标题公式、排期等运营模块；经文核验需 API.Bible key
entries.note_en: Christian devotional and outreach content; includes operations modules such as headline formulas and scheduling; scripture verification needs an API.Bible key

entries.name: hcds-expression-refactor
entries.desc: 把口述经历整理成口播稿：先清理卡壳和重复，按主题分篇，再从七种结构（结果复盘、挑战记录、日常小事等）里选一种重排材料、改开头和衔接，保留原来的语气，不补编事实
entries.desc_en: Spoken experience → voiceover: removes stumbles/repetition, splits by topic, picks one of seven structures (result retrospective, challenge log, everyday small things, etc.) to reorder material, rewrite openings; keeps tone, adds no facts

entries.name: latepost-writer
entries.desc: 仿晚点写商业深度报道：先对齐核心命题，从五类叙事骨架中选一，检索百余信源找增量信息，用细节代替形容、以个人处境映照战略，最后做风格自评
entries.desc_en: Imitates LatePost-style business reporting: aligns on core thesis, picks one of five narrative skeletons, searches 100+ sources for new information, detail not adjectives, personal predicaments mirror strategy; style self-assessment

entries.name: life-chronicle-agent
entries.desc: 日记转人生短片：30 天日记做情绪分类和弧线检测找出转折点，按经典叙事弧写 1500–2000 字以你为主角的短篇，再拆 6 个分镜配图配音合成视频
entries.desc_en: Diary → life short film: emotion classification and arc detection over 30 days of diary find turning points, writes a 1500-2000 character short story starring you along a classic arc, then 6 storyboard shots with images, voiceover, video
entries.note: 故事用 Claude/GPT-4o/Ollama 写；情绪分类、配图、配音用本地 HF 模型；日记 AES-256 加密，调外部 API 需用户授权
entries.note_en: Story written with Claude/GPT-4o/Ollama; emotion classification, images and voiceover use local HF models; diary is AES-256 encrypted and external API calls need user authorization

entries.name: voice-film
entries.desc: 把研究或报告做成配音讲解片：先写 STORY 块（主角、代价、转折、不得声称项），按片型选叙事弧，脚本 lint 限制钩子和口播数字，数字取自数据并标实测或估算
entries.desc_en: Turns research or reports into voiceover films: writes a STORY block (protagonist, cost, turn, forbidden claims), picks an arc by film type, script lint limits hooks and spoken numbers; numbers come from data, marked measured or estimated
entries.note: 配音、音乐和审帧需要 OpenRouter key；用 Remotion 渲染，公司使用需看授权；镜头组件来自 Rieranthony/product-film-skill
entries.note_en: Voiceover, music and frame review need an OpenRouter key; rendered with Remotion, check the license for company use; shot components come from Rieranthony/product-film-skill

entries.name: Daily-Philosophy
entries.desc: 哲学寓言 skill：选一个概念写原创寓言，故事里不点题、最后 10% 才显露，再注明出处、列隐喻对照表；另一个把寓言做成海龟汤让读者猜概念
entries.desc_en: Philosophical fable skill: writes an original fable for one concept, unnamed until the last 10%, then cites the source and a metaphor mapping table; another skill turns it into a lateral-thinking puzzle for readers to guess the concept
entries.note: 概念出处靠模型自身知识，没有检索核查
entries.note_en: Concept sources rely on the model's own knowledge, with no retrieval or fact-check

entries.name: memoir-product
entries.desc: AI 采访者陪老人口述人生，只做去赘词、顺语序、断句三层轻整理成回忆录；AI 补充内容须标「[AI补充]」，多版本说法并存不合并，逐句交本人确认
entries.desc_en: AI interviewer for elders' stories; only three light cleanup layers (remove filler, smooth word order, split sentences) into a memoir; AI additions marked "[AI added]", differing versions unmerged, each sentence confirmed by the person
entries.note: MVP 演示项目，默认演示模式；AI 模式接 SiliconFlow，作者说明尚未真机联调
entries.note_en: MVP demo project, demo mode by default; AI mode connects to SiliconFlow, and the author says it has not been tested end to end on a real device

entries.name: startup-llm-content-pipeline
entries.desc: 检索结果或访谈稿先由 Gemini 抽成结构化事实，再由 Claude 按背景、历程、问题与方案、洞见写创业故事，只用原文，缺失写 Not mentioned
entries.desc_en: Gemini extracts structured facts from search results or interview transcripts, then Claude writes a startup story as background, journey, problem and solution, insights, using only the source and writing "Not mentioned" for gaps
entries.note: 需 Anthropic、Gemini、Tavily 三家 API key；叙事结构偏人物特稿模板
entries.note_en: Needs Anthropic, Gemini and Tavily API keys; the narrative structure is a profile-feature template

entries.name: XinZhongZhiCheng-skills
entries.desc: 蒸馏「心中之城」影视解说法：从正片和字幕建六层事实表，找裂缝选题，两证一反加替代解释，排命题链和片段功能表，写带证据标签的口播，再用脚本审事实与原创度
entries.desc_en: Distills the "Xin Zhong Zhi Cheng" commentary method: six-layer fact table from film/subtitles, crack as topic, two proofs and one counterexample plus alternative explanation, proposition chain, evidence-tagged voiceover, script audit
entries.note: 与心中之城本人无关，默认原创模式、不模仿本人；用女娲 Skill 提炼；没有原片或字幕时不伪造时间码和台词；方法可迁移到真实人物故事
entries.note_en: Unaffiliated with Xin Zhong Zhi Cheng himself; defaults to original mode and does not imitate him; distilled with the Nuwa Skill; fabricates no timecodes or lines when the original film or subtitles are missing; the method transfers to real-person stories

entries.name: faceless-youtube-video-creation
entries.desc: 仿 Zenn、RealLifeLore 式视频随笔：从日常反常识问题切入，用三根带具名研究和年份的证据支柱展开，首尾用同一画面呼应，先调研再写口播稿
entries.desc_en: Imitates Zenn / RealLifeLore video essays: starts from an everyday counterintuitive question, three evidence pillars with named studies and years, same image echoed at start and end, researches before writing the voiceover script
entries.note: 写稿阶段免费；配音、生图、上传分别需 ElevenLabs、Higgsfield、YouTube OAuth
entries.note_en: Script writing is free; voiceover, images and upload need ElevenLabs, Higgsfield and YouTube OAuth respectively

entries.name: finance-video-copywriting
entries.desc: 泛财经新闻口播七步流水线：先拆参考爆款的骨架，强制搜索并交叉核实每个数字的来源，对齐「谁的什么被谁搞没了」这条打脸主线，再写大纲和正文，最后从用户改稿里学习
entries.desc_en: Seven-step finance-news voiceover pipeline: tears down a viral reference, forces search and cross-verification of each number's source, aligns on a "whose what got destroyed by whom" comeuppance line, outline, text, learns from user edits
entries.note: 主打情绪化的「爽文打脸」叙事
entries.note_en: Built around emotional "face-slap payoff" narrative

entries.name: HAJIGAN-doro/StoryForge
entries.desc: 人生故事记录：AI 用开放式问题引导用户回忆和讲述，结束后把访谈整理成第一人称、有开头经过结尾的故事，可编辑导出，支持云端 API 和本地模型
entries.desc_en: Life-story recording: AI guides the user to recall and tell with open questions, then organizes the interview into a first-person story with beginning, middle and end, editable and exportable; supports cloud APIs and local models
entries.note: 方法较简单：一段访谈提示词加一段成文提示词
entries.note_en: Simple method: one interview prompt plus one writing prompt

entries.name: lawyer-short-video-skill
entries.desc: 把脱敏的真实案例或法律材料做成律师口播稿：锁定来源、抽取事实、建主张台账，按角度矩阵拆选题，案例按背景→目标→证据→结果来讲，标注缺口，没有真实结果就不造逆转
entries.desc_en: Anonymized real cases or legal material → lawyer voiceover scripts: locks sources, extracts facts, builds a claims ledger, angle matrix for topics, cases as background → goal → evidence → result, marks gaps, invents no twist
entries.note: 示例都是标明虚构的教学样例；法律结论需要律师终审
entries.note_en: Examples are all teaching samples labeled fictional; legal conclusions need final review by a lawyer

entries.name: nba-weibo-writer
entries.desc: NBA 微博 skill：先建事实卡并搜索核验，提炼一个可辩护判断，从关键回合或动作细节切入，按现象→战术数据→球员处境→命运线递进，不编采访
entries.desc_en: NBA Weibo skill: builds fact cards and verifies by search, distills one defensible judgment, enters via a key play or action detail, progresses phenomenon → tactical data → player's situation → fate line; no invented interviews
entries.note: 表达机制提炼自陈深、段冉、张佳玮的公开文章；含评论类短文，叙事集中在人物长文和复盘
entries.note_en: Expression mechanisms distilled from public articles by Chen Shen, Duan Ran and Zhang Jiawei; includes short commentary, but the narrative focus is long profiles and game retrospectives

entries.name: slide-story-architect
entries.desc: 先定观众和要做的决定，再排开场、张力、证据、方案、行动的演示叙事线，逐页写结论式标题、证据、视觉形式和讲者过渡，没有证据的结论要标为假设
entries.desc_en: Sets audience and decision, then arranges a presentation line of opening, tension, evidence, proposal, action; per slide a conclusion title, evidence, visual form, speaker transition; unevidenced conclusions marked as hypotheses
entries.note: 只出演示大纲和讲者备注，不直接生成 PPTX；个人和非商业免费，商业使用要联系作者授权
entries.note_en: Outputs only a presentation outline and speaker notes, no PPTX; free for personal and non-commercial use, commercial use needs the author's license

entries.name: Tongkehui-Multi-Agent
entries.desc: 儿童科普绘本多智能体流水线：故事生成→文学审核→科学审核（RAG 知识库、知识图谱、DeepSearch 迭代查证）→模拟读者反馈微调→插画生成与审核→排版导出
entries.desc_en: Multi-agent pipeline for children's science picture books: story → literary review → science review (RAG knowledge base, knowledge graph, iterative DeepSearch checks) → simulated reader feedback → illustration and review → layout export
entries.note: 需自配通义、火山、DeepSeek 等模型和文生图 API
entries.note_en: You must supply models such as Tongyi, Volcano and DeepSeek, plus a text-to-image API

entries.name: agent-saga
entries.desc: 把 git 历史、日志、日记和对话记录写成连载纪实小说：先出 20–30 章大纲，由真实在岗的 AI agent 当叙述者，每章以悬念收尾，禁止虚构事件
entries.desc_en: Writes git history, logs, diaries and conversation records into a serialized documentary novel: first a 20-30 chapter outline, with a real working AI agent as narrator, each chapter ending on suspense, and no invented events
entries.note: 正文语言可配置；每章页脚默认带项目署名行，可关闭
entries.note_en: Prose language is configurable; each chapter footer carries a project credit line by default, which can be turned off

entries.name: biqibao-ecno-video
entries.desc: 把财经概念讲成角色故事动画：从角色的具体冲突和选择切入，先演行为和后果再点名概念、映射现实，区分事实、假设案例与推论，再拆逐句分镜做成片
entries.desc_en: Finance concepts as story animation: starts from a character's conflict and choices, shows behavior and consequences before naming the concept and mapping to reality; separates fact, hypothetical case, inference; per-sentence storyboards
entries.note: 默认用比奇堡（海绵宝宝）角色，可换原创角色；做完整视频需生图、TTS 与 Remotion 环境，只写文案分镜不需要
entries.note_en: Defaults to Bikini Bottom (SpongeBob) characters, replaceable with original ones; the full video needs image generation, TTS and a Remotion environment, while copy and storyboards alone do not

entries.name: cf_ai_autobiography_omkar
entries.desc: AI 自传写作：先根据出生地、迁居时间线和上传的简历、日记 PDF 生成目录大纲，再逐章边访谈边写，每章结束后可以调整后续大纲，写好的章节只追加不回改
entries.desc_en: AI autobiography writer: outline from birthplace, relocation timeline and uploaded resume/diary PDFs, then writes chapter by chapter while interviewing; outline adjustable after each chapter, finished chapters append-only
entries.note: Cloudflare 实习申请项目，用 Gemini；Workers + Durable Objects
entries.note_en: Cloudflare internship application project, uses Gemini; Workers + Durable Objects

entries.name: cn-script-skills
entries.desc: 中文科普口播 skill：联网研究后按机制拆解、论文速报等模板写稿（悬念钩子、节拍过渡、反转、金句收尾），再由多个受众人设子代理打分，不达标自动重写
entries.desc_en: Chinese popular-science voiceover: after web research, templates like mechanism breakdown and paper briefing (suspense hook, beat transitions, twist, punchline ending); audience-persona subagents score it, auto-rewrites if below bar
entries.note: CC BY-NC 4.0 禁止商用；联网研究依赖 Perplexity MCP，可选豆包评审需 ARK_API_KEY；合集里还有大健康营销脚本
entries.note_en: CC BY-NC 4.0, no commercial use; web research depends on the Perplexity MCP, optional Doubao review needs ARK_API_KEY; the collection also includes health-marketing scripts

entries.name: DDA4080-Industry-Project-Tencent-x-CUHK-Shenzhen-
entries.desc: 老照片口述史回忆录：视觉模型先读照片，再按回答质量和情绪动态追问，把访谈写成第一人称回忆体、名家文学体或传记体故事，多张照片串成人生叙事并打分评测
entries.desc_en: Old-photo oral-history memoir: vision model reads the photo, follow-ups adapt to answer quality and emotion, interview written as first-person memoir, literary-style or biography story; photos form a life narrative, scored in evaluation
entries.note: 腾讯 × 港中深课程项目，默认用腾讯混元；附模拟数据和评测基准
entries.note_en: Tencent x CUHK-Shenzhen course project, defaults to Tencent Hunyuan; includes simulated data and an evaluation benchmark

entries.name: deepcuts
entries.desc: 音乐收听纪录片：先联网调研并内联引用来源，再按「之前→转折→之后」弧线列场景级节拍，生成多主持人旁白与歌曲交替的脚本，只用真实曲目并逐首解析
entries.desc_en: Music-listening documentary: researches online with inline source citations, scene-level beats on a "before → turn → after" arc, script alternating multi-host narration and songs, real tracks only, each analyzed
entries.note: 仅 macOS，需 Spotify 桌面端；生成用 Gemini，配音可选 ElevenLabs
entries.note_en: macOS only, needs the Spotify desktop app; generation uses Gemini, voiceover optionally ElevenLabs

entries.name: deepwrite
entries.desc: 深度文章五种模式（产业史故事、事件纵深、市场心理复盘等）各配叙事骨架，先抛具体事实再解释；完稿后审核员核每个数字和来源，研究员核逻辑
entries.desc_en: Long articles in five modes (industry-history story, event deep dive, market-psychology retrospective, etc.), each with a skeleton stating a concrete fact before explaining; reviewer checks every number and source, researcher checks logic

entries.name: fable-skill
entries.desc: 把概念讲成寓言：提炼单一原理→找结构同构的情境→角色与冲突→结局和寓意，附「寓意↔概念」映射表并做可替换性测试；另有零件对应真实组件的模型式寓言
entries.desc_en: Concept as fable: single principle → structurally isomorphic situation → characters and conflict → ending and moral, with moral-to-concept mapping table and substitutability test; also a model-style fable with parts mapped to components
entries.note: 用虚构外壳讲真实知识；factual 指寓意与概念逐项映射加保真测试，没有外部检索
entries.note_en: Uses a fictional shell to teach real knowledge; "factual" means item-by-item moral-to-concept mapping plus a fidelity test, with no external retrieval

entries.name: financial-report-viral-script
entries.desc: 研报转财经口播：先抽出核心问题、因果链和 2–4 类参与者的利益与行动，再安排数据；默认只用研报材料，区分事实、推断和机构观点，复核数字口径
entries.desc_en: Report → finance voiceover: extracts core question, causal chain, and interests/actions of 2-4 participant types, then arranges data; report material only by default; separates fact, inference, institutional opinion; rechecks figures
entries.note: 叙事性中等，主要靠「谁想要什么、因此做了什么」组织讲解
entries.note_en: Moderately narrative; mainly organizes the explanation around "who wants what and therefore does what"

entries.name: indonesian-folklore-terminal-rpg
entries.desc: 印尼历史民俗终端 RPG：AI 叙事者在 10 个历史王国背景里按玩家选择推进剧情，穿插真实年代、人物、地名、服饰和民间生物，内置王国史料设定，边玩边学历史
entries.desc_en: Indonesian history and folklore terminal RPG: AI narrator advances the story by player choices across 10 historical kingdoms, weaving in real eras, figures, places, clothing and folk creatures from built-in lore, so players learn history
entries.note: 需要 Cerebras API；史实依据是项目内置设定，没看到检索或核查步骤
entries.note_en: Needs the Cerebras API; historical grounding is the project's built-in settings, with no retrieval or fact-check step visible

entries.name: lifetrace
entries.desc: 传记 skill：陪聊式访谈，候选记忆经本人确认措辞、时间、来源后才写入 JSON 档案，据此生成动态大纲和传记草稿，引用条目 ID，推断不得变事实
entries.desc_en: Biography skill: conversational interview; candidate memories are written to a JSON archive only after the person confirms wording, time and source; generates a dynamic outline and draft citing entry IDs, and inference may not become fact

entries.name: Memory-Storyteller
entries.desc: 用结构化表单记一段回忆（起因、关键瞬间、情绪变化、感官细节、意义），让 Claude/GPT 写成第一人称、有始有终的短篇情书故事并定时发送
entries.desc_en: Records a memory in a structured form (cause, key moment, emotional change, sensory detail, meaning), has Claude/GPT write it as a first-person short love-letter story with a beginning and end, and sends it on a schedule
entries.note: 方法较轻：一张回忆表单加单个提示词
entries.note_en: Light method: one memory form plus a single prompt

entries.name: persona-story-skill
entries.desc: 员工视角讲老板的人设口播：只问一个真实故事素材，按钩子、冲突、翻转、弧光、接杠、成本账、产品收口七段写，按行业匹配范例，禁止编造核心冲突
entries.desc_en: Employee-view voiceover on the boss's persona: asks for one real story item, writes seven parts (hook, conflict, twist, arc, counter-argument, cost ledger, product close), matches industry examples, forbids inventing the core conflict
entries.note: 面向实体老板获客的营销向短视频文案；只禁止编造核心冲突，允许补行业常识细节
entries.note_en: Marketing short-video copy for local business owners seeking customers; only the core conflict may not be invented, common-sense industry details may be added

entries.name: skw-video-editor-ai-skills
entries.desc: 用真实素材剪案例片：先写战略前提，按案例骨架（张力→执行→转变→证据）做节拍图，选一种故事引擎，给每个镜头定叙事职责，不编造效果、不描述没看过的素材
entries.desc_en: Cuts case-study films from real footage: strategic premise, beat map on a case skeleton (tension → execution → change → evidence), one story engine, a narrative job per shot; invents no results and describes no unseen footage
entries.note: 面向 Palmier Pro 等剪辑软件，产出是剪辑叙事方案（节拍图、镜头计划、剪辑图），不是成文故事
entries.note_en: Aimed at editors such as Palmier Pro; output is an editing narrative plan (beat map, shot plan, edit map), not a written story

entries.name: story-ops
entries.desc: 个人与品牌叙事工作台：从访谈稿挖故事素材，按 STAR、英雄之旅、SCQA 等结构起草，用语料声纹 linter 校文风，再派多个受众人设子代理并行评审
entries.desc_en: Personal and brand narrative workbench: mines story material from interviews, drafts in STAR, hero's journey, SCQA etc., checks style with a corpus voiceprint linter, then dispatches audience-persona subagents to review in parallel
entries.note: 目录架构仿照 santifer/career-ops；附品牌指南 PDF 生成
entries.note_en: Directory layout modeled on santifer/career-ops; includes brand-guide PDF generation

entries.name: story-to-content
entries.desc: 把事实或个人经历写成故事化内容：选角度和五类钩子，套 ABT/开放循环等结构并场景先行，另出纸拼贴动画节拍表和口播，最后逐项核对数字人名
entries.desc_en: Writes facts or personal experience as story-driven content: angle and one of five hook types, ABT / open-loop structures scene-first, plus a paper-collage animation beat sheet and voiceover; finally checks numbers and names one by one
entries.note: 产出以社媒帖子为主（Telegram/Instagram/LinkedIn，英/波斯/土耳其语），附图像与 Veo/Kling 视频提示词；缺的事实标 [CONFIRM]，不许编
entries.note_en: Output is mainly social posts (Telegram/Instagram/LinkedIn, in English/Persian/Turkish), with image and Veo/Kling video prompts; missing facts are marked [CONFIRM] and may not be invented

entries.name: sunge-narrative-writing
entries.desc: 先定真实/虚构模式和阅读契约，再用冲突公式、双尺度钩子、场景证据、物象回环、重复与破例等十种机制写；非虚构有事实边界规则和伏笔回收台账
entries.desc_en: Sets real/fictional mode and reader contract, then ten mechanisms (conflict formula, dual-scale hooks, scene evidence, object recurrence, repetition and rule-breaking); nonfiction gets fact-boundary rules and a foreshadowing ledger
entries.note: 也能写原创虚构；方法提炼自公开文本《我的女友景甜》的叙事分析，不复制原文
entries.note_en: Can also write original fiction; method distilled from narrative analysis of the public text "My Girlfriend Jing Tian", without copying the original

entries.name: sunology-writing-skill
entries.desc: 孙学体冷叙事 skill：先从素材找命题、数字、物件、空处，再选冷叙事/财富宣言/人物神话模式，用动作链代替情绪词；只在素材内重组，缺事实先补料
entries.desc_en: Sun-Xue cold narrative: finds proposition, numbers, objects, gaps, picks cold narrative / wealth manifesto / personality myth mode, action chains not emotion words; only recombines the material, gathers more if facts missing
entries.note: 文风提炼自孙宇晨公开文本；明确禁止冒充本人或编造真实经历
entries.note_en: Style distilled from Justin Sun's public texts; explicitly forbids impersonating him or inventing real experiences

entries.name: teaching-case-writer
entries.desc: 商学院教学案例：先审计素材结构并联网核查、建来源档案，以决策主线重写正文（决策场景开场、开放结尾），配套五题递进教学笔记，最后三层核验
entries.desc_en: Business-school cases: audits material structure, fact-checks online, builds a source file, rewrites around a decision line (decision-scene opening, open ending), five-question teaching note, three layers of verification
entries.note: 按中国人民大学 / 管理案例共享中心投稿格式交付 docx，需 python-docx
entries.note_en: Delivers a docx in the Renmin University of China / China Management Case Sharing Center submission format; needs python-docx

entries.name: yang-jiang-restrained-narrative-skill
entries.desc: 回忆与个人叙事的克制改写 skill：先写清观察位置，把亲见、转述、推测分开标注，用动作和物件代替情绪判词，删无证因果，交付克制版和修改说明
entries.desc_en: Restrained rewriting of memories and personal narrative: states the viewpoint, separates seen, relayed and inferred, actions and objects instead of emotional verdicts, deletes unsupported causation, delivers a restrained version with notes
entries.note: Chinese Thinkers as Skills 系列（约百个同模板 skill）之一；受杨绛启发，不扮演本人；附修改检查脚本
entries.note_en: One of the Chinese Thinkers as Skills series (about a hundred skills with the same template); inspired by Yang Jiang, does not impersonate her; includes a revision check script

entries.name: yingxue-writing
entries.desc: 把真实经历写成生活反讽：正经语体撞破事、俗物参与因果、语义回收、现实收尾；分来源约束、个人回忆、明示虚构三种事实模式，附脚本查假口语和强行成长
entries.desc_en: Real experience → irony: formal register hitting trivial events, mundane things in causation, semantic callbacks, grounded endings; 3 fact modes (source-constrained, memory, labeled fiction); scripts catch fake colloquialisms, forced growth
entries.note: 受曾颖公开文本与「颖学」讨论启发，与本人无关；也支持明确标注的虚构讽刺
entries.note_en: Inspired by Zeng Ying's public texts and the "Ying-Xue" discussion, unrelated to the person; also supports clearly labeled fictional satire

entries.name: youtube-documentary-automation
entries.desc: n8n 工作流：SearXNG 检索→大纲 agent 规划 15+ 章叙事递进→分章写作→总稿合并并纠正史实（不编引语、区分史实与传说）→出配图提示词
entries.desc_en: n8n workflow: SearXNG retrieval → outline agent plans a 15+ chapter narrative progression → chapter writing → combined draft with historical facts corrected (no invented quotes, history separated from legend) → image prompts
entries.note: 需要自建 n8n、SearXNG 和 Gemini API；定位睡前历史纪录片口播
entries.note_en: Needs self-hosted n8n, SearXNG and the Gemini API; positioned as bedtime history documentary voiceover

entries.name: sepia
entries.desc: 按 StoryScope 论文测出的 AI 小说结构特征分三遍修：先改叙事架构（不点题、松因果链、后置揭示），再改段落流和表层措辞
entries.desc_en: Three-pass revision based on AI-fiction structural features from the StoryScope paper: fixes narrative architecture (no stated theme, looser causality, delayed reveals), then paragraph flow and wording

entries.name: WriteHERE
entries.desc: 异构递归规划：把写作任务动态拆成检索、推理、撰写三类子任务，边分解边执行并按上下文调整，小说与长报告共用一套引擎
entries.desc_en: Heterogeneous recursive planning: dynamically splits a writing task into retrieval, reasoning and composition subtasks, executing while decomposing and adjusting to context, with one engine for novels and long reports
entries.note: EMNLP 2025 oral 论文代码；同时做技术报告（报告模式需 SerpAPI）；需 OpenAI/Anthropic Key；README 标 MIT 但 GitHub 未识别许可证
entries.note_en: EMNLP 2025 oral paper code; also does technical reports (report mode needs SerpAPI); needs an OpenAI/Anthropic key; README says MIT but GitHub does not detect a license

entries.name: creative-writing-skills
entries.desc: muse 主代理调度头脑风暴、角色模拟、大纲、写手、批评、编辑和读者模拟等子代理，从已有文字提炼文风文件，写后批评修订并同步知识库
entries.desc_en: A muse main agent dispatches sub-agents for brainstorming, character simulation, outline, writer, critic, editor and reader simulation, distills a style file from existing text, critiques, revises and syncs the knowledge base after writing

entries.name: doc-story-generation
entries.desc: DOC：先生成前提和多层细纲（重排器挑大纲顺序、检测人物），再按细纲逐段写正文并用控制器保持贴合大纲，产出 3500+ 词长故事
entries.desc_en: DOC: generates a premise and multi-level detailed outline first (a reranker picks outline order and detects characters), then writes paragraph by paragraph with a controller keeping to the outline, for stories of 3,500+ words
entries.note: ACL 2023，Re3 的后续；需 GPT-3 API 和 GPU 跑控制器；更新版见 facebookresearch/doc-storygen-v2
entries.note_en: ACL 2023, follow-up to Re3; needs the GPT-3 API and a GPU for the controller; updated version at facebookresearch/doc-storygen-v2

entries.name: emnlp22-re3-story-generation
entries.desc: Re3：先生成前提、设定、人物和大纲（Plan），逐段起草（Draft），用相关性/连贯性重排器挑候选（Rewrite），再检测修正前后矛盾（Edit）
entries.desc_en: Re3: generates premise, setting, characters and outline (Plan), drafts passage by passage (Draft), reranks candidates by relevance/coherence (Rewrite), then detects and fixes continuity errors (Edit)
entries.note: EMNLP 2022 论文代码，调用 GPT-3 旧接口；作者推荐后续版本 yangkevin2/doc-story-generation
entries.note_en: Code for an EMNLP 2022 paper using the old GPT-3 API; author recommends the later version yangkevin2/doc-story-generation

entries.name: agent-skills
entries.desc: 叙事技能大全：故事教练、合写、大纲、人物弧光、对白、结局、反套路、闪小说，大量世界观构建体系
entries.desc_en: Large narrative skill collection: story coach, co-writing, outlining, character arcs, dialogue, endings, anti-cliché, flash fiction, and many worldbuilding systems
entries.note: 也含营销等非虚构 skill，按需挑选安装
entries.note_en: Also contains nonfiction skills such as marketing; pick what you install

entries.name: arrows
entries.desc: 补全式写作前端：每次按段落生成两个续写候选，用方向键选取、重生成或撤回，无任何界面元素，靠作者逐段挑选推进正文
entries.desc_en: Completion-style writing frontend: generates two continuation candidates per paragraph, pick with arrow keys, regenerate or undo, no UI elements, the author advances the text by choosing paragraph by paragraph
entries.note: 需 OpenAI 兼容的 text completion 接口（推荐 llama.cpp server 并行生成）；2024-07 后未更新
entries.note_en: Needs an OpenAI-compatible text completion API (llama.cpp server recommended for parallel generation); not updated since 2024-07

entries.name: LLooM
entries.desc: 人在环中的续写界面：读取模型 logits 同时展开多条候选 beam，作者逐段挑选或改写后再继续，一点点织出故事
entries.desc_en: Human-in-the-loop continuation interface: reads the model's logits and expands several candidate beams at once, and the author picks or rewrites segment by segment before continuing, weaving the story bit by bit
entries.note: 2024-12 后未更新（127★）；需本地 vLLM/llama.cpp 提供 logits，OpenAI 模式写死 gpt-3.5-turbo
entries.note_en: Not updated since 2024-12 (127 stars); needs local vLLM/llama.cpp to provide logits, OpenAI mode hardcodes gpt-3.5-turbo

entries.name: doc-storygen-v2
entries.desc: DOC 官方重写版：前提→层级大纲→正文三步，每步用开源或聊天大模型生成并按 logprob 重排挑选，前提与大纲存 JSON 供人工修改
entries.desc_en: Official rewrite of DOC: premise, hierarchical outline, then text in three steps, each generated by an open or chat LLM with logprob reranking to pick, and premise and outline saved as JSON for human editing
entries.note: 原作者对 yangkevin2/doc-story-generation 的重写；默认用 vLLM 部署 LLaMA-2 等，需改一行 vLLM 代码；附 7000 对情节人工偏好标注
entries.note_en: Rewrite by the original author of yangkevin2/doc-story-generation; defaults to deploying LLaMA-2 and others with vLLM, requiring a one-line vLLM code change; includes 7,000 human plot preference pairs

entries.name: novel-writing
entries.desc: 小说写作基本功 skill：场景/章/卷的因果规划、视角与知情边界、有后果的对话、保留作者声音的修订与审稿
entries.desc_en: Novel craft fundamentals skill: scene/chapter/volume causal planning, POV and knowledge boundaries, dialogue with consequences, revision and review that preserve the author's voice
entries.note: skill 正文为英文，示例有中英两版
entries.note_en: Skill text is in English, examples in both Chinese and English

entries.name: MoPS
entries.desc: ACL 2024：把故事前提拆成主题、背景、人物等模块，先归纳各模块候选成嵌套字典，抽一条路径再让 LLM 合成前提，供扩写成小说或剧本
entries.desc_en: ACL 2024: splits story premises into modules (theme, background, character), induces candidates into a nested dictionary, samples a path and has an LLM synthesize a premise for expansion
entries.note: 附 HuggingFace 数据集 ManTle/mops（前提及扩写故事）；扩写用 Dramatron 和 RecurrentGPT；默认 gpt-3.5
entries.note_en: Comes with the HuggingFace dataset ManTle/mops (premises and expanded stories); expansion uses Dramatron and RecurrentGPT; defaults to gpt-3.5

entries.name: chinese-erotic-fiction-writing
entries.desc: 中文成人向（H）小说写作 skill：动笔前勘察偏好，按写作规范写作、扩写、重写，可学习本地书库文风，会话记忆逐步收敛口味
entries.desc_en: Chinese adult (erotic) fiction writing skill: surveys preferences before writing, writes, expands and rewrites per writing guidelines, can learn style from a local book library, and session memory gradually converges on taste
entries.note: 本地 CLI 需 Python ≥3.10（pip install -e .），可把本地 txt 书库建成 SQLite 索引，统计技法密度；用户偏好存在 sessions/，不进 git
entries.note_en: Local CLI needs Python 3.10+ (pip install -e .), can build a local txt library into a SQLite index and count technique density; user preferences are stored in sessions/ and kept out of git

entries.name: writers-room-story-engine
entries.desc: 故事开发 skill：按前提→故事核→主角→Story Spine→因果节拍→世界压力→场景→修订推进，融合皮克斯 22 条、英雄之旅与「所以/但是」因果
entries.desc_en: Story development skill: premise, story core, protagonist, Story Spine, causal beats, world pressure, scenes, revision, combining Pixar's 22 rules, hero's journey and "therefore/but" causality

entries.name: WalkingShadows
entries.desc: 故事原型工具：参考生成式智能体论文，分阶段提示先描绘设定、搭故事主干、按故事动力写大纲、提炼主题，再摘要设定，全栈 monorepo
entries.desc_en: Story prototype tool following the generative agents paper: staged prompts first describe the setting, build the story trunk, write the outline by story dynamics, extract themes, then summarize the setting; full-stack monorepo
entries.note: 2023 年早期原型，README 说明有限，提示词迭代记录在 experiments/；Bazel 构建
entries.note_en: Early 2023 prototype, README is limited, prompt iteration notes are in experiments/; Bazel build

entries.name: storywriting.skill
entries.desc: 把《查理编剧课》整理成 skill：用八要素检查人物与冲突，按类型片十类定型、十序列/四幕式排节拍，再设计场景起承转合、对白潜台词和悬念反转
entries.desc_en: Charlie Screenwriting Course as a skill: checks characters and conflict with eight elements, sets genre type by ten genre-film categories and beats by ten sequences/four acts, then designs scenes, dialogue subtext and suspense twists
entries.note: 基于查理编剧课笔记；适用小说/剧本/电视剧；SKILL.md 引用的 references/ 路径与实际文件位置（根目录）不符
entries.note_en: Based on notes from the Charlie screenwriting course; suits novels/scripts/TV series; the references/ path cited in SKILL.md does not match the actual file location (repo root)

entries.name: novel-humanize
entries.desc: 中文小说去 AI 味 skill：对话改「」、破折号清零、调整标点节奏、打散骨架逐句细改，保剧情不 OOC 注入人味，配 L1–L4 分层自检
entries.desc_en: Chinese novel de-AI skill: dialogue to 「」, em dashes removed entirely, punctuation rhythm adjusted, skeleton broken up and refined sentence by sentence, plot kept without OOC while injecting human feel, with L1-L4 layered self-checks
entries.note: README 已改名 novel-live-writing（活人感写作总装）；主打过朱雀检测；整合 laoguo2025/huoren-write 与 KKKKhazix/human-writing 的规则（后两者细则需去原仓库查看）
entries.note_en: The README now calls it novel-live-writing; aims to pass the Zhuque AI detector; integrates rules from laoguo2025/huoren-write and KKKKhazix/human-writing (see those repos for the detailed rules)

entries.name: mckee-story
entries.desc: 把麦基《故事》做成 Claude Code 知识库 skill：核心框架速览、术语表、可复用故事模式和分章原文，按话题或章节加载供写作时调用
entries.desc_en: Turns McKee's Story into a Claude Code knowledge-base skill: a core framework overview, glossary, reusable story patterns and chapter-by-chapter source text, loaded by topic or chapter for use while writing
entries.note: 内容是原书的提炼与摘录；README 带作者自媒体账号推广
entries.note_en: Content is a distillation and excerpts of the original book; README promotes the author's social media accounts

entries.name: Pacing
entries.desc: EMNLP 2023 长篇故事规划：训练具体度评估器，在层级大纲扩展时对齐同层节点详略、控制节奏，再用 ChatGPT 版 DOC 逐条生成正文
entries.desc_en: EMNLP 2023 long-form story planning: trains a concreteness evaluator to align detail across same-level nodes in hierarchical outline expansion for pacing, then ChatGPT-based DOC writes prose
entries.note: 基于 yangkevin2/doc-story-generation；评估器模型与 GPT-BookSum 数据集在 Hugging Face
entries.note_en: Based on yangkevin2/doc-story-generation; evaluator model and the GPT-BookSum dataset are on Hugging Face

entries.name: BMad-Expansion-Pack-Creative-Writing
entries.desc: BMad-Method 创意写作扩展包：情节架构、人物心理、世界构建、编辑、试读等 10 个 agent，配小说/剧本/短篇/系列 8 套流程和 27 份清单
entries.desc_en: BMad-Method creative writing expansion: 10 agents (plot, character psychology, worldbuilding, editing, beta reading), 8 workflows for novels/scripts/shorts/series and 27 checklists
entries.note: 需先安装 BMad-Method；也含封面设计、KDP 出版等周边 agent 与清单
entries.note_en: Requires BMad-Method installed first; also includes peripheral agents and checklists for cover design and KDP publishing

entries.name: CoDi
entries.desc: 导演-演员框架：planner 设定世界人物并可按四段式结构规划，director 调度角色 agent 逐轮演出达成故事目标，editor 整理成剧本或小说
entries.desc_en: Director-actor framework: a planner sets world and characters and can plan in a four-part structure, a director schedules character agents turn by turn toward story goals, an editor compiles a script or novel
entries.note: AIIDE 2025 论文代码；默认 GPT-4o + Gemini，需 OpenAI / Google API Key
entries.note_en: Code for an AIIDE 2025 paper; defaults to GPT-4o + Gemini, needs OpenAI / Google API keys

entries.name: Collective-Critics-for-Creative-Story-Generation
entries.desc: 在 DOC 长故事流水线上加集体评审：多位带人设的 LLM 评论家按新颖性等创意标准批评故事计划与正文表达，领导者汇总后迭代修订
entries.desc_en: Adds collective review to the DOC long-story pipeline: several persona-driven LLM critics criticize the story plan and prose expression on creativity criteria such as novelty, and a leader aggregates them for iterative revision
entries.note: EMNLP 2024 论文代码，基于 yangkevin2/doc-story-generation；Streamlit 查看生成结果
entries.note_en: EMNLP 2024 paper code, based on yangkevin2/doc-story-generation; Streamlit viewer for results

entries.name: Serendipity-Engine
entries.desc: 八阶段工作台：作者画像→叙述者（视角/时态/可靠性）→世界→人物→关系→大纲→写前结构审计→逐章写作，正文带入作者声音与人物声纹
entries.desc_en: Eight-stage workbench: author profile→narrator (POV/tense/reliability)→world→characters→relationships→outline→structure audit→chapter writing, with author voice and character voiceprints
entries.note: 自带 API key；main 分支是纯 Markdown 理论与模板，可脱离应用手动使用；作者主导，AI 按请求生成正文；仓库内的 zip 是 Chrome 扩展打包
entries.note_en: Bring your own API key; the main branch is pure Markdown theory and templates usable manually without the app; author-led, AI generates prose on request; the zip in the repo is a Chrome extension package

entries.name: ai-story-forge
entries.desc: 日文小说模板集：人物按不变核心/准稳定/可变三层设定，故事分骨架→关键场景→场景细化三阶段构建，五轴质检，附 Claude Code 斜杠命令
entries.desc_en: Japanese novel template set: characters are set in three layers (unchanging core / semi-stable / mutable), stories build in three stages (skeleton, key scenes, scene detail), with five-axis QA and Claude Code slash commands

entries.name: fiction-humanizer-zh
entries.desc: 中文小说去 AI 味：修复梗概感、情绪标签、对白汇报腔、冲突无代价，按铺垫-过程-余波重写，强化前 300 字和章末钩子
entries.desc_en: De-AI for Chinese fiction: fixes synopsis feel, emotion labels, report-style dialogue and costless conflict, rewrites as setup-process-aftermath, strengthens the first 300 characters and chapter-end hooks

entries.name: gpt3-cyoa
entries.desc: 2020 年 GPT-3 方案：把文本逐级摘要成场景→章节→全书的层级大纲作外部记忆，再按摘要重新展开，设想用来生成分支冒险，附《汤姆·索亚》摘要/展开实验
entries.desc_en: 2020 GPT-3 approach: summarizes text into scene, chapter and book outlines as external memory, then re-expands from summaries, envisioned for branching adventures; Tom Sawyer experiments
entries.note: 只有构想文档和提示词实验输出，分支冒险生成器本身没有实现；API 脚本取自 minimaxir/gpt-3-experiments
entries.note_en: Only an idea document and prompt experiment outputs; the branching adventure generator itself is not implemented; API scripts taken from minimaxir/gpt-3-experiments

entries.name: clawloom
entries.desc: 世界推演平台：人设规则、播种角色，AI 角色按 tick 自主决策和互动，事件写入时间线，再从事件中提取叙事导出为小说或剧本
entries.desc_en: World simulation platform: persona rules and seeded characters, AI characters decide and interact autonomously per tick, events are written to a timeline, and narrative extracted from the events is exported as a novel or script
entries.note: 外部 AI 通过 API Key 接入来建世界、推进模拟
entries.note_en: External AI connects through an API key to build worlds and advance the simulation

entries.name: deep-narrative-engine
entries.desc: 成人向虚构创作桌面工具：以角色卡为核心（AI 生成或从小说提取），配世界观、文风分析与语料库，生成小说章节、互动分支故事等多种文体
entries.desc_en: Adult-oriented fiction desktop tool: centered on character cards (AI-generated or extracted from novels), with worldbuilding, style analysis and a corpus, generating novel chapters, interactive branching stories and other forms
entries.note: 成人内容；作者自述约一半模块是凑数；无开源许可证；大语料文件走 Git LFS
entries.note_en: Adult content; the author says about half the modules are filler; no open-source license; large corpus files use Git LFS

entries.name: Johnsons-Narrative-Spittoon-Inversion
entries.desc: 提示词框架：先填世界、人物、说话风格模板，从结局页倒推写到开头，用隐性因果替代显式转折，再用评分/审读/编辑/弱点四种导师模式修订
entries.desc_en: Prompt framework: fill world, character and voice templates, write backward from the ending page using implicit causality instead of explicit turns, then revise in scoring, reading, editing, weakness modes
entries.note: 需 VSCode + Cline；附 10/20/30/40 页故事模板和 CYOA 版；2026-04-07 后无更新，倒序写作思路少见，按例外收录；仓库无许可证
entries.note_en: Needs VSCode + Cline; includes 10/20/30/40-page story templates and a CYOA version; no updates since 2026-04-07, included as an exception for its uncommon reverse-order writing idea; no license

entries.name: chinese-webnovel-editor
entries.desc: 网文去 AI 味精修 skill：先冻结剧情事实、人物证据与世界规则，再处理报告腔、剧本式对话、段落碎裂和章尾不兑现，分四种审改模式
entries.desc_en: De-AI refinement skill for web novels: freezes plot facts, character evidence and world rules, then fixes report tone, script-like dialogue, fragmented paragraphs and unpaid chapter endings, four review modes
entries.note: beta；README 中作者名和仓库地址仍是占位符
entries.note_en: Beta; author name and repo URL in the README are still placeholders

entries.name: vibe-writing
entries.desc: wiki 式 AI 协作写小说：人物、地点、概念各一页用 [[双链]] 互连，先写大纲和时间线，红链记待补设定，CLAUDE.md 要求 AI 先查条目保一致
entries.desc_en: Wiki-style AI collaborative novel writing: pages for characters, places, concepts linked by [[wikilinks]], outline and timeline first, red links mark missing settings, CLAUDE.md makes the AI check entries
entries.note: 仓库本身是一部示例推理小说项目，使用时需替换成自己的项目；未声明许可证
entries.note_en: The repo itself is a sample mystery novel project, replace it with your own when using; no license declared

entries.name: worldbuilder
entries.desc: 文件化世界观与写书系统：11 类实体用 Markdown+YAML 互引，图校验关系与时间线一致性，CLI 向导出提示词交 Claude Code 写设定与正文
entries.desc_en: File-based worldbuilding and book-writing system: 11 entity types cross-reference through Markdown+YAML, graph validation checks relation and timeline consistency, and a CLI wizard outputs prompts for Claude Code to write settings and prose
entries.note: 插画与角色配音生成需 Apple Silicon
entries.note_en: Illustration and character voice generation need Apple Silicon

entries.name: worldbuilding-skill
entries.desc: 十三步世界观设计 Skill：核心偏离不超过 3 条，每条推七层后果链，再做兼容性、神秘预算、语气与叙事接口审计，另有诊断与轻量模式
entries.desc_en: Thirteen-step worldbuilding skill: at most 3 core deviations, each pushed through a seven-layer chain of consequences, then audits for compatibility, mystery budget, tone, narrative interface

entries.name: advanced-writer
entries.desc: MCP 服务加 Skill：先选结构范式，按情绪理论和荣格原型建人物，场景用「神经化学」节奏曲线和病理评分诊断后批量修订，设定存向量库与图库
entries.desc_en: MCP service plus Skill: picks a structural paradigm, builds characters from emotion theory and Jungian archetypes, diagnoses scenes with a neurochemical pacing curve then batch-revises; vector and graph stores
entries.note: 需要 ChromaDB 和 Neo4j，模型走 OpenRouter 或 Ollama；另带 Next.js 写作工作台
entries.note_en: Needs ChromaDB and Neo4j, models via OpenRouter or Ollama; also ships a Next.js writing workbench

entries.name: ai_writers_workshop
entries.desc: MCP 服务器：给 AI 助手提供原型人物、英雄之旅等叙事模式和情节线库，按项目管理人物、场景、大纲与象征，知识图谱存实体关系后汇编成稿
entries.desc_en: MCP server giving AI assistants archetype characters, Hero's Journey and other narrative patterns and plotlines, managing characters, scenes, outlines and symbols per project, with a knowledge graph of entity relations compiled into a draft
entries.note: 附 Ollama modelfile（qwen3）
entries.note_en: Ships an Ollama modelfile (qwen3)

entries.name: fictional-erotica
entries.desc: 中英双语成人情色场景写作与修订：可调明确度、语域、对白密度和场景重心，保持人物声口和身体动作连续，支持原创与同人
entries.desc_en: Bilingual Chinese/English adult erotica scene writing and revision: adjustable explicitness, register, dialogue density and scene focus, keeps character voice and physical action continuous, original or fan fiction
entries.note: 仅限 18+；skill 在 fictional-erotica/ 子目录，tests/ 附测试提示词和评分表
entries.note_en: 18+ only; the skill is in the fictional-erotica/ subdirectory, tests/ has test prompts and scoring sheets

entries.name: huoren-write
entries.desc: 网文与短剧文本的去 AI 味打磨：清理模板腔、假精确、万能安抚腔和强行升华，保留剧情事实与人物声口，附检查脚本
entries.desc_en: De-AI polishing for web novel and short drama text: removes template tone, false precision, all-purpose soothing tone and forced uplift while keeping plot facts and character voice, with a check script
entries.note: 同时覆盖短剧剧本
entries.note_en: Also covers short drama scripts

entries.name: AutoWriter
entries.desc: 34 个英文写作 skill：Sanderson 方法论套件、网连载谋略与悬念公平性、潜台词、叙述密度、因果世界观，外加自主写作循环
entries.desc_en: 34 English writing skills: a Sanderson methodology suite, web-serial scheming and suspense fairness, subtext, narrative density, causal worldbuilding, plus an autonomous writing loop
entries.note: 主 README 只介绍未完成的 Elixir 循环，skill 说明见 skills/README.md；另含若干非虚构和营销类 skill
entries.note_en: Main README only covers the unfinished Elixir loop, skill docs are in skills/README.md; also includes some nonfiction and marketing skills

entries.name: Creative-writing-skill
entries.desc: 用 Verbalized Sampling 一次给出多版点子、开头、大纲和人物，草稿自动归档进项目 wiki，带卡文诊断和批评命令
entries.desc_en: Uses Verbalized Sampling to give multiple versions of ideas, openings, outlines and characters, archives drafts into a project wiki, with writer's-block diagnosis and critique commands
entries.note: 通用创意写作（含诗歌），非长篇专用；仓库附 12MB 论文 PDF
entries.note_en: General creative writing (including poetry), not long-form-specific; repo includes a 12MB paper PDF

entries.name: reliquery
entries.desc: Claude 插件：把手稿/跑团日志拆成按角色、地点、势力存放的 relic 文件，建本地语义索引和时间知识图谱，共写时按问题检索所需设定
entries.desc_en: Claude plugin: splits manuscripts or TRPG logs into relic files organized by character, place and faction, builds a local semantic index and temporal knowledge graph, and retrieves needed settings by question during co-writing
entries.note: 依赖 MemPalace 本地语义检索；.plugin / .claude-plugin 格式；架构也可用于非虚构项目
entries.note_en: Depends on MemPalace local semantic retrieval; .plugin / .claude-plugin format; the architecture can also be used for nonfiction projects

entries.name: addictive-writing
entries.desc: 用利害、因果推进、悬问、挣来的转折、回报与再钩子来起草、改写和审读散文与脚本，禁止标题党和歪曲事实，附 24 题盲评对照语料
entries.desc_en: Drafts, rewrites and reviews prose and scripts using stakes, causal progression, open questions, earned turns, payoffs and re-hooks, forbids clickbait and distorted facts, and includes a 24-question blind-comparison corpus
entries.note: 适用范围也包括广告、邮件、落地页等非故事文体
entries.note_en: Scope also includes non-story forms such as ads, emails and landing pages

entries.name: storygen-skill
entries.desc: 按编码 agent 的流程写故事：先定故事脊梁和弧线做计划，story bible 记状态，初稿交 6 个 Braintrust 评审子代理并行审读，再收敛修订
entries.desc_en: Writes stories the way a coding agent works: plans by setting the story spine and arc, keeps state in a story bible, sends the first draft to 6 Braintrust reviewer subagents for parallel reads, then converges on a revision
entries.note: 方法提炼自 Karina Nguyen 在 Lux Summit 的讲故事演讲；无子代理环境时顺序跑六个评审视角
entries.note_en: Method distilled from Karina Nguyen's storytelling talk at Lux Summit; without subagents it runs the six review perspectives in sequence

entries.name: justin-sun-narrative-skill
entries.desc: 「可观察痕迹」叙事法：先私下建模利害、替代物、证据、不变量、压力、破裂与余韵，再挑高推断值细节写作，附修订评分表，虚构与非虚构都适用
entries.desc_en: "Observable traces" narrative method: privately models stakes, substitutes, evidence, invariants, pressure, rupture and aftertaste, then picks high-inference-value details to write; revision scoring rubric; works for fiction and nonfiction
entries.note: 非官方，方法抽象自孙宇晨《我的女友景甜》；附原文全文（README 称已获授权）
entries.note_en: Unofficial; method abstracted from Justin Sun's "My Girlfriend Jing Tian"; includes the full original text (README says it is authorized)

entries.name: Logos
entries.desc: 游戏叙事写作助手：作者的 Markdown 设定库是唯一事实源，元数据+向量+全文三路检索加知识图谱，按技能向导做大纲规划、设定撰写、草稿审阅和设定校验
entries.desc_en: Game narrative writing assistant: the author's Markdown setting bible is the sole source of truth; metadata + vector + full-text retrieval plus knowledge graph; skill wizards for outline planning, setting writing, draft review, validation
entries.note: Electron 桌面应用，需 OpenAI 兼容接口；内置《西游记》示例设定库；作者的技术求职作品
entries.note_en: Electron desktop app, needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; ships an example Journey to the West setting bible; the author's portfolio piece for tech job hunting

entries.name: narrative-production-skills
entries.desc: 开发、写作、连续性、评估、修订五个 skill：先低分辨率探索多个构思，区分「选中」与「批准」，批准的决定成为下游约束，改稿只重开受影响部分
entries.desc_en: Five skills (development, writing, continuity, evaluation, revision): explores several ideas at low resolution, distinguishes "selected" from "approved", approved decisions become downstream constraints, revision reopens only affected parts
entries.note: 适用短篇、长篇和剧本；.claude/skills 下是开发用 skill，和叙事无关；README 安装命令还是 <org>/<repo> 占位
entries.note_en: For short stories, novels and scripts; the skills under .claude/skills are development skills unrelated to narrative; the README install command is still the <org>/<repo> placeholder

entries.name: novel-to-webnovel
entries.desc: 把日轻译稿、机翻稿的翻译腔改成中文网文口感：分三档程度，格式清理、风格定调、样例确认、分块并行改写、QA 脚本
entries.desc_en: Turns translationese in Japanese light novel and machine translations into Chinese web novel feel: three intensity levels, format cleanup, style calibration, sample confirmation, parallel rewriting, QA scripts
entries.note: 需要 perl。默认另存新文件；重度档会把人名和背景改成中国本土
entries.note_en: Needs perl. Saves to a new file by default; the heavy level changes names and settings to Chinese local ones
